*Huiwen Yan,Kyriakos G. Vamvoudakis,Mushuang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出元多智能体强化学习框架（meta-MARL），将MARL建模为马尔可夫博弈，实现跨博弈分布的快速交互策略适应，并在自动驾驶任务中验证了其优于预训练MARL基线的适应速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有元强化学习（meta-RL）多聚焦单智能体系统，而将其扩展到多智能体系统面临额外挑战：多智能体任务不仅由环境决定，还取决于智能体间的策略交互。

Method: 将多智能体强化学习问题建模为马尔可夫博弈（MG），提出面向MG分布的meta-MARL框架，用于快速交互策略适应；定义新概念"meta-NE"刻画meta-MARL问题的目标解，并建立meta-NE与基于gradient-play的meta-MARL算法驻点之间的等价性充分条件。

Result: 在自动驾驶任务上的评估表明，所提meta-MARL方法相较预训练MARL基线实现更快的适应速度，验证了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提meta-MARL框架通过meta-NE解概念与梯度博弈等价性分析，有效解决了多智能体交互策略的快速适应问题。

Abstract: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.

</details>


### [335] [ReLiveGym: Evaluating Long-Lived Agents over Weeks of Replayed Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00710)
*Xisen Jin,Jingheng Li,Zhenglun Chen,Junyi Du,Xiang Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ReLiveGym诊断性评测环境，用按时间重放的新闻/市场/社交流模拟数周，评估LLM智能体长期存活任务中的性能，发现"何时行动"是关键设计轴，且最优设计因任务和模型而异， hindsight反馈的持续学习可缓解失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益被部署于需持续监控或循环执行的任务（如市场分析），需数天至数周无人值守运行、把握正确时机并适应动态环境。现有长时程智能体研究多假设静态环境，未充分涵盖时间演化的动态性，缺乏对长存活任务的诊断评测。

Method: 构建ReLiveGym诊断评测环境：按时间顺序重放真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流，模拟数周时间跨度，智能体在其中稀疏行动；任务覆盖不同时间敏感度、推理强度与循环频率。在8个基础语言模型上，考察模型选择与harness设计对性能的影响，并评估基于事后反馈（hindsight）的持续学习效果。

Result: agent"何时行动"的判断成为长存活任务的关键harness设计轴；最优设计随任务变化，有时也随模型选择变化。持续学习与 hindsight 反馈可持续提升性能并应对观察到的失败模式。

Conclusion: 模型选择、行动时机机制与反馈利用是设计长存活智能体的三大核心考量。

Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents become widely adopted, they are increasingly deployed for tasks that require persistent monitoring or recurring actions (e.g., market analysis). These agents are expected to operate unattended for days or weeks, act at the right timing, and adapt to the dynamic environment over time. These challenges are not fully captured in the existing long-horizon agent work, as they often consider a static environment that is not temporally changing. We introduce ReLiveGym, a diagnostic evaluation environment of long-lived tasks in which agents act sparsely over simulated weeks of chronologically replayed real-world news, market, and social-media streams. The tasks span diverse levels of time sensitivity, reasoning intensity, and recurrence. Across eight base language models, we investigate how model choice and harness design affect agent performance on such long-lived tasks. Our results show that how agents determine when to act arises as an important harness-design axis for long-lived tasks; and that the optimal design varies across tasks and sometimes model choices as well. We also evaluate how continuous learning from hindsight feedback affects performance and addresses failure modes observed in these long-lived tasks. These findings indicate model choice, action timing mechanism, and use of feedback as important considerations in the design of long-lived agents. Code: https://github.com/SaharaLabsAI/ReLiveGym

</details>


### [336] [Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00715)
*Shihab Ahmed,Debamita Ghosh,David Tang,Yudan Wang,Alvaro Velasquez,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Robust Nash Alignment（RNA），将不确定成对偏好下的对齐建模为带偏好核模糊集的鲁棒博弈，并通过四玩家代理博弈与单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法实现可计算求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于偏好的对齐方法通常只针对单一偏好模型优化，当成对偏好存在噪声、异质或部署后发生漂移时表现脆弱，缺乏对最坏情况的性能保证。

Method: 构造博弈论框架：主学习者在adversarial competitor与位于名义偏好周围模糊集中的任意偏好核两方面追求最坏情况胜率最大化，鲁棒目标直接给出最坏性能的认证下界；由于原始问题计算困难，引入由leader策略、follower策略、adversarial kernel与对偶变量组成的四玩家原始-对偶代理博弈，并设计单循环乐观镜像下降-上升（optimistic mirror descent-ascent）算法求解。

Result: 证明代理博弈始终下界截断后的硬约束目标，量化代理与硬目标的差距，并给出代理可恢复原鲁棒目标的精确性条件；证明代理博弈对偶间隙达到 O(1/√T) 的平均迭代收敛率，进而得到原鲁棒目标的近优策略；在受控表格博弈与不确定偏好的LLM对齐实验中验证了收敛理论，且性能优于名义基线。

Conclusion: RNA 为不确定成对偏好下的对齐提供了具有最坏情况保证的可计算博弈论方案，兼顾鲁棒性与收敛性，并在理论刻画与实证表现上均优于名义偏好基线。

Abstract: Preference-based alignment methods typically optimize against a single preference model, and can therefore be brittle when pairwise preferences are uncertain: noisy, heterogeneous, or shift after deployment. To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable, and develop a single-loop optimistic mirror descent-ascent algorithm for it. We show that the proxy always lower-bounds the truncated hard-constrained objective, quantify the proxy-to-hard gap, and characterize an exactness condition under which the proxy recovers the robust objective. We then prove an \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})\) average-iteration convergence for the proxy-game duality gap, which implies a near-optimal robust policy for the original robust objective. Experiments on controlled tabular games and LLM alignment with uncertain preference further validate the convergence theory and show improved performance over nominal baselines.

</details>


### [337] [Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00791)
*Terry Dorsey,Kevin Huggins*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出企业表示复杂度（ERC）模型与企业表示简化（ERS）概念，用对象、交互、行为、支撑来源四个维度刻画表示范围，并分析简化的生命周期义务与经济模型及对AI推理的促进作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业信息由应用、项目、技术、组织边界和本地需求塑造的制品所表示，这些结构随时间累积形成表示复杂度，需要企业维护，也需要信息消费者与AI系统解读。因此有必要界定"简化"的含义并提供可比较的复杂度度量。

Method: 提出ERC作为表示中立的复杂度模型，从四个维度刻画表示范围：表示对象（Objects）、交互（Interactions）、行为（Behaviors）和支撑来源（Supporting Sources）；其中前三者为依赖类，支撑来源刻画表示暴露。ERC在表示层与任务层定义，以支持比较并区分架构简化与检索优化。在此基础上推导ERS的两项推论：一是表示的维护、治理、依赖、变更、增强与运行的生命周期义务，并给出区分全局重复性表示成本、任务级重复成本与一次性转换成本的经济模型；二是任务级ERC降低可减少AI系统需识别、关联和解释的表示范围。

Result: ERC提供了可度量的架构变量，用于比较表示备选方案、转换效果、经济结果和AI推理性能；Text-to-SQL研究证据表明，降低模式与推理复杂度可提升推理准确率。同时明确ERC并非通用的复杂度、性能或成本指标。

Conclusion: ERS是在限定范围内减少不必要的表示复杂度同时保留所需信息；ERC作为表示中立的模型，可在表示层和任务层比较复杂度，连接架构简化、经济评估与AI推理表现。

Abstract: Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

</details>


### [338] [Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00797)
*Corinn Tiffany,Wen Zhang,Eugene Bagdasarian,Lillian Tsai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Sapien 是一种用于执行状态化上下文策略的策略引擎，使 AI 智能体在多步任务中难以被劫持执行越权工具调用，同时保持接近无约束智能体的效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文安全防御通常通过合成任务特定策略并在智能体工具调用上强制执行，从而防止 AI 智能体采取越权行为。但在多步任务中，哪些操作有效往往取决于智能体此前已执行和已学习到的内容，现有方法难以表达和执行这种状态依赖的策略。

Method: Sapien 是一种策略引擎，用于强制执行状态化上下文策略。其策略通过扩展正则表达式来规定允许的工具调用序列，扩展内容包括状态化谓词、延迟策略生成以及作用域语义检查。

Result: Sapien 的效用与无约束智能体仅相差几个百分点。即使智能体被完全劫持，Sapien 的策略也能在 AgentDojo 上排除 93–95% 的攻击，在 Toolathlon 上排除 62–85% 的攻击，在长时程任务中其防护效果是工具允许列表的两倍。

Conclusion: Sapien 能够在多步任务中有效执行状态化上下文策略，在保持高实用性的同时显著提升对劫持攻击的防护能力。

Abstract: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

</details>


### [339] [Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00834)
*Wensen Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Kepler：将假设表示为可执行世界模型的ARC-AGI-3开源harness，冻结配置下25款公开游戏全部达100.00 RHAE；并揭示评测漏洞，主张采用首试、成本约束与验证感知的汇报方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3的规则与目标必须从交互观察中推断，因此需要能显式建模并验证假设的评测框架；同时公开集分数本身可能缺乏区分度，现有汇报方式易掩盖评测缺陷与成本。

Method: 提出开源harness Kepler：将假设表示为可执行世界模型，并通过回溯式转移校验（retrospective transition checks）与条件预测校验（conditional prediction checks）进行验证。在单一冻结的Claude Opus 5配置下运行，不做逐游戏模型选择或依分数重跑。附带单游戏观察案例研究及跨模型棋盘对比。

Result: 25款公开游戏全部server-verified 100.00 RHAE；183个完成关卡中181个的最终Opus尝试动作数不超过对应人类中位数基线；保留棋盘共8,256次环境动作（7,292次发生在计分关卡）；令牌8.58亿、缓存读取97.37%、成本$777.72（2026-09-01列表等价费率）。报告三类评测失败：源码泄露导致的无效满分、控制条件下agent重建被移除的harness、自主修复掩盖损坏的planner。案例研究显示动画帧含稳定文本网格中缺失的任务相关信息。最终Opus 5与GPT-5.6 Sol棋盘上50个游戏-模型单元中48个达100。

Conclusion: 公开集分数单独具有有限区分价值，评测结果易受泄露、harness依赖与自主修复等混淆；应推动首试（first-attempt）、成本约束（cost-conditioned）与验证感知（verification-aware）的汇报规范。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

</details>


### [340] [Learning Multiple Timescales for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00849)
*Pedro Robles Dutenhefner,Dikshant Shehmar,Wagner Meira,Marlos C. Machado*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GITA（广义隐式时间抽象），通过让单一价值函数以k为条件并对多个k值进行优势加权监督聚合，解决了离线目标条件强化学习中折扣导致长程信号消失与固定时间抽象k难以兼顾局部分辨率与长程信号的矛盾，在OGBench上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）在长时程任务上表现不佳。主要原因是折扣因子会缩小远距离状态间的价值差异，使其低于函数近似误差，导致智能体缺乏对状态排序的信号。时间抽象（将k个环境步视为单步转移）虽可恢复长程信号，但不存在适用于所有状态-目标距离的固定k：大k保留长时程价值差异却抹平近邻状态区别，小k则相反，形成难以调和的权衡。

Method: 作者将上述权衡显式化，提出广义隐式时间抽象（GITA），其核心是让单一价值函数以k为条件。GITA通过聚合多个k值上的优势加权监督来训练单一策略：对某状态-目标对赋予更大正优势的尺度，会对该样本的更新贡献更强。由此GITA无需在局部分辨率与长程信号之间二选一，而是同时保留两者，且不必固定单一k。

Result: 在OGBench上，GITA优于广泛的离线GCRL基线。相较于HIQL，所有任务的平均成功率提升25个百分点（相对提升73%）；相较于最强固定k方法OTA，提升7个百分点（相对提升14%）。

Conclusion: GITA通过以k为条件的价值函数与多尺度优势加权聚合，打破了固定时间抽象中局部分辨率与长程信号的权衡取舍，为离线GCRL长时程任务提供了一种无需选择单一k的有效方案，并在实验中验证了其优越性。

Abstract: Existing approaches to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) struggle with long-horizon tasks. Discounting shrinks value differences between distant states until they fall below the function approximation error, leaving the agent with no signal for ranking states. Temporal abstraction, which treats k environment steps as a single transition, restores this signal at long range, but no single fixed k suits all state-goal distances: large k preserves value differences across long temporal distances while collapsing distinctions between nearby states, and small k does the reverse. We make this trade-off explicit and introduce Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction (GITA), which conditions a single value function on k. GITA trains one policy by aggregating advantage-weighted supervision across multiple k values, so scales assigning larger positive advantages to a state-goal pair contribute more strongly to its update. GITA does not need to choose between local resolution and long-range signal; it retains both without committing to a single k. On OGBench, GITA outperforms a broad range of offline GCRL baselines, raising average success rate across all tasks by 25 percentage points (73% relative improvement) over HIQL. It also improves over the strongest fixed-k method, OTA, by 7 percentage points (14% relative).

</details>


### [341] [An Educator-Guided LLM Pedagogical Agent for Scaffolded Feedback in Conceptual Database Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00870)
*Sara Riazi,Pedram Rooshenas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个由教育者引导的LLM教学代理，集成于ERD编辑器，通过隐藏的、基于学生作品的诊断与分阶段反馈工作流，为概念数据库设计提供支架式反馈。在三类ERD环境、383个反馈回合的部署中，71.1%的目标层面修改完全或部分采纳了隐藏诊断目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念数据库设计学习中，学生需要针对ERD的支架式反馈，但现有LLM反馈往往缺乏对作品、作业要求、评分量规与教学资源的充分锚定，也难以控制反馈形式与信息披露程度，容易直接给出答案或产生不准确信息。

Method: 构建教育者引导的LLM教学代理，将反馈锚定于学生作品、作业要求、教育者编写的评分量规与教学资源；架构上将"隐藏的、基于作品的诊断"与"控制学生可见支持形式与披露程度的工作流"分离。实例化为四阶段工作流：概念检查、引导性应用、低细节反馈、局部澄清；每次反馈请求生成与学生ERD版本状态关联的有状态回合。

Result: 在三类ERD环境、共383个反馈回合的部署中，71.1%的观察到的目标层面修改完全或部分采纳了隐藏诊断目标，其中许多发生在第1—2阶段之后。质性分析表明，分阶段披露有时会隐藏不准确细节、支持选择性采纳或允许后续修正，但部分错误仍影响了学生修改。自选样本的问卷反馈倾向于延迟披露与学生自主性，同时指出反馈存在间接性和重复性问题。

Conclusion: 将诊断与反馈披露分离并结合分阶段支架工作流的LLM教学代理，可有效促进学生对ERD诊断目标的采纳，延迟披露与学生自主性受到偏好；但需改进反馈的间接性与重复性，并减少错误信息对修改的干扰。

Abstract: We present an educator-guided LLM pedagogical agent for scaffolded feedback in conceptual database design. Integrated into an entity--relationship diagram (ERD) editor, the system grounds feedback in the student artifact, assignment requirements, educator-authored rubrics, and instructional resources. Its architecture separates hidden, artifact-grounded diagnosis from the workflow that controls the form and disclosure level of student-facing support.
  We instantiate the architecture as a four-stage workflow progressing from concept checks and guided application to low-detail feedback and localized clarification. Each feedback request creates a stateful episode linked to versioned ERD states. In a deployment spanning three ERD environments and 383 feedback episodes, 71.1\% of observed target-level changes fully or partially incorporated the hidden diagnostic target, including many after Stages~1--2. Qualitative analysis showed that staged disclosure sometimes withheld inaccurate details, supported selective uptake, or allowed later recovery, though some errors still shaped revisions. Survey responses from a self-selected sample favored delayed disclosure and student agency but noted indirectness and repetition.

</details>


### [342] [MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00872)
*Mitchell Piehl,Muchao Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemFit 是一种面向对话智能体的长期记忆系统，通过无 LLM 的追加式写入与多路径检索，在保持原始对话细节的同时显著降低记忆构建成本与延迟，并在三个基准上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 长期记忆系统依赖 LLM 智能体来组织和整合记忆，导致写入操作成本高、效率低。同时，部分方法通过压缩丢失了表层细节，难以兼顾效率与信息保真。

Method: MemFit 将每轮对话逐字存储在仅追加（append-only）存储中，实现近乎瞬时、无 LLM 的插入；用片段摘要对轮次进行索引而非替换原文。检索采用无 LLM 的多路径策略，结合词汇与语义信号，并在文本与多模态设置下对字幕增强的片段（caption-augmented episodes）进行交叉编码器重排序。

Result: 在 LoCoMo、MemGallery 和 LongMemEval-S 三个常用基准上，MemFit 达到当前最优性能，同时将记忆构建时间和成本降低数倍。

Conclusion: MemFit 为持久化智能体记忆提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案，在不牺牲原始细节的前提下兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Long-term memory systems for large language models (LLMs) have gained popularity for extending reasoning capabilities across applications. Current memory systems rely on LLM agents to organize and consolidate memory, resulting in costly, inefficient write operations. To address this limitation, we propose MemFit, a long-term memory system for conversational agents that reduces the cost and latency of memory operations. Unlike existing systems that rely on expensive LLM calls for memory construction or discard surface-level details through compression, MemFit stores each turn verbatim in an append-only store with near-instantaneous, LLM-free insertion, indexing turns with segment summaries rather than replacing them. Additionally, MemFit uses an LLM-free, multi-path retrieval strategy that combines lexical and semantic signals with cross-encoder reranking over caption- augmented episodes in both textual and multimodal settings. Empirical results on three widely used benchmarks, LoCoMo, MemGallery, and LongMemEval-S, show that MemFit achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing memory construction time and cost several-fold, providing a scalable and efficient solution for persistent agentic memory.

</details>


### [343] [ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00906)
*Sungho Park,Wonjoong Kim,Jue Zhang,Wook-Shin Han,Pengfei Gao,Chanyoung Park,Yongqiang Yao,Rao Fu,Elsie Nallipogu,Qingwei Lin,Victor Rühle*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将"训练课程"视为harness优化的缺失维度，提出ActiveSaddler，把课程学习建模为非平稳多臂老虎机，使课程与harness协同演化，在GAIA2和Terminal-Bench 2.0上Pass@1分别提升4.4和7.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动harness优化方法只优化"如何更新harness"（提示、工具接口、控制逻辑），却把"用哪些训练场景产生反馈"固定下来。但随harness演化，最有用的场景会变化，因此训练课程本身也应随之自适应，这一维度此前被忽略。

Method: 将缺失维度形式化为自动课程学习问题，提出ActiveSaddler：把演化课程建模为带动态实例化优化目标的非平稳多臂老虎机；将反复出现的失败抽象为可复用的"失败模式臂"，估计继续针对各模式的潜在学习进展，自适应平衡"重访已知弱点"与"探索新场景发现新失败"；优化结果持续更新失败模式集合及其优先级，使课程与harness共同演化。

Result: 在GAIA2和Terminal-Bench 2.0上，相比使用优化前固定场景顺序的同一harness优化器，ActiveSaddler发现更强的harness，测试Pass@1分别提升4.4和7.5个百分点。消融表明增益依赖动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用、以及平衡持续优化与新失败发现。

Conclusion: 自动课程学习是harness优化中一个新的关键维度，课程与harness协同演化可带来一致的性能提升。

Abstract: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.

</details>


### [344] [OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00912)
*Jinzhi Bu,Haixin Tang,Huanan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OSCAR是一个由模拟器、编码器和审查器组成的LLM优化建模框架，通过认证模拟器分配多LLM调用并持续搜索至认证改进，以低成本在本地小模型上实现高准确率建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可将业务描述转为优化模型，但生成的可执行代码可能错误表达约束或目标，导致求解器返回"错误问题"的最优解；即便解满足操作规则，也可能存在更优方案。对反复使用优化建模的组织而言，框架需在低成本下产出准确公式，并最好能本地运行。核心问题是：如何验证改进，并在价格与能力各异的LLM间分配调用尝试。

Method: 提出OSCAR框架，包含离线Simulator、Coder与Reviewer三个组件；Simulator用带标签的决策样例认证，用于比较候选方案，并超越可行性继续搜索。将"寻找下一次认证改进"建模为难度不可观测下的序贯决策问题——调用哪些LLM、何时停止。在已知先验的简化设定下，给出成本排序式升级为最优的条件；对一般菜单，导出无先验的竞争性保证。

Result: 在五个基准问题上，OSCAR在报告设置下达到95%~100%准确率，仅用两个可单GPU本地部署的小型开放权重LLM（其单次尝试准确率平均分别为29%和48%）。每个问题五次运行中，Codex与Claude Code的平均token成本分别是OSCAR的3.1倍和5.8倍。

Conclusion: OSCAR支持根据预算与保密需求选择本地或云端的开放权重模型。企业应维护可行与不可行决策的带标签样例，以澄清自然语言操作规则，并在LLM解释与标签冲突时以标签为准。随着LLM能力与价格变化，OSCAR简单的操作规则与可调设置有助于企业调整模型选择并受益于技术进步。

Abstract: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.

</details>


### [345] [Finding the Right Fit: Model-Harness Interactions across Agent Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00917)
*Yixuan Li,Yiyun Zhou,Yao Long Teng,Fuchao Yang,Yanchen Deng,Zhiyi Lyu,Xuyu Dong,Feng Chen,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文考察"模型-框架(harness)"配对在不同任务设置下的稳定性，评测66种配置后发现模型排名会随框架反转，不存在普遍最优组合，主张将模型、框架与任务三者联合评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择agent系统实际上是同时选择语言模型与其行动所依赖的harness。作者希望回答一个核心问题：一个强模型、强harness或强配对，在评测设置变化时是否仍然保持强表现，即性能排名是否具有跨设置的可迁移性。

Method: 构建66种配置进行评测：4个可配置harness（OpenHands、DeepSeek Harness、PI、openJiuwen）与5个模型配对，在TUA-Bench、ALE-CLI、Terminal-Bench 4三个基准上测试，并加入原生组合Codex-GPT与Claude Code-Claude。通过匹配轨迹(matched trajectories)分析差异成因，并发布harness适配器、评测代码及6,204条带评分轨迹。

Result: 模型排名在不同harness间发生反转：Terminal-Bench 4上Claude在OpenHands中领先GPT 7.94分，但在PI中反落后30.16分。五个模型中有四个的最优harness随基准变化，但部分配对稳定存在，如openJiuwen使Kimi在三个基准上均取得最高分（提升5.61至11.11分）。厂商自家harness并非模型最优选择，更高成本也不必然带来更高分数——Terminal-Bench 4上GPT在PI下比DSH得分更高且单任务成本不足其四分之一。轨迹分析显示，模型几乎自主发起全部修复，关键在于harness能否以模型可用的形式回传失败信息：GPT在PI的精简脚手架下表现最佳，而常产生畸形工具调用的Kimi则在openJiuwen中表现最好。

Conclusion: 模型、harness与任务应当被联合评估，而非孤立地比较模型或框架；性能强弱的可迁移性有限，适配度取决于harness如何向模型回传失败信息。作者公开了harness适配器、评测代码与全部6,204条带评分轨迹以支持复现与后续研究。

Abstract: Choosing an agent system means choosing both a language model and the harness through which it acts. We ask whether a strong model, harness, or pairing stays strong when the setting changes. We evaluate 66 configurations: four configurable harnesses (OpenHands, DeepSeek Harness, PI, and openJiuwen) paired with five models on TUA-Bench, ALE-CLI, and Terminal-Bench 4, plus the native Codex-GPT and Claude Code-Claude pairings. Model rankings reverse across harnesses. On Terminal-Bench 4, Claude leads GPT by 7.94 points in OpenHands but trails it by 30.16 points in PI. For four of the five models, the best harness changes from one benchmark to another, yet some pairings hold: openJiuwen gives Kimi its highest score on all three benchmarks, by 5.61 to 11.11 points. A model's own vendor harness is not reliably its best, and higher cost does not reliably buy a higher score. On Terminal-Bench 4, GPT scores higher under PI than under DSH at less than a quarter of the cost per task. Matched trajectories suggest why fit varies. Models start almost all repairs themselves, so much depends on whether the harness hands failures back in a form the model can use. GPT does best with PI's lean scaffold, while Kimi, which often issues malformed tool calls, does best in openJiuwen. We argue that the model, the harness, and the task should be evaluated together, and we release the harness adapters, evaluation code, and all 6,204 scored trajectories at https://github.com/liyix/finding-the-right-fit and https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixuanli97/finding-the-right-fit.

</details>


### [346] [ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00947)
*Shawn Bowers,Martin Caminada,Haoyang Liu,Bertram Ludäscher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ABDA-NL 为基于 ASPIC- 知识库和 grounded 语义的论证式讨论系统 ABDA 增加了自然语言接口，由大语言模型充当语言与形式化表示之间的桥梁，同时由确定性的 ABDA 引擎独占论证、攻击与接受标签的判定权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原系统 ABDA 依赖形式化知识库，对非专业用户存在使用门槛；需要一种自然语言接口，使用户能够理解论证结论、探究推理过程并进行 what-if 探索和知识编辑，同时不牺牲形式化推理的可靠性。

Method: 在 ABDA 之上构建自然语言层：用户可查看结论的接受、拒绝或未定状态，打开 grounded 讨论博弈的交互式呈现以了解原因，通过暂停假设与规则或改变偏好来探索替代情形，基于场景参考文档提问，并用平实英语撰写新事实、假设与规则。大语言模型负责依据文档与场景当前状态回答问题，并将自然语言编辑转换为候选形式化陈述；确定性 ABDA 引擎仍是论证、攻击与接受标签的唯一来源，模型的每项建议均需经校验并由用户确认后方可生效。

Result: 构建了 ABDA-NL 系统，实现了自然语言问答、论证过程交互式说明、what-if 探索与自然语言知识编写等功能，且所有形式化生成内容均经用户确认后生效。

Conclusion: 通过将大语言模型限定为语言转换与问答的桥梁、把推理判定权保留给确定性引擎，ABDA-NL 在提升可用性的同时维持了论证结果的可靠性与可控性。

Abstract: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

</details>


### [347] [PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00949)
*Ronghua Li,Zi Liang,Zhishan Li,Shinan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究智能体轨迹SFT中"获得新能力"与"保持原有能力"的权衡问题，提出PG-SFT方法，利用回合级信息增益调整监督强度，在牺牲少量目标任务性能的情况下显著减少分布漂移与通用能力退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在离线智能体轨迹上做监督微调（SFT）是训练专用工具调用智能体的标准做法，但逐token模仿推理与动作会损害基座模型的通用推理、工具调用、代码生成等其他能力。已有方法（标准SFT、KL惩罚约束分布漂移、限制更新幅度）均无法避免这种退化，因此需要研究如何更好地平衡新能力获取与旧能力保持之间的权衡。

Method: 受近期token级自适应学习目标启发，提出Privilege-Guided SFT（PG-SFT）：利用智能体轨迹的回合级（turn-level）信息增益作为指标，动态调整监督强度，从而决定监督信号在何处、以多大强度偏离基座行为。

Result: 对比实验显示，标准SFT提升目标任务得分但降低多个非目标任务得分；KL惩罚或限制更新幅度均无法阻止该退化趋势。PG-SFT在所评估基准上取得更优的权衡：大幅降低分布漂移与广泛的通用能力退化，代价是目标任务性能略有下降。

Conclusion: 平衡"获取—保持"权衡不仅取决于模型是否被锚定在基座行为上，还取决于监督应在何处、以多强的力度偏离该行为。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust supervision strength. PG-SFT yields a more favorable observed trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks, substantially reducing distributional drift and broad capability degradation at the cost of slight degradation in target-task performance. Our findings suggest that balancing the acquisition--retention trade-off depends not only on whether the model is anchored to its base behavior, but also on where and how strongly supervision should depart from that behavior.}

</details>


### [348] [Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00961)
*Jérémie Lumbroso*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出AI代码生成时代瓶颈已从"写代码"转向"监督写代码的系统"，由此暴露一个词汇缺口：领域内要求"人类监督"，却未区分语言在委托通道中的两种功能——协调行动（控制论式）与协调理解（认识论式）。作者提出治理判据：每个重大抉择都应附带"若条件改变结果将会不同"的可检验条件，并给出操作性测试（两部分重构检验）与记录约定（ORRCF）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着代码生成被越来越多地委托给AI系统，瓶颈从编写代码转向监督编写代码的系统，这使CS教育研究者开始为这一转变命名。该转变暴露了一个词汇缺口：领域要求"人类监督"，却没有可用的区分来标明语言在委托通道中承担的两种不同功能——协调行动（控制论意义：词语成功在于世界与之相符）与协调理解（认识论意义：词语成功在于它向世界负责且听者能核查这一点）。由此命名的失效并非控制论式语言本身，而是"认识论形式"的语言在做控制论的工作：为获得认可而非为真而校准的解释形态输出。仅检查输出是否被批准的监督可被橡皮图章式盖章满足；而要让智能体真正担责，其工作背后的推理必须可被检索与核查。

Method: 作者呈现三个委托片段作为示例（非受控证据），其中认识论参与被证明可行且仍可审计；另有一个公开记录中建议按其自身陈述的条件被撤回，以及一个失败案例，说明监督若不需要其自由裁量选择的理由会怎样。基于此，作者提出一条面向智能体系统治理的判据：在现有技术信任属性之外，每个重大抉择都应携带"在何种条件下它本会走向另一结果"，并以第三方可检验的形式给出。作者为该判据提供可操作形式——两部分重构检验，依据第二位读者能否预测智能体在扰动下的行为来给委托记录评分——并给出审议记录约定ORRCF，使该条件成为每条记录抉择的必需组成部分。

Result: 作者给出三组委托片段作为示例，显示认识论参与在实际中可行且保持可审计；给出一个建议依其自身陈述条件被撤回的公开记录；给出一个监督不要求自由裁量理由的失败案例。在此基础上提出治理判据，并形式化为两部分重构检验与ORRCF记录约定，使"条件"成为每条记录抉择的必需组件。

Conclusion: 若无此类条件，第三方无法区分一项决定与一次橡皮图章式盖章。作者主张在现有技术信任属性之外，把"每个重大抉择均携带可被第三方检验的反事实条件"作为智能体系统治理的补充判据，并通过两部分重构检验（评估第二位读者能否预测扰动下的行为）与ORRCF审议记录约定将其落地。

Abstract: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. We present three delegation episodes --- illustrations, not controlled evidence --- in which epistemic engagement proved practicable while remaining auditable, one public record where a recommendation was withdrawn on its own stated terms, and one failure case illustrating oversight that requires no reasons for its discretionary choices. We propose a criterion for agentic-system governance, alongside existing technical trust properties: every consequential choice should carry the condition under which it would have gone otherwise, in a form a third party can test. Without such a condition, a third party cannot distinguish a decision from a rubber stamp. We give the criterion an operational form --- a two-part reconstruction test scoring a delegation record by whether a second reader can predict what the agent does under a perturbation --- and a deliberation-recording convention, ORRCF, that makes the condition a required component of every recorded choice.

</details>


### [349] [VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00972)
*Caiqi Zhang,Rujun Han,Zifeng Wang,Zoey CuiZhu,Nigel Collier,Tomas Pfister,Chen-Yu Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 VeriHarness，将基础大模型转化为「智能体验证器」，通过工作区、证据工具与可复用验证技能，对多轮采样结果进行分歧消解与共识挑战，从而在无参考答案条件下提升长时程任务的验证与选择能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体承担越来越复杂、长时程的任务，其输出验证变得愈发困难；且测试时不提供参考答案或评分标准。重复采样虽可产生含互补正确主张的多个 rollout，但缺少可靠机制判断哪些主张可信。作者观察到：分歧常暴露正确替代方案，而共识可能掩盖错误，因此需要新的验证范式。

Method: VeriHarness 将生成器所用底层 LLM 转化为智能体验证器，为其配备工作区、证据工具与可复用验证技能。其中包含两个核心组件：（1）分歧消解器（disagreement resolver），针对竞争性主张与环境证据进行核对；（2）共识挑战器（consensus challenger），检验共享主张并搜索被遗漏的需求。二者发现的问题用于指导最终产物的选择与修订；此外验证技能可依据失败反馈自我改进。

Result: 在五个长时程工作区基准和两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness 在所评估基线中取得最高选择分数。基于证据的修订进一步提升平均性能：相比单次 rollout，Gemini 3.5 Flash 提升 6.2 分，Claude Opus 4.8 提升 6.4 分。作者还发布约 26,000 条 rollout 的完整数据集（覆盖五个基准与两个模型，成本超 10 万美元）以支持后续研究。

Conclusion: VeriHarness 是一种新颖且关键的长时程智能体验证方法，验证技能可由失败反馈自我进化，为规模化智能体验证提供了可行路径。

Abstract: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.

</details>


### [350] [RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00979)
*Jingtan Wang,Sirajul Salekin,Young mok Jung,Javier Movellan,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low,Manjot Bilkhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RISED将评分细则（rubric）从奖励信号扩展为多环境LLM智能体训练中的数据选择与策略监督工具，在多个环境上取得最高平均通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多环境联合训练通用LLM智能体时，现有课程与数据选择策略多在环境层面分配训练或依赖局部标量奖励，未显式考虑跨环境rollout之间的关系；且各环境学习速率不同，同一批次内会同时存在全失败与全成功组，导致这些数据缺乏组内相对奖励信号。这暴露了仅依赖标量奖励的局限：既缺乏跨环境关系信息，也在奖励相同的情况下没有组内对比信号。

Method: 提出RISED框架，将rubric从奖励用途重新定位为引导在线数据选择与策略监督。具体地：用LLM评判器依据跨环境共享的rubric词表为每条rollout打标签，生成行为画像；据此选择与混合环境批次整体行为构成一致、且与已选数据重叠有限的数据；正向rubric（描述期望行为）作为特权上下文提供给on-policy自蒸馏教师，提供额外的token级监督；负向rubric（描述非期望行为）则引导后续rollout生成远离反复出现的失败模式。

Result: 在不同模型骨干上，RISED在各环境的平均通过率最高，且在每一个单独环境中均排名第一或第二；基于rubric的分析可进一步刻画伴随这些提升而发生的行为变化。

Conclusion: 将rubric由单一奖励信号扩展为数据选择与策略监督的多用途文本反馈，可有效缓解多环境RL中跨环境关系缺失与组内奖励无对比的问题，从而提升通用智能体在多环境下的整体表现，并具备可解释的行为分析能力。

Abstract: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

</details>


### [351] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01000)
*Fan Huang,Minsuk Kim,C. Tyler Diggans,Filippo Radicchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了LLM作为概率生成器时输出的偏好分布，发现模型内部具有自洽性，但不同模型家族与规模之间存在显著不一致，暗示结果更多由模型选择而非提示词措辞决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用作仿真、合成数据生成和决策支持中的概率生成器，但其生成分布的结构与可靠性研究不足，尤其缺乏对"LLM能否替代调查受访者"这一假设的检验。

Method: 针对航空旅行、餐厅和消费品的偏好分布进行系统分析，覆盖九个开源权重模型与三个选择领域，并考察温度变化、贪心解码以及提示词与选项顺序扰动下的稳健性。

Result: 所有模型表现出自洽性，最可能结果在重复采样下迅速稳定；但模型家族与规模之间存在显著不一致，即使最可能结果也缺乏共识，且该模式在多种条件下保持稳健。

Conclusion: 结果更多受模型选择影响而非提示词措辞影响，挑战了"足够强大的LLM会产生相似偏好分布、可替代调查受访者"的常见假设。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as probabilistic generators for simulation, synthetic data generation, and decision support in settings where real-world data are unavailable. Yet, the structure and reliability of the distributions they produce remain understudied. Here, we systematically analyze LLM-generated distributions of preferences for air travel, restaurants, and consumer products. Encouragingly, all models considered in our analysis exhibit self-coherence, with the most probable outcomes stabilizing rapidly under repeated sampling. At the same time, we observe substantial discordance across both model families and scales, with little consensus even among their most probable outcomes. These patterns hold across nine open-weight models, three choice domains, and show robustness under temperature changes, greedy decoding, and perturbations of prompt and ordering. Our findings indicate that outcomes are influenced more by the choice of model than by the wording of the prompt, challenging the common assumption that sufficiently capable LLMs produce similar preference distributions when used as stand-ins for survey respondents.

</details>


### [352] [Calibration-risk routing for controlled world-model adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01001)
*Yifan Zhang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MC-WM方法，通过划分目标数据并依据标准化校准风险选择模型族，用置信信号与确定性有效性谓词加权想象策略更新，以缓解模拟器到目标的迁移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习可利用模拟经验，但模拟器到目标的偏移造成模型选择难题：在目标数据有限时，直接校正模拟器或直接拟合目标均可能失败。

Method: MC-WM将初始目标数据划分为互不相交的拟合、选择与校准三部分，选择标准化校准风险更低的模型族；并引入学习到的置信信号与确定性有效性谓词，对单步想象策略更新进行加权，而不改写物理奖励。

Result: 在三个受控MuJoCo偏移下评估了540个唯一报告运行单元；在一次预部署工件门控后重复了一个精确路由单元，共完成541次执行。

Conclusion: MC-WM通过数据分区、风险驱动的模型族选择与置信度加权更新，为有限目标数据下的模拟器到目标迁移提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can exploit simulated experience, but a simulator-to-target shift creates a model-selection problem: correcting the simulator and fitting the target directly can each fail under limited target data. We introduce the Model-Corrected World Model (MC-WM), which separates initial target data into disjoint fit, selection, and calibration partitions and deploys the family with lower standardized calibration risk. A learned confidence signal and deterministic validity predicates weight one-step imagined policy updates without rewriting physical rewards. We evaluate 540 unique reported run cells across three controlled Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) shifts; one exact-routing cell was repeated after a pre-deployment artifact gate, giving 541 completed executions.

</details>


### [353] [What Can Analogy Tell Us About Artificial Consciousness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01002)
*Keith J. Holyoak,Martin M. Monti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个因果框架用于评估"意识类比推断"的证据强度，区分生成意识的因果因素相似性与下游行为/认知效应相似性，并据此论证当代AI的行为相似性只能为意识提供有限证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观体验只能以第一人称直接通达，因此对其他实体（历史上主要是非人动物，如今扩展到AI）是否具有意识的判断部分依赖类比推理。既有推断方式缺乏对类比证据强度的系统刻画，尤其在AI情境下亟需明确"何种相似性才是有效证据"。

Method: 构建一个因果框架来评估此类证据类比。核心区分在于：一是与意识生成相关因素的相似性，二是下游行为或认知效应的相似性。该框架以因果相关性对源—目标相似性进行加权，同时容许未知原因、失效性差异（disabling differences）以及通往意识的替代路径的存在。

Result: 应用于生物系统时，该框架解释了为何类比支持通常随与人类的因果距离增大而减弱；应用于当代AI时，表明行为相似性只能为意识提供有限证据，因为相关的因果对应关系仍未被充分确立。

Conclusion: 该框架同时澄清了哪些证据能够增强人工意识主张，为AI意识议题提供了可操作的证据评估标准。

Abstract: Who or what is conscious? Because subjective experience is directly accessible only in the first person, judgments about consciousness in other entities depend partly on analogy. Historically, such inferences have focused on nonhuman animals, but advances in artificial intelligence have raised the possibility of conscious AI. Here we develop a causal framework for evaluating such evidential analogies. The key distinction is between similarities in factors plausibly involved in generating consciousness and similarities in downstream behavioural or cognitive effects. Our framework weights source-target similarity by causal relevance while allowing for unknown causes, disabling differences and alternative routes to consciousness. Applied to biological systems, it explains why analogical support generally weakens with increasing causal distance from humans. Applied to contemporary AI, it suggests that behavioural similarity provides only limited evidence for consciousness because relevant causal correspondences remain poorly established. The framework also clarifies what evidence would strengthen claims of artificial consciousness.

</details>


### [354] [Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01006)
*Sharath M Shankaranarayana,Davor Runje,Jan Jannink*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计决策模型 Jev 的置信度校准，发现其置信度在熟悉封闭选择题上校准良好，但无法区分"运气"与"知识缺失"；模型在缺乏答案相关信息时仍给出高置信，越过知识边界后置信度高出准确率 0.21–0.33，且重校准无法弥补。定向是非问题可更清晰读出"结果是否已定"（AUROC 1.00）与"证据是否充分"（0.95），但"是否知道答案"的探针易受表面线索干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型输出的概率常用于路由、弃答与自动执行，校准只保证平均意义上可用，却无法说明低置信度源于随机性还是知识缺失，也无法说明模型在超出已知范围时置信度是否下降。作者希望在固定条目、变化信息量的受控设定下，审计"置信度校准"与"知识边界感知"之间的区别。

Method: 在决策模型 Jev 上开展审计，使用 15 个以上公开数据集与 6 个生成式任务族，并设计配对干预：对同一条目改变所提供的信息。比较置信度指标与准确率、重校准效果，并引入定向是非问题探针（结果是否已定、证据是否充分、模型是否知道答案），通过 AUROC 评估其判别能力，同时考察真实人名与去除日期等表面线索的影响。

Result: Jev 的置信度在熟悉的封闭选择题上校准良好，但不能指示知识缺失：在无答案相关信息时对显著选项赋值高达 0.80；在超出观察到的知识边界的新闻上，置信度超出准确率 0.21–0.33，且用早期月份重校准无法消除该差距。定向是非问题读数更锐利：判断结果是否已定 AUROC 1.00，判断证据是否充分 0.95（同一批条目上置信度仅 0.85）。"模型是否知道答案"的探针能标记虚构实体与边界后新闻（0.91），但在使用真实人名或去除日期时相对答案不确定性无优势。

Conclusion: 校准后的置信度不等于知识边界感知。黑箱知识审计必须显式控制表面线索，否则探针优势可能来自表层特征而非真实的知识缺失信号；定向是非问题可作为更可靠的读出手段，但其稳健性依赖于线索控制。

Abstract: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

</details>


### [355] [From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01014)
*Shaoang Li,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将多数投票式测试时扩展建模为"发现—决策"缺口问题，通过已实现投票状态与剩余调用预算刻画可恢复性阈值、候选转换窗口与锁存证书，并给出精确有限时域端点概率；实验显示输入置换使原始多数投票准确率提升21.1点，精确锁存可在16次调用预算下节省28–30%调用而不改变任何固定预算输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多响应投票是测试时扩展与集成推理的常用原语，增加采样可扩大候选池、提高发现正确答案的概率。但在固定调用预算下，被发现的答案还需在剩余调用中积累足够支持才能成为最终多数获胜者，由此形成"发现到决策"的缺口（discovery-to-decision gap）。作者旨在刻画这一缺口，并给出可恢复性条件与节省预算的方法。

Method: 以已实现投票状态和剩余调用预算为状态量进行理论分析：推导尖锐的可恢复性阈值；证明随采样推进，已观测候选集只能扩张而可达终点获胜者集合只能收缩，从而形成候选级转换窗口；在给定独立同分布响应律下给出同一状态的精确有限时域端点概率；分析错误答案身份合并对单次正确性与多数准确率的影响；提出单例可达性给出的无金标准精确锁存证书，并定义已知答案宇宙下锁存首次触发为所有可容许延续得到相同固定预算输出的最早前缀。实证上考察发现但未被选中的正确答案的可达性丧失时机，并用受控Word16研究验证。

Result: 大多数"已发现但未被选中"的正确答案仅在发现之后才丧失可达性；在受控Word16研究中，输入置换使原始多数投票准确率提升21.1个百分点，而单次调用正确率基本不变；精确锁存在16次调用预算下节省28–30%的调用，同时保持所有固定预算输出不变。

Conclusion: 该工作将多数投票的测试时扩展统一为基于投票状态与剩余预算的可达性/转换分析，给出阈值、端点概率与锁存证书，并证明错误答案概率重分配的效果依赖于实际投票状态；实践上可通过输入置换提升多数准确率、通过精确锁存在不改变输出前提下显著减少调用次数。

Abstract: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

</details>


### [356] [Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01017)
*Xuehang Guo,Haoyu Wang,Shengyu Chen,Zach Chen,Wei Cheng,Qingyun Wang,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 InFlowOp，以无标签代价统一衡量智能体能力与运行开销，双向决定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，并在执行中做最廉价纠错，配套基准 Braid，性能较单智能体基线最高提升 11.97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体工作流构建困难：任务分解粒度、子任务与智能体的匹配、何时新建专家等关键决策需事前确定，而子任务成败只有运行后才可知；改进工作流代价高，故障定位依赖参考答案、打分结果或训练好的评估器，修复又需整体重执行、重搜索或重训练。

Method: InFlowOp 将所有决策统一映射为一种无标签代价，该代价综合智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度以及智能体运行开销。执行前，依据该代价双向确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，而非依赖固定模板；执行中，用同一代价以最廉价动作纠正故障，使该代价同时服务于工作流的构建与运行。针对工作流级评测难题，提出基准 Braid，其任务需多智能体协作才能完成。

Result: 在多种领域与骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相较单智能体基线最高提升 +11.97%，其中在流式优化下取得 +9.64%。

Conclusion: 以统一的无标签代价驱动工作流的构建与运行期修复，可在无需参考答案与额外训练的情况下有效提升多智能体工作流性能，并提供了面向多智能体协作的评测基准。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

</details>


### [357] [Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01995)
*Alessandro Chiesa,Ziyi Guan,Burcu Yildiz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究预言机辅助计算的零知识交互论证：一般情形下不可实现（随机预言机模型中不存在对所有此类计算的零知识证明，且该不可能性延伸至辩论模型）；若预言机对每个回答附加密码学签名，则可在仅假设抗碰撞哈希函数下实现高效证明者与验证者的零知识验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统常基于机密数据（如病历、药物分子结构）产生输出，需在验证输出正确性的同时不泄露底层数据。已有关于预言机辅助计算（正确性依赖人类判断、物理实验或网络等预言机）的交互证明与辩论研究聚焦于"验证者远快于计算"的高效验证，但一般情形下这种高效验证不可能，故依赖额外假设。本文转而关注隐私：在允许验证者运行时间为计算的多项式级别的前提下，探讨此类交互论证能否做到零知识。

Method: 作者在随机预言机模型下给出一般性不可能性证明：即使证明者与验证者运行时间远超计算本身，也不存在覆盖所有预言机辅助计算的零知识证明，且该结论延伸至辩论（debate）这一可扩展监督的典型模型。在正面方向，作者构造协议：令预言机对其每个回答附加密码学签名，从而在仅假设抗碰撞哈希函数的前提下，实现所有预言机辅助计算的零知识验证，且证明者与验证者均高效。

Result: 负面结果：随机预言机模型中不存在覆盖全部预言机辅助计算的零知识证明，即便双方运行时间可远大于计算，不可能性亦适用于辩论模型。正面结果：若预言机对回答附加密码学签名，则每一预言机辅助计算均可在零知识下验证，证明者与验证者高效，仅需抗碰撞哈希函数假设。

Conclusion: 预言机辅助计算的零知识验证在一般情况下不可行，但预言机回答的密码学签名可将之转为可行。该方案除保障隐私外，还提供了一条不依赖辩论中的诚实对手、也不依赖先前单证明者协议的鲁棒性的可扩展监督新路径。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output.
  We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight.
  On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.

</details>


### [358] [Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01042)
*Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Peiyu Zhang,Anzhe Cheng,Heng Ping,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出受控框架ICR，将多智能体通信评估从单一准确率转向"修正/保持"的选择性行为分析，揭示通信增益与损害的来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体通信评估常在被设计好的系统内进行，导致通信效果、智能体架构与额外推理能力三者混淆；最终准确率又把"纠正的错误"与"被污染的正确答案"合并为单一指标，无法反映通信如何改变决策。

Method: 构建Independent-Communicate-Revise（ICR）受控框架：先固定各智能体的独立推理轨迹，再引入通信阶段，把通信效果定义为"答案修正"；在两名智能体初始正确性条件下分别度量修正率与保持率，并设置无消息的修订对照（revision control）以剥离额外推理带来的收益；在四个推理基准上审计文本与潜空间通信，并在MedQA与GPQA-D上比较不同接收方策略（如结构化验证策略）。

Result: 四个基准上，相近的总体准确率可能掩盖差异极大的修正行为；与仅传递答案相比，传递完整推理在所有四个基准上都提高修正率、降低保持率，即更丰富的消息同时放大有益与有害影响。MedQA和GPQA-D上的接收方策略比较显示，结构化验证策略使各信道均转向更高保持、更低修正，而其选择性效果因信道与任务而异。

Conclusion: 通信质量并非信道的固有属性，而由消息内容与接收方策略共同决定；ICR将评估重心转向选择性修正，提供统一框架以分析收益与损害的联合产生机制。

Abstract: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

</details>


### [359] [Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02074)
*Abid Mohamed Nadhir,Ahmad Al Hanbali,Beggas Mounir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出同态优势算子（HAO），通过将零均值中心化投影应用于时序差分目标，抑制FHE深度强化学习中多项式近似因贝尔曼漂移导致的发散，并在表格MDP、加密CartPole及物流路由基准上验证其稳定性与精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端智能系统常需处理机密数据，全同态加密（FHE）可实现保密计算，但将其用于强化学习时必须用多项式近似替代非线性操作，而递归误差引发的贝尔曼漂移会导致近似灾难性发散。现有仅靠正则化（L2权重衰减、梯度裁剪）难以稳定该过程，因此需要一个能从根本上消除漂移来源的稳定化框架。

Method: 提出同态优势算子（HAO）：将基于优势价值估计中的零均值中心化投影直接适配到时序差分（TD）目标上。该线性投影消除驱动贝尔曼漂移的均匀状态价值基线，同时保持每个状态的动作排序，且不增加额外的非线性乘法深度、无需昂贵的密文自举（bootstrapping）。实验采用三层方法：表格MDP、使用真实CKKS密码学操作的加密CartPole环境，以及具有密集连续特征的20节点物流路由基准。

Result: HAO严格将网络预激活值限制在安全的多项式近似域内。所有随机种子下HAO智能体的边界越界率为0%；仅使用正则化（L2权重衰减与梯度裁剪）在5个种子中有3个越界，未稳定化基线在83.8%的回合中越界。HAO在表格域中将最优策略准确率提升18.0个百分点，并在裁剪梯度上加入DP-SGD风格高斯噪声时仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: HAO通过线性中心化投影有效防止FHE深度强化学习中的多项式近似发散，在不增加乘法深度与自举开销的前提下实现严格有界稳定，并在多种任务与噪声条件下保持高性能，为隐私保护强化学习的云端部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.

</details>


### [360] [Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01045)
*Jiaqi Tang,Lan Wei,Bingyu Shen,Boyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"空承诺"(empty commitment)概念：智能体承诺当前轮次之后的行动，但其工具或运行时不具备执行能力，其落空仅由配置本身决定，无需后续轨迹即可判定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人常做出"明天提醒你"之类承诺，但除非用户再次发消息，否则不会再次运行，这类承诺在配置层面就无法兑现，与"食言"不同，现有工作缺乏对其的定义与测量手段。

Method: 在承诺语义(commitment semantics)之上定义空承诺，包含三种失败类型、用于判定工具可实现的承诺的锚定条件(anchoring condition)，以及响应层面的结果分类体系；并提出测量协议：在五种逐步添加一种持久化能力(persistence affordance)的设置中执行后续请求，环境可隐式或显式陈述。

Result: 该文给出空承诺的形式化定义、失败类型划分、锚定条件与响应级结果分类，并设计了逐项叠加持久化能力、环境隐式/显式两种呈现方式的五组后续请求测量方案。

Conclusion: 空承诺可仅凭智能体配置判定，区别于需依赖后续轨迹的食言；所提界定与测量协议为评估智能体承诺可兑现性提供了可操作框架。

Abstract: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

</details>


### [361] [Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01080)
*Shaohuai Liu,Yuning Wu,Haoran Liu,Enzo Jia,Devin Chen,Kai Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 APIVIS 训练框架，将有限预算 Gumbel 搜索适配到片段级数学推理，通过组内混合直接与搜索响应并选择性监督搜索改进 token，提升 RLVR 数学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 已显著提升大模型数学推理能力，近期工作将搜索引入 RLVR rollout 以增加轨迹多样性，但多样性本身并不能保证搜索诱导的 rollout 策略优于当前策略。

Method: APIVIS 将有限预算 Gumbel 搜索适配到 chunk 级数学推理；在每个 rollout 组内混合直接响应与搜索响应，使搜索带来的改进产生有信息量的相对奖励；并对搜索改进的 token 施加选择性监督，在组内奖励一致导致 GRPO 失效时保留学习信号。

Result: 理论证明精确值引导选择在每个搜索状态下提升期望验证器奖励，并将该保证扩展到完整 rollout 策略，在有界值估计误差下给出近似保证；在主流数学推理基准和不同模型规模上，显著优于有竞争力的搜索类方法。

Conclusion: APIVIS 通过将搜索改进转化为可学习的相对奖励信号，弥补了搜索多样性与策略改进之间的差距，验证了其在数学推理任务上的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

</details>


### [362] [YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01097)
*Yoonkyu Woo,Woojin Lee,Jin-Xia Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: YouRA是一种面向自主科研的有状态、证据可溯源架构，通过验证状态架构、独立控制器和有状态反思三大组件，在长程研究流水线中维持研究状态、执行证据与失败历史，从而缩小论文声称与实际实验之间的差距。在MLR-Bench十任务端到端子集上，YouRA在三种匹配骨干网络上均优于MLR-Agent与AI Scientist V2，消融实验验证了各组件的独立贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端科研智能体已能产出完整科学论文，但稿件声称常与已执行实验相偏离。该问题的根源是结构性的：研究状态、失败历史与声称—证据对齐在长程流水线中未作为持久、可验证的状态加以维护。因此需要一种有状态、证据可溯源的自主科研架构。

Method: 提出YouRA架构，整合三个组件：(1) 验证状态架构（VSA），追踪假设、门控与证据指针；(2) 独立控制器，将状态与反思记录转化为生命周期、恢复与辩论/评审控制，实现控制与执行分离；(3) 有状态反思，将失败记录为结构化经验教训，并通过有界修复、重新设计或重置来路由恢复。同时支持MCP工具访问与反思引导恢复。

Result: 在MLR-Bench预定义的十任务端到端子集上，YouRA在三种匹配骨干网络上于标量Overall指标均优于MLR-Agent和AI Scientist V2。基于MLR-Bench幻觉分类法的自动诊断报告了四类基于事实的失败类型的交集/并集计数；数据溯源诊断显示更多基于真实数据的输出。对四个组件（VSA、独立控制器、MCP工具访问、反思引导恢复）的消融支持其可分离贡献。

Conclusion: 移除任一核心状态组件都会使YouRA性能低于完整系统，表明验证状态架构与独立控制器等组件对系统有效性不可或缺。YouRA通过持久化研究状态、执行证据与失败历史，实现了可验证、可溯源的自主科研，缓解了声称与实验证据的结构性偏离问题。

Abstract: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

</details>


### [363] [Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01116)
*Lachlan McGinness,Dan Pagendam,Robert Offner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对LLM环境足迹缺乏标准化碳核算的问题，调研NeurIPS 2025全部5,285篇论文发现环境影响报告几乎缺失，进而提出标准化可持续性指标、推理碳成本估算启发式方法及开源工具carbonbenchmark，并形式化"SMAJ"框架以平衡精度与环境成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型能力增强和广泛应用，其环境足迹不断扩大；尽管学界呼吁负责任AI，但机器学习社区缺乏标准化的碳核算实践，且现有研究普遍忽视环境影响报告。

Method: 对NeurIPS 2025接收的5,285篇论文进行自动化文献综述；定义标准化的可持续性指标以评估模型训练效率；提出估算LLM推理碳成本的简单启发式方法；将这些指标实现为即插即用软件carbonbenchmark；并形式化"SMAJ"（Smallest Model that Achieves the Job）框架。

Result: 自动化文献综述显示，NeurIPS 2025接收论文中环境影响报告几乎不存在；提出的指标与启发式方法可在carbonbenchmark工具中实现，用于追踪和报告排放。

Conclusion: 该工作旨在推动AI可持续发展转型，通过标准化碳核算工具和SMAJ框架，呼吁研究界在追求传统SotA精度的同时，优先考虑计算效率与环境责任，避免以不成比例的环境成本换取边际精度提升。

Abstract: As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions.
  Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.

</details>


### [364] [AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01119)
*Zhicheng Feng,Yubo Zhao,Xuefeng Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AbsorbEvo是一个智能体框架，可将自然语言性能目标转化为经全波仿真验证的微波吸收体设计，在AbsorbBench-36上任务成功率达79.17%，显著优于通用智能体（25.00%）和随机搜索（12.50%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能微波吸收体设计需要电磁理论、材料科学与仿真编程的交叉专业知识，且优化过程耗时。现有设计流程依赖人工专家经验，缺乏将自然语言性能目标自动转化为可行设计的方法。

Method: 提出AbsorbEvo自主逆向设计智能体框架。其候选进化策略融合语言推理、物理预测与历史反馈：大语言模型根据任务目标与计算历史提出参数调整的方向与幅度；系统结合定向增量与全局采样生成候选；以低成本预测模型作为物理先验对候选排序，仅对高排名设计执行全波仿真；通过物理有效性校验的结果用于性能评估并指导后续搜索。训练任务经验被蒸馏为文本技能，经独立验证后用于新任务。

Result: 在相同提案预算下，于留出的AbsorbBench-36任务上，AbsorbEvo任务成功率为79.17%，通用智能体为25.00%，随机搜索为12.50%；平均最优覆盖率为0.7816，后两者分别为0.6434和0.6448。

Conclusion: AbsorbEvo将语言推理与物理反馈整合进设计决策，为自然语言驱动的微波吸收体自主逆向设计提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

</details>


### [365] [CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01124)
*Jiazhen Hong,Xiaotian Zhou,Zihao Ding,Kailong Wang,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CortexBridge，一种轻量适配器，将脑电特征与电极及图谱坐标结合，把任意导联布局映射到共享皮层潜空间，在三个冻结基础模型和五个 MOABB 数据集上 15 项评估中 13 项取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG 基础模型通常以固定通道词表或有限导联组合预训练，当电极布局变化时迁移困难，缺乏处理异构 montage 的机制。

Method: CortexBridge 是一个轻量适配器，融合 EEG 特征与电极坐标、图谱（atlas）坐标，将任意 montage 路由到统一的皮层潜空间；在冻结基础模型（EEGPT、LaBraM、CBraMod）上评估，使用 MOABB 的五个 BCI 数据集。

Result: 15 项评估中 13 项性能提升；平衡准确率平均提升 EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%，12 类 SSVEP 分类最大提升 13.02%；学得的图谱表征呈现任务依赖的空间模式，SSVEP 在 Yeo 视觉网络中比听觉 P300 更集中。

Conclusion: 皮层对齐可作为一种可学习且具解剖基础的 routing 机制，将异构 EEG montage 接入预训练基础模型。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

</details>


### [366] [Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01128)
*Aditya Dubey,Namah Gupta,Vinti Agarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将指令微调语言模型置于六个DSGE模拟器中，以PPO为主、GRPO为无critic基线，检验其政策行动是否符合经济动态而非仅语言通顺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成听起来合理的政策回应，但语言合理性不等于行动符合经济动态，需要可验证的仿真环境来判别。

Method: 构建统一Python接口，支持重复rollout、持续冲击、状态克隆与滚动视界模拟；模型每回合观察经济状态与话语变化，选择有界政策行动并获得新状态与经济奖励；采用PPO（学习价值函数、GAE传播延迟奖励）为主方法，GRPO（组相对优势、无价值函数）作为匹配的无critic基线；实验涵盖方向性语义信号、奖励视界、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移及历史锚定的疫情与货币政策冲击。

Result: 该设定构成长期信用分配问题：政策效果可能在数季度后显现。PPO可借助学习价值函数与广义优势估计将延迟奖励回传至较早token；GRPO无学习价值函数，仅依据完整轨迹回报分配组相对优势，无法区分是哪一较早回合导致结果，若所有rollout回报相同则归一化优势为零。

Conclusion: 应以模拟经济后果而非语言合理性来评判政策行动；PPO在长视界信用分配上更适配，GRPO作为无critic对照凸显其局限。

Abstract: Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

</details>


### [367] [Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01138)
*Haotian Chen,Bowen Ye,Yuning Zhang,Jingkun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文为LLM智能体环境实现类型化快照-结算合约，审计顺序敏感性、有效进展与重放一致性三类性质，并通过大规模排列试验与多步回合验证五种结算策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体环境中并发动作即使各自合法也可能冲突，需要仲裁机制；现有工作缺乏对执行语义（顺序敏感性、进展效率、重放一致性）的系统审计。

Method: 实现类型化快照-结算合约；在28,800次穷举排列试验与2,160个脚本化多步回合中测试五种结算策略；另以全状态日志审计重放一致性，含156个检查点与1,332个构造性破坏样本。

Result: 联合策略在固定优先级下具有空间顺序不变性；保守拒绝在六智能体门口任务中仅完成31.25%，而随机票据达90.28%，配对提升59.03个百分点（95% bootstrap区间50.00–68.06）。所有策略均保持测试的空间约束，但优先级仲裁仍达不到独立小实例最优。日志审计精确重放156个检查点并拒绝1,332个破坏，保留终止锚点。

Conclusion: 证据针对执行语义而非人类真实性或长期公平性；快照-结算合约能保证重放一致性与空间约束，但仲裁策略在进展效率与最优性上仍有改进空间。

Abstract: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

</details>


### [368] [ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01140)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Xi Zhu,Weizhi Zhang,Minghao Guo,Ye Li,Hamid Palangi,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReSolve：一种免训练推理流程，通过选择性生成式审核复用候选推理，在竞赛数学题上以更少 token 达到更高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多解采样会将大量计算浪费在中间推导和未完成的论证上。作者希望把候选推理本身视为可复用的推理计算资源，而非仅取最终答案。

Method: 提出 ReSolve 免训练推理流程：由答案分布控制器在候选答案不一致或无法解析时调用模型审查已有推导，并把生成的新解纳入有界循环；采用 Hybrid 评分进行聚合。

Result: 在 130 道竞赛数学题、两个独立采样池上，ReSolve 分别答对 100 和 99 题，优于同四候选投票的 91 和 92，且无正确转错误；相比八样本自一致性（94、96），token 消耗分别减少 46.3% 和 47.2%。消融实验去掉可见推导后准确率由 100 降至 93；选择性审核较始终开启审核节省约 54% 审核 token、6.2% 总 token。

Conclusion: 结果表明候选推理可作为可复用的推理计算；但未证明其相对额外采样具有准确率优势，也未证明专门路由指令带来独立收益。

Abstract: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers.
