Experiments on image benchmarks and medical datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art heuristics in low-budget settings.

</details>


### [603] [Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01204)
*Yihao Ding,Daniel Yitian Su,Yiran Zhang,Christopher M. Gonzalez,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DrillBench——一个包含 49,671 个西澳钻孔的基准，用于下一层岩性预测与自回归地层生成，并揭示空间条件模型的"迁移边界"，进而提出结合大规模预训练与空间检索的通用方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归建模在语言与序列任务中成效显著，而钻孔随钻进过程由浅至深逐层揭示岩性，天然契合自回归预测范式。但现有钻孔建模多聚焦空间插值与重建或掩码建模，严格的因果式自回归预测研究不足，且缺乏系统性评测基准。

Method: 构建 DrillBench 基准（49,671 个西澳钻孔），设定下一层预测与自回归地层生成任务，并按由易到难的分级迁移谱（局部预测→空间偏移→跨地质省迁移）评测。对经典、地统计与神经模型进行基准测试，在此基础上提出骨干无关的训练方案：历史钻孔大规模预训练 + 邻域岩性空间检索。

Result: 基准测试暴露出明显的"迁移边界"：空间与地球化学条件在局部带来大幅提升，但在更强分布偏移下急剧退化；而岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳健。检索在风化覆盖层中最为有效（局部空间连续性仍具信息量），预训练则在基岩及更大范围地质偏移下贡献更大。二者结合在保持局部性能的同时提升空间与跨省迁移泛化，且在距离最远的划分上增益最显著。

Conclusion: 钻孔岩性预测应区分局部内插能力与分布偏移下的泛化能力；空间检索与大规模预训练具有互补性，按地质条件自适应组合可兼顾局部精度与跨区迁移，为地质自回归建模提供可复现的基准与思路。

Abstract: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer boundary}: spatial and geochemical conditioning provides large local gains but deteriorates sharply under stronger shift, whereas lithology-sequence autoregressive models transfer more robustly. Guided by this finding, we develop a backbone-agnostic recipe combining large-scale pretraining on historical drillholes with spatial retrieval of neighbouring lithology. Retrieval is most effective in weathered cover, when local spatial continuity remains informative, whereas pretraining contributes more strongly in bedrock and under broader geological shift. Together, they retain strong local performance while improving generalisation under spatial and cross-province shift, most markedly on the most distant splits. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/yihaoding/drillbench.

</details>


### [604] [Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01821)
*Tido Specht,Elias Benedict Krey,Nils Neukirch,Nils Strodthoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将非线性多维概念发现（NLMCD）引入LLM token级激活分析，以低维流形建模概念，并提出概念对齐（CBA）分数，跨层跨模型比较概念几何，得到六项关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性方法多依赖强线性假设，但证据表明概念特征存在于非线性流形上，线性方法会掩盖真实几何结构，因此需要超越线性概念的分析框架。

Method: 将计算机视觉中的非线性多维概念发现（NLMCD）适配到LLM token级激活，将概念建模为低维流形；提出基于概念的对齐分数（CBA），即无需显式特征匹配、度量几何邻近性的广义Rand指数。

Result: (i) CBA在相邻层检验中比PCA、CKA线性基线更敏感；(ii) 逐层对齐矩阵揭示中层与后层的两个块结构，跨模型一致且被线性指标掩盖；(iii) 概念构成在网络大部分层由句法主导，后层转为句法-语义混合并增强输出导向；(iv) 英汉多语概念共享依赖训练而非普适，Qwen最强、Llama较弱、GPT-2缺失；(v) 跨模型对齐呈同族Qwen（不同规模）强对应、跨族弱对齐；(vi) Tulu-3训练阶段中相邻阶段对齐最高，base到SFT变化最大，DPO/RLVR基本不改变早期层，RLVR在后层大多保留DPO概念。

Conclusion: 非线性流形视角与CBA能揭示线性方法遗漏的层级概念组织、语言共享与训练阶段演化规律，为LLM内部表征的机制可解释性提供了更几何化的分析工具。

Abstract: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

</details>


### [605] [Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01223)
*David Berghaus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出用大语言模型作为“研究代理”，通过自主循环编辑简短NumPy程序，搜索出两个紧凑的时间序列异常检测器（单变量与多变量），在TSB-AD基准上全面领先，无需训练网络或GPU，兼顾准确、高效与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测需在预测准确性、计算效率与可解释性之间取得权衡，现有方法（经典、深度、基础模型基线）难以同时兼顾，因此需要探索能平衡三者的新范式。

Method: 将LLM不作为检测器本身，而是作为检测器的作者：设计一个自主研究循环，模型在无泄漏目标函数下反复编辑单个短小的NumPy程序，并保留评分最优的检测器。该循环最终发现两个紧凑检测器（分别针对单变量与多变量序列），其思路是用局部频谱特征描述短窗口，并通过协方差感知距离与训练区间分布比较。

Result: 在TSB-AD基准上，这两个检测器在多项指标上领先，超越最强的经典、深度及基础模型基线（包括Time-RCD）；且不训练任何网络、不使用GPU，其中多变量检测器比所有性能相近的基线更快。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的程序搜索是获得准确、高效且透明的时间序列异常检测器的可行途径。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

</details>


### [606] [Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01889)
*Yohan Chatelain,Pablo de Oliveira Castro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究低精度Transformer推理中随机舍入（SR）与就近舍入（RN）的选择问题，指出最优舍入规则依赖于网络中的具体位置：MLP应使用SR，LM head应使用RN，混合配置可将困惑度降低28%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度Transformer推理中舍入规则（SR vs RN）的优劣尚无定论，本文旨在揭示该选择在网络不同操作位点上的差异化效应，并解释其机理。

Method: 固定数值格式、仅改变各操作位点的舍入规则进行隔离实验；将PRISM向量化舍入库扩展为可变精度随机舍入（VPSR）算法以支持任意虚拟精度；提出两项分析：(1)线性投影的概率前向误差界，(2)softmax输出处交叉熵期望变化的二阶分解（符号漂移、漂移曲率、Fisher加权方差惩罚）。

Result: 在DistilGPT-2、t=6位有效位下，MLP中使用SR使困惑度为全精度参考的1.15倍，而RN为2.21倍；在LM head处顺序反转，因SR引入非均匀方差而RN无。混合精度配置（MLP输出t=6，MLP用SR、head用RN）使困惑度降至全精度参考的1.10倍，较匹配位RN降低28%。

Conclusion: 舍入规则的优劣是位点依赖的：MLP噪声近似uniform logit偏移，softmax对其不变，SR的方差被大部分折扣；head噪声在词表上非均匀，故RN更优。混合分配SR与RN可显著提升低精度Transformer推理性能。

Abstract: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point.
  We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not.
  On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.

</details>


### [607] [Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01238)
*SeongHyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Seungyoo Lee,Jiyeon Ham,Yunju Bak,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)：让各分支在"目标偏置的数据混合"上训练以提升权重空间兼容性，再用合并模型评测作为低成本选择信号并迭代优化，结合 qNEHVI 多目标贝叶斯优化，在代码、数学、指令遵循与 think/non-think 控制上优于朴素合并。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一语言模型需在单一参数集中整合数学、代码、指令遵循与可控思考等异构能力。顺序后训练会把所有目标纠缠进同一条优化轨迹，导致最终模型对训练顺序、数据配比、调度与停止准则高度敏感；而权重空间合并虽模块化，但直接合并单目标专家往往失败：领域能力急剧退化，或 think/non-think 模式坍缩为单一主导行为。

Method: 作者将上述失败归因于权重空间几何不兼容：单目标专家的参数漂移到相距较远的区域，其插值落在任何共享低损失盆地之外。为此提出 MTM：每个分支在目标偏置的数据混合上训练（而非单一目标），使其暴露于跨目标交互，从而在合并时保持兼容。MTM 以合并模型的评测结果作为低成本信号来选择分支混合配比，避免昂贵的数据混合消融。流程为迭代式：每轮用全局选定的合并系数提升基座模型，并在保持其他目标的约束下，用各领域偏好的系数精炼分支混合。为突破单纯形网格搜索的规模限制，MTM 采用基于 qNEHVI 的多目标贝叶斯优化。

Result: 在代码、数学、指令遵循以及 think/non-think 控制任务上，MTM 优于朴素合并，并在单目标合并会坍缩的情形下仍保持行为分离性。

Conclusion: 有效统一模型要求各分支被训练为"可合并的"（mergeable），即通过目标偏置数据混合与基于合并评测的迭代优化，使不同能力专家落入共享低损失盆地，从而兼顾多能力整合与行为分离。

Abstract: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. We propose Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on an objective-biased data mixture rather than a single objective, exposing it to cross-objective interactions and making branches compatible at merge time. MTM uses merged-model evaluations as a low-cost signal for selecting branch mixtures, avoiding expensive data-mixture ablations. The procedure is iterative: each round promotes the base model using globally selected merge coefficients and refines each branch mixture using domain-preferred coefficients under constraints that preserve other objectives. To scale beyond simplex grid search, MTM uses qNEHVI-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across code, mathematics, instruction following, and think/non-think control, MTM outperforms naive merging and preserves behavioral separation where single-objective merging collapses, suggesting that effective unified models require branches trained to be mergeable.

</details>


### [608] [Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01947)
*Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Xuemin Chen,Xiaozhuang Song,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Latent JEPA 框架，将自回归学习与联合嵌入预测结合，让连续隐思维在不显式表述中间步骤的情况下预测未来解的有用信息，在 ChemCoTBench 的分子优化与编辑、反应指标上取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学推理既需要化学知识也需要多步问题求解。化学直觉能在求解细节完全展开之前给出对可能结果的初步判断。受这种"预期"与显式分析互补的启发，作者希望让连续隐思维在不逐字表述每一步的情况下，去预测未来解中具有信息量的方面。

Method: 提出 Latent JEPA：将自回归学习与对一个或多个未来视图的联合嵌入预测（joint-embedding prediction）结合。针对化学推理，设计了文本预测目标与分子预测目标，把隐思维同时与后续推理过程和分子结果相连接。

Result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上，分子优化任务以及若干编辑与反应指标均有提升。表征分析表明，未来预测使隐思维对分子结果更具信息量，并增强其与化学结构的对应关系。

Conclusion: 抽象的"未来预测"可作为学习原则，用于把连续隐推理与科学结果相连接，为化学等科学领域的隐空间推理提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.

</details>


### [609] [Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01253)
*Bisma Majid,Shabir Ahmed Sofi,Mir Mohammad Yousuf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出APGEM自适应策略引导误差缓解框架，在量子强化学习训练循环中动态选择误差缓解策略，在CVRP任务上显著优于静态缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子强化学习（QRL）在NISQ设备上受退相干、门误差与测量误差影响，策略质量下降、学习可靠性降低；现有误差缓解技术多为固定修正，无法适应变化的噪声条件与训练过程演变。

Method: APGEM作为混合量子-经典训练循环的上下文感知编排层，基于策略级指标（量子态保真度、策略熵、累计奖励、近似比）评估ZNE、PEC、CDR与REM四种误差缓解策略，并将所选策略直接集成到强化学习循环中，实现动态选择。

Result: 在CVRP（NP-hard城市物流问题）及多种NISQ噪声模型与噪声水平下，APGEM持续优于传统静态缓解方法，达到约94%的oracle策略效用，噪声增大时保持更高的量子态保真度，训练行为更稳定；消融实验表明框架学到了适应不同噪声环境与电路执行条件的上下文感知缓解策略。

Conclusion: 将自适应误差缓解集成进学习过程，可显著提升QRL在NISQ硬件上的鲁棒性与可靠性。

Abstract: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. APGEM evaluates Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) using policy-level indicators, including quantum-state fidelity, policy entropy, cumulative reward, and approximation ratio, and integrates the selected strategy directly into the reinforcement learning loop. The framework is evaluated on the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a representative NP-hard problem in urban logistics, under a range of NISQ noise models and noise levels. APGEM consistently outperforms conventional static mitigation methods, reaches approximately 94% of the utility of an oracle strategy, maintains higher quantum-state fidelity as noise increases, and produces more stable learning behaviour throughout training. Ablation studies show that the framework learns context-aware mitigation policies that adapt to different noise environments and circuit execution conditions. These findings demonstrate that integrating adaptive error mitigation into the learning process substantially improves the robustness and reliability of QRL on NISQ hardware.

</details>


### [610] [IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01269)
*Luca Geminiani,Nadja Klein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IQS-BO，一种基于PFN的贝叶斯优化方法，通过监督学习直接预测候选点成为最优点的后验概率，实现完全上下文内或仅摊销决策步的高效优化，并引入混合先验提升预训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化每一步都需重拟合代理模型并最大化采集函数，计算开销大。现有PFN方法中，PFNs4BO仍需数值最大化采集函数，FIBO固定决策规则且无代理，基于学习的采集函数则依赖强化学习、缺乏查询标签。因此需要一种能以监督方式学习查询决策、且成本更低的上下文内BO方法。

Method: IQS-BO是一个PFN，在合成先验上以监督学习方式学习查询决策。单次前向传播中，它预测每个候选点在整个候选集上使目标最大化的概率，并证明其目标的极小化子即为该事件的后验概率。模型可无代理预训练实现完全上下文内BO，也可将固定概率代理的预测作为额外输入，仅摊销决策步骤。此外提出一种混合先验，将GP样本与具有扭曲输入、孤立狭窄最优或平台区域（平稳核难以建模）的函数相结合进行预训练。

Result: 在合成与真实基准上，IQS-BO以远低于基于采集函数方法的查询成本，达到与GP标准BO及现有上下文内方法相当或更优的性能。采用混合先验预训练可进一步提升优化性能。

Conclusion: IQS-BO通过监督学习方式在上下文内完成贝叶斯优化的决策，兼顾低成本与高性能，并可通过结合非平稳特性的混合先验增强PFN预训练，为高效黑箱优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.

</details>


### [611] [Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01270)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Dhiraj Golhar,Ummesalma Diwan,Sourish Dasgupta,Manjunath Joshi,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示个性化编码器的"可恢复性缺口",并提出REPAIR:在冻结编码器与任务头之间,于紧凑坐标空间中对比缓存表征与当前偏好状态,定位并聚合修正证据,从而在不重训练编码器的情况下提升推荐与生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化编码器将不断演化的交互历史压缩为偏好状态,任务头仅基于该状态工作,会遗漏仍存于冻结编码器各时间步缓存表征中的有用证据。作者旨在研究这一"可恢复性缺口",区分偏好证据的"可获得性"与"下游使用",并验证仅做压缩后状态修正即可带来收益。

Method: 提出REPAIR:将缓存表征与当前偏好状态在紧凑的可学习坐标空间中比较,分别在长历史、近期交互与局部突发三类范围内解析修正证据;随后选择哪些模式、哪些时间步参与贡献,并把聚合修正量加到状态上再送入任务头。该"编码器侧修复"复用已有前向计算的表征,无需重新编码历史;编码器与任务头均保持冻结,仅训练REPAIR。生成任务中对应方法为IMPerSumm。

Result: 在MovieLens、PENS、MIND与Amazon Reviews 2023上,仅训练REPAIR即提升全部12个代表性推荐host的MRR与nDCG@10,而编码器与任务头冻结;同等host仅微调任务头的增益更小(如MovieLens上Mamba4Rec提升3.96 MRR点,而仅微调任务头仅0.19)。排序与时序诊断支持存在紧凑且依赖host的修正结构。个性化生成中,IMPerSumm将两个加权PerSEval指标(衡量对用户偏好的响应性)最高提升25.23%。

Conclusion: 结果表明压缩后状态修正是有效且必要的,并明确区分了偏好证据的"可获得性"与其"下游使用";仅训练轻量修正模块即可跨多任务、多host稳定获益。

Abstract: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

</details>


### [612] [CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02039)
*Yafei Zhang,Songshuo Lu,Sicong Liao,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Cancellation-Aware Response Masking (CARM)，一种序列级掩码方法，通过对 token 对数比取绝对值后再平均，避免正负漂移相互抵消，实现更可靠的 off-policy 控制，并在数学推理与代码生成任务上显著优于几何均值掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 LLM 后训练中，策略更新及 rollout 引擎与训练引擎的差异会使采样响应变为 off-policy。常用的几何均值掩码规则使用长度归一化的 token 概率比几何均值，其带符号对数比在不同位置上可能相互抵消，从而掩盖了严重的双向策略漂移。

Method: 提出 CARM (Cancellation-Aware Response Masking)，在平均之前对每个 token 的对数比取绝对值，防止相反方向的概率变化相互抵消，并给出了理论证明：被接受的响应满足关于超出规定区间的采样 token 比例与其越界平均对数距离的联合界。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成实验中，CARM 在 AIME 2024/2025/2026 和 BeyondAIME 上的平均 mean@16 比几何均值掩码最多提升 3.13 个百分点；在四个代码基准上的平均 pass@1 比最强基线提升 2.88 个百分点。

Conclusion: CARM 是一种有理论依据且有效的响应级 off-policy 控制方法，适用于 LLM 强化学习。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [613] [Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01284)
*Mehmet Baygin,Sengul Dogan,Turker Tuncer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本教程系统梳理了模型验证方案（留出法、交叉验证变体、分组与嵌套设计），并通过八个对照场景说明分割不当会导致乐观且稳定的假象，最终结论是：没有普适最优的验证方法，独立单元须匹配部署目标，且所有依赖数据的操作都必须排除用于性能估计的观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型验证旨在估计完整学习流程在新数据上的性能，但无效的数据划分会产生乐观且稳定的结果，从而误导模型评估。论文希望厘清各类验证设计中的偏差来源与泄漏风险，并给出可操作的指导。

Method: 综述了留出验证、训练/验证/测试设计、重复随机子采样、k折与重复分层交叉验证、留一法与留p法、分组感知验证以及嵌套分组交叉验证；将通用机器学习原则与EEG片段、配对眼OCT图像、重复临床测量和多中心数据相联系。设计八个对照场景对比有缺陷与防泄漏设计：七个使用锁定的混淆矩阵与可审计指标，一个使用可复现的重复研究模拟，覆盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、记录依赖性、中心混合、重复使用测试集和估计器不稳定性，并考察偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性与计算成本。

Result: 分析表明不存在普适最优的验证方法；独立单元必须与预期部署目标一致；所有依赖数据的操作都必须排除用于性能估计的观测，否则将产生乐观偏差。论文还提供了数据量矩阵、决策树与报告清单，以及可复现的MATLAB模板与scikit-learn对照实现。

Conclusion: 验证方案的选择应服从部署场景，而非追求单一“最佳”方法。防止信息泄漏的关键在于保证独立单元一致并使数据依赖操作与评估观测隔离，配套的决策工具与代码模板可支持规范化实践。

Abstract: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

</details>


### [614] [EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01315)
*Qiuliang Liu,Liming Wu,Qi Li,Zhonglong Peng,Chang Chen,Xiaolong Chen,Wenbing Huang,Shifeng Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出以占用分布矩阵（ODM）统一表示无序晶体结构，并设计熵多面体流（EP-Flow）框架，实现公式条件下的无序晶体结构预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多功能材料本质上是无序的，其性质由取代混合、空位或间隙物种控制。现有晶体生成模型要么假设确定的位点占据，要么依赖位点级无序标注，而在以化学式为唯一输入时这些标注通常不可得。

Method: 将无序晶体结构预测形式化为占用分布矩阵（ODM），即连续的"位点×物种"表示，可统一有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序与间隙占据。有效ODM须满足位点级占用、质量守恒与非负性等耦合约束，使样本落在依赖化学式的运输多面体上。提出EP-Flow：一种边缘约束的流匹配框架，将异构多面体规范化到共享的双中心空间，学习保持边缘分布的流，并通过Sinkhorn逆映射恢复可行占据。模型联合生成占据、分数坐标与晶格参数。

Result: 在基于COD与MPDS构建的公式条件无序CSP基准上取得最优性能，显著优于经适配的有序晶体生成器；分析表明EP-Flow能恢复稀疏且具有化学意义的局部无序模式，而非仅匹配全局组成统计。

Conclusion: EP-Flow为公式条件下的无序晶体结构预测提供了统一且有效的生成范式，验证了在无需位点级无序标注的情况下建模无序结构的可行性。

Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.

</details>


### [615] [Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01317)
*Pascal Janetzky,Yuxin Wang,Michael Klar,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PPNAS，一种将预测驱动推断（PPI）引入神经架构搜索（NAS）的方法，融合少量真实性能标签与大量零成本代理（ZCP）信息，在有限评估预算下实现标签高效的预测器式 NAS，并达到当前最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS 中评估候选架构存在固有矛盾：可靠的性能标签因训练与评估代价高昂而稀缺；零成本代理虽可大规模廉价计算，但噪声较大。目前尚不清楚如何有效结合这两类监督信号。作者希望同时利用少量真实标签与大量 ZCP 信息，缓解标签稀缺与代理噪声问题。

Method: 提出 PPNAS，基于预测驱动推断（PPI）框架。它将（1）一小部分带观测性能标签的架构与（2）一大批带 ZCP 信息的架构进行融合：利用 ZCP 提供的序数信息构造额外的成对排序监督，同时借助 PPI 对 ZCP 排序与真实性能排序之间的系统性偏差进行去偏校正。

Result: 在端到端预测器式 NAS 场景下评估 PPNAS，在有限评估预算条件下取得了当前最优（state-of-the-art）的性能表现。

Conclusion: PPNAS 是首个面向标签高效 NAS 的预测驱动方法，证实了将 PPI 与零成本代理结合可有效提升有限预算下的架构评估与搜索效果。

Abstract: Evaluating candidate architectures in neural architecture search (NAS) faces an inherent trade-off: on the one hand, reliable performance labels are limited because training and evaluating architectures is costly; on the other hand, zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) are cheap to compute at large scale but can be noisy. Yet, how to effectively combine these two sources of supervision remains unclear. In this paper, we propose PPNAS, a novel prediction-powered inference (PPI) approach for NAS. PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. We evaluate PPNAS in end-to-end predictor-based NAS, where it achieves state-of-the-art under limited evaluation budgets. To the best of our knowledge, PPNAS is the first prediction-powered approach for label-efficient NAS.

</details>


### [616] [Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02140)
*Aayush Karan,Sitan Chen,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种MCMC采样算法，依据参考模型将离线（off-policy）轨迹逐步转化为更接近在策略（on-policy）的数据分布，使SFT在获得在策略学习优势的同时利用离线数据中的特权信息，在多项任务上媲美甚至优于强在策略基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练通常使用SFT与RL：普遍认为RL泛化强、不易遗忘，但依赖重复采样寻找成功轨迹；SFT可从离线专家数据学习，却易泛化弱、发生灾难性遗忘。作者希望同时兼得在策略学习的能力与离线数据所含的特权信息。

Method: 不改动学习目标，而是调整数据分布以适配学习器：提出一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样算法，在给定参考模型（用于微调）的条件下，将离线轨迹逐步变换为更接近在策略的分布。

Result: 在科学技能习得、数学推理和开放式专业技能等任务上，该采样算法使SFT可媲美主流后训练技术，通常比强在策略基线泛化更好、遗忘更少；所得微调模型具有强分布性能，并能超越对基座模型分布的简单锐化（sharpening），实现分布外/超出基座分布的学习。

Conclusion: 该研究将采样视为一种模型原生算子，用于塑造数据的可学习性，可作为贯穿整个后训练流程的通用基础原语，具有更广泛的适用价值。

Abstract: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.

</details>


### [617] [Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01318)
*Hanna Malet,Gabriel Turinici*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究扩散模型在有限预算生成流水线中的模型坍塌：当保留全部历史与真实数据、但每代仅从不断增大的池中抽取固定规模样本训练时，真实数据占比会逐渐趋零。结果显示，固定预算协议的退化是局部的，部分特征可长期保留，而替换协议则迅速全面退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究结论看似矛盾：以合成数据替换真实数据会导致坍塌，而在合成数据中持续累积真实数据却能避免坍塌。作者希望澄清这一分歧，考察介于两者之间、更符合有限预算流水线的中间情形——数据不删除但真实数据比例自然稀释。

Method: 在多代扩散模型训练流程上，对比两种协议：替换协议（仅用上一代合成数据）与固定预算协议（保留全部历史及真实数据，每代从增长池中抽取固定规模样本）。实验覆盖2D螺旋数据集及MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10图像基准。同时构建多代参数动力学的线性响应模型，并用随机递归进行分析。

Result: 替换协议下数据集迅速退化，与文献一致；固定预算协议仅发生部分退化，保留了部分特征。线性响应模型的随机递归分析确认两种协议存在本质差异：某些特征在两种协议下都脆弱，会在数代内丢失；而另一些特征在固定预算协议下稳健，在几乎无界的训练代数内仍被保留。

Conclusion: 模型坍塌并非一概而论：在固定预算协议中，坍塌是部分且特征依赖的，部分特征可长期存续。结果调和了此前关于合成数据替换与真实数据累积的看似矛盾结论，并将坍塌机制归结为特征脆弱性的差异。

Abstract: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

</details>


### [618] [Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02173)
*Areeb Ahmad,Pratinav Seth,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"自我修复"现象（消融某组件后其他组件补偿）其实源于一种消融前就已存在的增益：任何干预都可视为某个反事实对比强度轴λ上的一个点，而细粒度单元的因果修复响应遵循仿射定律E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，斜率γ_r是固定系数，决定该单元是抵消还是强化被移除信号。实验在四个模型的事实判断任务上发现81个下游方向中68个符合该定律，GPT-2 Small的IOI电路中10个可及头中有7个符合且均为"配重"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往反复观察到语言模型组件被消融后其他组件会调整补偿（self-repair），但机制不明，最系统的研究甚至认为该现象是噪声且难有单一解释。作者质疑这一结论，试图证明自我修复有一个统一机制：它源于消融前就已存在的增益/配重，而非消融诱发的特殊调整。

Method: 将任何对因果重要组件的干预建模为反事实对比强度轴λ上的一点（传统消融只是未校准的点）；对细粒度单元r定义因果修复响应E_r(λ)，并提出其服从仿射定律E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，其中斜率γ_r为固定系数，符号决定单元是抵消还是强化被移除信号。在四个不同家族模型（Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral）的事实判断任务上，识别符合该定律的组件（含MLP神经元、OV神经元、奇异方向），并用固定权重预测γ_r的幅度；在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路上验证。

Result: 在事实判断任务上，81个下游方向中有68个符合该仿射定律；覆盖MLP神经元、OV神经元和奇异方向。可从固定权重预先估计γ_r的幅度。在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路中，干预可触及的10个头中有7个符合该定律，且这7个全部为counterweight（配重）。

Conclusion: 看似神秘的自我修复，其实只是配重（counterweight）在其常规操作下、当对比信号出现在核心层时的一种表现。它并非噪声或需要单独解释的特殊机制，而是由消融前已存在的固定系数γ_r支配的仿射响应。

Abstract: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.

</details>


### [619] [Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01322)
*Kotaro Kamiya,Joel Nicholls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN)，用代数同态的松弛形式"K-term sandwich"作为限制映射，构造出半正定的sheaf Laplacian，并刻画其表达能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在代数值stalk上，保持代数同态与等变性只能得到versor共轭，这种限制映射表达能力弱，需要更一般的构造来增强sheaf神经网络在图级等变回归中的表达力。

Method: 在每个stalk上放置Clifford代数，沿边传输multivector特征。放弃代数同态约束，采用K-term sandwich作为restriction map，使sheaf Laplacian天然半正定、无需versor约束且能混合grade；并从耦合grade、触及endomorphism空间的程度、条件数三个维度刻画该映射族。

Result: K-term sandwich可张成endomorphism空间的一半；在Cl(3,0,0)中对应于与中心pseudoscalar对易的映射；项数控制表达力。CSNN对应reversion成员，是构造性的first-order模型，处于该族的grade-mixing角。

Conclusion: 通过松弛同态约束得到一族更灵活的等变restriction map，CSNN作为其中reversion特例，为图级等变回归中的sheaf构造提供了理论刻画与可用模型。

Abstract: We introduce the Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN), an equivariant sheaf neural network for geometric graphs that places a Clifford algebra on each stalk of a cellular sheaf and transports multivector features along edges. The canonical choice of restriction map for sheaves with algebra-valued stalks is algebra homomorphism. Adding the constraint of equivariance, the naive choice becomes versor conjugation. However, versor conjugation is expressively weak, so we drop algebra homomorphism and arrive at the K-term sandwich. The resulting sheaf Laplacian is positive semidefinite by construction, needs no versor constraint, and still mixes grades. Our main contribution characterizes the resulting family of restriction maps along three axes: which grades a map couples, how much of the endomorphism space it reaches, and how well it is conditioned. The K-term sandwich spans half of the endomorphism space, and in Cl(3, 0, 0) it corresponds to the maps that commute with the central pseudoscalar. The number of terms controls expressivity. CSNN is the reversion member, a first-order model by construction and the grade-mixing corner of this family, developed as a sheaf construction for graph-level equivariant regression.

</details>


### [620] [Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01343)
*Anthony Dugois,Vincent Fagnon,Giorgio Lucarelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究非预知（non-clairvoyant）单机调度中最小化完工时间之和的问题，借助分类模型的混淆矩阵构建鲁棒性框架，将不确定性刻画为各类内排列集合，并设计最优非自适应策略及自适应/随机算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非预知单机调度中作业处理时间未知，经典最坏情况下不存在常数竞争比算法，因此需要引入额外结构信息以突破这一限制。作者受鲁棒优化与学习增强算法的启发，利用分类器提供的结构信息（混淆矩阵）来刻画不确定性，从而规避Min-Max与Min-Max Regret等经典鲁棒指标的计算困难。

Method: 假设作业被划分为若干类别，并可获得分类器的混淆矩阵，其中第(k,ℓ)项表示被预测为类k而实际属于类ℓ的作业数量。基于该混淆矩阵，将不确定性刻画为各预测类内部的一组排列（permutation）集合，而非离散数值情景集合。在此框架下考虑三种鲁棒准则：Min-Max、Min-Max Regret以及所有情景下的期望目标。首先提出对所有三种准则均不敏感的（oblivious）最优非自适应策略；随后研究自适应与随机算法。

Result: 提出了一种对Min-Max、Min-Max Regret和期望目标三种鲁棒准则均最优的非自适应策略；并证明当混淆矩阵具有特定结构性质时，自适应算法与随机算法可以优于最优非自适应策略。

Conclusion: 利用分类器混淆矩阵的结构信息可有效应对非预知调度中的不确定性，避免经典鲁棒指标的计算困难；该框架既给出了统一的最优非自适应解，也揭示了在矩阵具有特殊结构时自适应与随机化方法能带来额外收益。

Abstract: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computational difficulty of classical robust metrics, such as Min-Max and Min-Max Regret. In addition to these worst-case metrics, we also consider the expected objective over all scenarios. We first propose an optimal non-adaptive strategy that is oblivious with respect to all three robust criteria. We then investigate adaptive and randomized algorithms, showing that they can outperform the optimal non-adaptive strategy when the matrix exhibits particular structural properties.

</details>


### [621] [Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01355)
*Alessandro Micheli,Andrea Zerio,Samir Bhatt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在有限状态空间上进行一步生成建模的新框架，通过离散Wasserstein几何定义目标相对KL梯度流，并利用马尔可夫跳跃与潜在条件生成器实现一步推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将连续域中的 drifting 生成建模方法扩展到离散领域，以实现有限状态空间上的一步生成。

Method: 利用离散Wasserstein几何，在可逆马尔可夫核的转移上定义目标相对KL梯度流；通过马尔可夫跳跃在粒子层面实现该概率流，并将传输更新摊销到潜在条件生成器中，使迭代动力学仅用于训练，推断保持一步。

Result: 在可精确计算分布与传输动力学的受控设定中，验证了KL耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性以及预测的数值缩放；有限容量神经生成器能够跟踪精确传输目标并保持一步生成。

Conclusion: 结果验证了该基本构造的有效性，为将Discrete Drifting扩展到结构化离散数据提供了基础。

Abstract: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

</details>


### [622] [Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01356)
*Simon Heilig,Jens Püttschneider,Mohammad Itani,Asja Fischer,Timm Faulwasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络中的Hamiltonian参数化为由单个输入凸网络生成的Bregman散度乘积，从而突破原有单吸引子限制，可表示具有双势阱等多吸引子能量景观的动力系统，并在三个系统上实现1.8倍至8.5倍的收敛加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络通过构造保证渐近稳定性，但其Hamiltonian是仅含单个全局最小值的全局Lyapunov函数，因此只能表示具有单一吸引子的动态系统。论文指出这一限制甚至排除了简单的双势阱系统，故需要一种能同时保持稳定性保证并刻画多平衡点能量景观的建模方式。

Method: 论文将Hamiltonian参数化为由同一个输入凸网络生成的两个Bregman散度之乘积，并据此构建稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络。

Result: 理论上证明了所得模型具有局部Lyapunov稳定性；证明稳定平衡点的共存必然迫使额外的非渐近稳定平衡点存在；证明所有平衡点位于有界区域内；并在双曲性假设下证明几乎处处稳定性。实验上，在三个系统上该方法能够恢复能量面的关键特征，并将收敛速度提升1.8倍至8.5倍。

Conclusion: 以Bregman散度乘积形式参数化Hamiltonian，为稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络提供了可表示多吸引子系统的途径，同时保留了稳定性证书，并带来实际收敛加速。

Abstract: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

</details>


### [623] [From Redundancy to Minimality: Fixed-Point-Guided Hierarchical Reduction of Learned Piecewise-Linear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01369)
*Hiroto Tamura,Gouhei Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种"固定点引导的分层约简"流程，先训练具有较多ReLU单元的几乎线性RNN（AL-RNN），再逐步线性化选定的ReLU单元，从而获得最小动力学表示；在3-scroll Chua系统上将最小实现的成功种子比例从20%提升到约71%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从时间序列理解非线性动力系统，不仅要复现轨迹，还需给出保留本质动力学结构的简单表示（最小动力学表示）。直接用少量ReLU单元训练AL-RNN以获得最小表示往往不可靠（成功依赖初始化/种子）。因此作者希望借助"冗余的非线性容量"，先训练较大模型再系统约简，从而稳健地得到最小表示。

Method: 采用几乎线性RNN（AL-RNN），即仅部分单元使用ReLU的分段线性RNN，激活模式定义线性区域并以符号表示，符号转移构成符号转移图。提出固定点引导的分层约简过程：逐步线性化选定的ReLU单元，合并相邻线性区域与图节点，同时保留含固定点（FP）的不同符号，形成约简树，得到逐级简化的候选模型。每个约简候选由父模型参数初始化，并在父模型动力学的引导下重新训练（learn-reduce-retrain）。理论证明：复现Q个不同固定点至少需要Q个含FP符号，从而在达到该下界时提供符号级最小性证书。

Result: 在3-scroll Chua系统上，以理论上限最小ReLU单元数（3个）直接训练，仅有20%的随机种子得到高保真的最小实现；而所提learn-reduce-retrain策略在相同最终非线性容量下，将种子宏观成功率（seed-macro success rate）提升到约71%。

Conclusion: 冗余的非线性容量可作为发现并实现最小动力学表示的"脚手架"。通过"先训练大模型—固定点引导分层约简—在父动力学引导下重训练"的策略，可显著提高获得符号级最小且高保真动力学表示的稳健性，并以含FP符号数下界提供最小性证书。

Abstract: Understanding a nonlinear dynamical system from time series requires not only reproducing its trajectories, but also identifying a simple representation that preserves its essential dynamical structure. Almost-linear recurrent neural networks (AL-RNNs) are piecewise-linear RNNs in which only a subset of units use ReLU nonlinearities, so that nonlinear capacity is explicitly controlled by the number of ReLU units. Their activation patterns define linear regions, represented as symbols, whose observed transitions form a symbolic transition graph. However, directly training AL-RNNs with few ReLU units to realize minimal dynamical representations can be unreliable. We ask whether an AL-RNN with more ReLU units can instead be trained first and systematically reduced to a minimal dynamical representation. We introduce a fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction procedure that progressively linearizes selected ReLU units, merging neighboring linear regions and graph nodes while preserving distinct symbols containing fixed points (FPs). The resulting reduction tree defines a hierarchy of progressively simpler candidates. Each reduced candidate is initialized from the parent parameters and retrained under guidance from the parent dynamics. We also prove that reproducing $Q$ distinct fixed points requires at least $Q$ FP-containing symbols, providing a certificate of symbol-level minimality when this bound is attained. On the 3-scroll Chua system, direct training with the theoretical minimum of three ReLU units achieves high-fidelity minimal realizations in only 20% of seeds, whereas our learn-reduce-retrain strategy increases the seed-macro success rate to approximately 71% at the same final nonlinear capacity. These results show that redundant nonlinear capacity can serve as a scaffold for discovering and realizing minimal dynamical representations.

</details>


### [624] [Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01373)
*Michael Hauri,Peter Buttaroni,Fabian A. Mikulasch,Friedemann Zenke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Commute-Time-Preserving World Models（CTWM），通过结合潜在位移预测器与log-determinant正则项，在可逆确定性动力学下从理论上恢复具有正确特征值缩放的图拉普拉斯表示，从而在大规模连续环境中实现保持通勤时间（commute-time）的世界模型，并在多个目标到达基准上以一半参数量匹配或超越LeWM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型可在潜在空间中规划，选择能最大程度缩短到目标状态距离的动作序列。因此，规划受益于距离能反映环境中通勤时间的潜在表示。图拉普拉斯的谱嵌入空间能提供此类表示，但需满足特定的特征值相关缩放。然而在大规模连续环境中直接构建图拉普拉斯不可行，而现有自监督方法为防表示崩溃通常鼓励各向同性表示，这会破坏正确的特征值缩放，导致通勤时间表示不准确。

Method: 提出CTWM（Commute-Time-Preserving World Models），将潜在位移预测器与log-determinant正则项相结合以防止表示崩溃。该方法在可逆确定性动力学下，以及在预测器的不动点处，可证明地恢复出正确缩放的拉普拉斯表示。

Result: 在数值仿真中，CTWM在若干复杂、连续的目标到达（goal-reaching）基准任务上匹配或超越任务无关基线LeWM，且仅使用其一半的参数量。

Conclusion: 通过log-determinant正则化替代各向同性约束，CTWM能在保留正确特征值缩放的同时避免表示崩溃，从而学习到保持通勤时间的潜在表示，为大规模连续环境中的高效规划提供了理论与实证支持。

Abstract: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.

</details>


### [625] [Action-On-Item Preference Flow: A Shared Event Schema for Predictive and Generative Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01375)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Kashish Kanjaria,Vashisth Purani,Sourish Dasgupta,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究能否用一个可复用的更新机制来统一处理用户在不同场景（电影、新闻、对话）中的交互历史，提出动作-项目模式与多时间尺度状态假设（MTSH），并实现 PerTIDE 模型，理论证明其重标记不变性、有界状态变化与池化训练界，实验验证跨源迁移与预测/生成任务上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户的电影、新闻与对话历史在原生动作和输出形式上各不相同，但每次交互都提供了更新用户记忆的证据。核心动机是探究这些异构历史能否训练出一个可复用的统一更新机制，从而实现跨源迁移与跨任务复用。

Method: 提出动作-项目（action-on-item）模式：将映射后的交互角色与内容嵌入配对，使共享更新参数可作用于分离的用户状态。理论上建立原生重标记不变性、项目嵌入扰动下的状态变化有界性，以及显式兼容条件下的池化训练界。提出多时间尺度状态假设（MTSH）刻画证据如何进入、保持与消费；实现 PerTIDE，包含动作门控、三条状态空间轨迹、融合与命令条件读出。

Result: 在 PENS 上，同一历史编码器同时支持下一新闻预测与个性化标题生成。在受控的 PENS 到 MovieLens 实验中，冻结的源训练核心在拟合同一目标消费者后，比结构相同的随机核心高出 15.23 MRR 分。在 MIND 上，PerTIDE 相比同等输入的三分支状态空间对照模型保持 4.12 分 MRR 优势。动作、读出与轨迹干预实验揭示了各组件对增益的互补贡献。

Conclusion: 理论与实验共同支持：可在兼容的源之间学习历史更新机制，并通过预测型与生成型消费者进行复用。这为跨领域用户建模提供了可迁移的统一记忆更新框架。

Abstract: A user's movie, news, and dialogue histories differ in their native actions and outputs, yet each interaction supplies evidence that can update user memory. We study whether these histories can train one reusable update mechanism. An action-on-item schema pairs a mapped interaction role with a content embedding, allowing shared update parameters to operate on separate user states. We establish invariance to native relabeling, bounded state changes under item-embedding perturbations, and a pooled-training bound under explicit compatibility conditions. The Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis (MTSH) specifies how this evidence enters, persists, and is consumed; PerTIDE implements it with action gating, three state-space traces, fusion, and command-conditioned readout. On PENS, the same history encoder supports both next-news prediction and personalized headline generation. In a controlled PENS-to-MovieLens experiment, a frozen source-trained core exceeds an identically structured random core by 15.23 MRR points after fitting the same target consumer. On MIND, PerTIDE retains a 4.12-point MRR advantage over a same-input three-branch state-space control. Action, readout, and trace interventions identify complementary contributions to these gains. Together, the theory and experiments support learning history updates across compatible sources and reusing them through predictive and generative consumers.

</details>


### [626] [Minimax Optimal Regret for Causal Logistic Bandits with Counterfactual Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01377)
*Junhyuk Huh,Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究带反事实公平约束的因果逻辑赌博机：在仅观测事实奖励、反事实可行性方向不可辨识的设定下，证明覆盖条件是必要的，并在弱满秩条件下给出与下界匹配的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果逻辑赌博机中，学习者只能观测事实奖励，而决定反事实可行性的方向未必能从反馈中辨识。以往分析要么忽略覆盖条件，要么施加较强条件，且缺少匹配下界，本文旨在厘清覆盖条件的必要性并建立紧致界。

Method: 通过已知的事实与反事实特征映射（共享未知逻辑奖励参数）建模；先构造事实不可区分但最优公平动作不同的环境，证明缺少覆盖类限制时联合损失为Ω(T)；再在跨动作汇总的事实协方差弱满秩条件下定义目标特定信息尺度V⋆；据此构造最坏情形族下界，并提出按V⋆调参的探索-利用算法与无需其值的自适应算法。

Result: 无覆盖条件时任何策略期望联合损失为Ω(T)；在弱满秩条件下任何策略期望联合损失为Ω([V⋆min{log K,d}]^{1/3}T^{2/3})；两种算法均达到max{R_T,V_T}=Õ([V⋆min{log K,d}]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ_0²)。

Conclusion: 覆盖条件是必要的；在弱满秩条件下，上下界在T、V⋆与min{log K,d}的主阶依赖上匹配（仅差对数因子），为反事实公平逻辑赌博机提供了紧致的理论刻画。

Abstract: We study causal logistic bandits with counterfactual fairness constraints. The causal structure is given through known factual and counterfactual feature maps that share an unknown logistic reward parameter, but the learner observes only factual rewards. Consequently, the directions determining counterfactual feasibility need not be identifiable from the available feedback. The closest prior analyses either omit a coverage condition or impose a comparatively strong one, and do not establish matching lower bounds. We first show that some coverage condition is necessary: without a coverage-type restriction, factually indistinguishable environments with different optimal fair actions force $Ω(T)$ expected joint loss. Under a weaker full-rank condition on the factual covariance pooled across actions, we identify a target-specific information scale $V_\star$ that measures the difficulty of estimating rewards and counterfactual effects from factual feedback. We construct worst-case families satisfying this condition on which every policy incurs expected joint loss $Ω\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}\right)$. We also give an explore--then--exploit procedure tuned using $V_\star$ and an adaptive algorithm that does not require its value. Both algorithms achieve $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ_0^2\right)$, where $R_T$ is regret relative to the best fair action and $V_T$ denotes the cumulative stage-wise positive violations. Thus the upper and lower bounds match in their leading dependence on $T$, $V_\star$, and $\min\{\log K,d\}$, up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [627] [Robust Evidential Learning Through Latent Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01384)
*Charmaine Barker,Daniel Bethell,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CLEAR：一种轻量、任务无关的事后方法，通过刻画潜空间组条件几何并生成潜空间扰动视图，度量潜冲突以选择性削弱证据强度，提升证据深度学习的OOD与对抗鲁棒性，无需重训练、不改变基础预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险场景中，OOD与对抗输入会导致模型产生高置信但不可靠的预测；证据深度学习（EDL）虽能单次前向给出高效不确定性估计，但对学习表征支持不足的输入（如对抗样本）仍可能赋予过高证据强度。

Method: CLEAR为事后方法：利用留出校准数据刻画模型潜空间的组条件几何；推理时在潜空间直接高效生成扰动视图，并度量其相对于预测组校准几何的冲突；高潜冲突视为证据不被支持，据此选择性降低证据强度，同时保留潜一致输入的证据；不重训练、不修改基础预测。

Result: 在ImageNet→CUB上，OOD与对抗AUROC分别提升+8.29与+5.01，运行速度比竞争性事后方法快17.4倍，并在分类、回归与目标检测基准上保持预测性能。

Conclusion: CLEAR以低开销提升EDL的证据鲁棒性，兼顾效率与任务通用性，适用于高风险的可靠不确定性量化场景。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes settings, where out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs can induce confident but unreliable predictions. Evidential Deep Learning provides efficient uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass, but can still assign high evidential strength to inputs that are poorly supported by the learned representation, such as adversarial inputs. We introduce CLEAR, a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that improves evidential robustness without retraining or altering the base prediction. Using held-out calibration data, CLEAR characterises the group-conditioned geometry of the model's latent space. At inference, it efficiently generates perturbation views directly in the latent space and measures their conflict relative to the calibrated geometry of the predicted group. High latent conflict indicates unsupported evidence, which CLEAR uses to selectively reduce evidential strength while retaining evidence for latent-consistent inputs. On ImageNet$\rightarrow$CUB, CLEAR improves OOD and adversarial AUROC by $+8.29$ and $+5.01$ while running 17.4$\times$ faster than competing post-hoc methods while preserving predictive performance across classification, regression, and object detection benchmarks.

</details>


### [628] [AF-Muon: An AdamW-Free Muon Optimizer for Tied-Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01395)
*Arash Lagzian,Paniz Halvachi,Junming Zhang,Zhouhan Lin,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AF-Muon，一种无 AdamW 的 Muon 扩展：隐藏权重矩阵用 Muon 谱范数更新，绑定词表用支持感知有限上限线性最小化 oracle，一维参数用 RMS 归一化更新，仅需单一一阶动量缓冲，节省约 20% 优化器状态内存，并在九种绑定 token 设置上优于 Hybrid Muon 与 Sign 端点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 通过对矩阵参数施加谱范数最速下降更新改进了大规模训练，但实际模型包含不符合稠密矩阵几何的参数块。典型的是绑定词表（tied vocabulary table），它同时接收稀疏输入查表与稠密输出分类器等多源结构不同的梯度。参考配方将这些块交给辅助 AdamW，从而重新引入二阶矩状态并将别名表当作通用张量更新，既耗费优化器内存，也未针对其独特几何。

Method: AF-Muon 是一种无 AdamW 的 Muon 扩展：对隐藏权重矩阵保留 Muon 矩阵更新；对绑定的词汇表使用支持感知的有限上限线性最小化 oracle（support-aware finite-cap LMO）；对一维辅助参数使用 RMS 归一化更新。整个方案每个参数类只使用一个一阶动量缓冲，完全不含二阶矩状态。

Result: 在九种绑定 token 设置中——124M 至 1B 的 decoder-only 语言模型、完全共享的 T5 风格编码器-解码器，以及 ImageGPT 风格图像 token、蛋白质和稀疏 MoE 变体，覆盖文本、图像与蛋白质序列数据——AF-Muon 在平均验证损失与困惑度上均优于 Hybrid Muon 和 SCION 风格 Sign 端点。相比 Hybrid Muon，其优化器状态内存节省约 20%；匹配训练下额外步时开销约 1%。长周期实验与超参数敏感性研究证实增益稳健，相同动量诊断将其归因于有限上限：相比 Sign 保留更多行内幅度，同时约束了 row-RMS 的坐标集中度。

Conclusion: 绑定词表构成一种独特的优化器几何，需要专门处理。AF-Muon 作为稳健的无 AdamW Muon 变体，在多种模型、模态与架构上取得一致的验证损失与困惑度改进，同时显著降低优化器状态内存并保持极低的步时开销。

Abstract: Muon improves large-scale training by applying a spectral-norm steepest-descent update to matrix parameters, but practical models also contain parameter blocks that do not fit dense-matrix geometry. One important case is the tied vocabulary table, which appears in language models and other token generators and can receive multiple structurally different gradient sources, from sparse input lookups to dense output-classifier updates. In the reference recipe these blocks are handed to an auxiliary AdamW optimizer, which restores second-moment state and updates the aliased table as a generic tensor. We propose AF-Muon, an AdamW-free extension of Muon that keeps the Muon matrix update for hidden weight matrices while using a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle for tied vocabulary tables and an RMS-normalized update for one-dimensional auxiliary parameters. AF-Muon therefore trains every parameter class with a single first-moment buffer and no second-moment state, saving around 20% optimizer-state memory relative to Hybrid Muon in our benchmark. Across nine tied-token settings - decoder-only language models from 124M to 1B parameters, a fully shared T5-style encoder-decoder, and ImageGPT-style image-token, protein, and sparse-MoE variants, spanning text, image, and protein-sequence data - AF-Muon improves mean validation loss and perplexity over both Hybrid Muon and a SCION-style Sign endpoint. Long-horizon runs and hyperparameter sensitivity studies confirm the gain is robust, and identical-momentum diagnostics attribute it to the finite cap, which preserves more within-row magnitude than Sign while bounding the coordinate concentration of row-RMS. These results identify tied vocabulary tables as a distinct optimizer geometry and yield a robust AdamW-free Muon variant across models, modalities, and architectures, with about 1% step-time overhead in matched training.

</details>


### [629] [Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01399)
*Alessandro Montenegro,Riccardo Venturelli,Marco Mussi,Matteo Papini,Alberto Maria Metelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在多重重要性加权框架下实例化两种PPO样本复用变体（wPPO-U与wPPO-BH），仅复用近期若干迭代的样本以隔离复用效应，并推导策略改进下界，通过连续控制任务系统研究数据复用何时以及如何提升PPO的样本效率或最终性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: on-policy方法（如PPO）样本效率低，数据更新几次即被丢弃；off-policy方法虽借助经验回放提升样本效率，却带来训练不稳定或大量调参负担。已有混合策略为PPO加入off-policy数据复用，但缺乏对“复用何时有益、在何种场景有益、收益多大”的系统研究。

Method: 在多重重要性加权框架下构建两种样本复用变体：wPPO-U使用普通重要性权重，wPPO-BH使用平衡启发式校正权重。二者保留PPO核心机制，仅复用最近若干迭代窗口内的样本，以隔离数据复用这一单一因素；并分别为二者推导策略改进下界，为其损失函数提供理论依据。

Result: 在连续控制任务上，利用推导的下界实证考察数据复用对PPO样本效率与最终性能的影响，系统刻画数据复用带来收益的条件与程度。

Conclusion: 通过在统一重要性加权框架下隔离复用效应，本文为PPO的样本复用提供了理论下界支撑与系统的实证分析，明确了数据复用提升样本效率或最终性能的场景条件。

Abstract: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. In this work, we study the effectiveness of sample reuse in PPO by instantiating two variants within a multiple importance weighting framework. Both retain the core PPO mechanics, reusing only samples from a window of recent iterations, thereby isolating the effect of data reuse from other factors. The variants, termed wPPO-U and wPPO-BH, employ vanilla importance weights or balance-heuristic-corrected ones, respectively. For both, we derive policy improvement lower bounds providing theoretical grounding for their respective losses. We use them to empirically study when and how data reuse improves sample efficiency or final performance of PPO across continuous control tasks.

</details>


### [630] [Why Does Train-Validation Separation Emerge? Update-Pressure Density Dynamics in Pretrained Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01425)
*Yuchen Li,Mingyu Du,Zongqi Fan,Ken-Tye Yong,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"动态结构"解释：预训练模型适配过程中,继续拟合会使更新需求从广泛可复用的支撑转向更窄、迁移性更弱的支撑,从而扩大训练-验证性能差距;并通过受控仿真、NLP与视觉实验验证该机制及其可观测预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练-验证分离(训练集表现与有限留出验证集表现之间的演化差异)尚缺乏机制性解释。作者希望给出一个动态结构性说明:适配过程中更新需求如何从广泛共享的支撑转移到更窄、留出迁移更弱的支撑,并解释梯度分配异质性与该差距的关系。

Method: 1) 提出条件局部模型,将更新需求转移与梯度分配异质性上升、训练-验证分离加深相联系;2) 使用固定训练探针(fixed training probes)使结构演化可观测,且验证样本不进入读数,留出表现单独用于评估其与差距的关系;3) 构造层级任务,用残差多层感知机(ResMLP)操纵样例私有特征占比(p=.3/.5/.7),保持四个共享特征层级相对混合比1:2:3:4,每条件五次运行;4) 分别在训练与验证样本上测掩码输入损失以暴露迁移不对称;5) NLP:RoBERTa、DeBERTa、Qwen各10轮,6个数据集共90次运行,考察训练探针加权的类内与整体离散度读数与准确率差距的相关性;6) 视觉:ResNet-18 40轮,三个数据集检验两种读数。

Result: ResMLP层级任务中,私有特征占比由.3增至.5、.7时,最终平均准确率差距由.185升至.331、.527;掩码输入损失在训练与验证样本上表现出对应迁移不对称。NLP 90次运行中,训练探针加权的类内与整体离散度读数均与准确率差距呈正相关(原始与平滑水平相关);约一个epoch间隔的配对原始变化分别在86/90与87/90次运行中保持正相关。视觉ResNet-18研究在三数据集上对两种读数进行了检验。

Conclusion: 受控仿真、NLP与视觉结果共同支持该动态结构解释;真实模型证据在指定监测器下检验了其可观测预测,表明训练-验证分离随适配加深而扩大,并伴随梯度分配异质性与迁移不对称的增强。

Abstract: Train-validation separation is the evolving difference between performance on observed training examples and a finite held-out validation set. We propose a dynamic structural account of how this gap develops during adaptation of pretrained models: continued fitting can shift update demand from broadly reusable support toward narrower support with weaker held-out transfer. A conditional local model links this shift to increasing heterogeneity in gradient allocation and train-validation separation. Fixed training probes make this structural evolution observable without validation examples entering the readouts; held-out performance is used separately to evaluate its relation to the gap. In a constructed hierarchy implemented with a residual multilayer perceptron (ResMLP), increasing the target share of example-private features from $p=.3$ to $.5$ to $.7$, while preserving the relative mixture $1{:}2{:}3{:}4$ among the four shared feature levels, increases the final mean accuracy gap from $.185$ to $.331$ to $.527$ across five runs per condition. Masked-input losses measured separately on training and validation examples expose the corresponding transfer asymmetry. The natural language processing (NLP) analysis uses 10-epoch runs of RoBERTa, DeBERTa, and Qwen on six datasets (90 runs): the training-probe-weighted within-class and overall dispersion readouts each have positive raw and smoothed level correlations with the accuracy gap in all 90 runs. Raw changes paired at approximately one-epoch intervals remain positively associated in 86/90 and 87/90 runs, respectively. A 40-epoch ResNet-18 study tests both readouts on three vision datasets. Together, controlled simulation, NLP, and vision support the dynamic structural account across settings, with real-model evidence testing its observable predictions under the specified monitors.

</details>


### [631] [Least-time Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01426)
*Alessandro Betti,Marco Gori,Stefano Melacci,Jinwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究梯度流速度控制下的风险最小化时间问题：通过设定速度使风险满足 $\dot e=-u(e)$，并对时间泛函进行正则化，证明最优速率呈 $u^*(e)\sim(9/(2\lambda))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$ 的幂律形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接最小化到达零风险的时间是病态的（ill posed），因此需要引入正则化项来获得适定问题，并刻画最优的风险下降速率。

Method: 将梯度流速度设为 $u(E(w))$，使风险精确满足 $\dot e=-u(e)$，从而将问题约化为关于 $u$ 的变分问题 $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2|u'|^2+1/u)\,de\}$；采用直接法证明存在性、严格凸性证明唯一性、证明最小值在原点外为正，并显式积分 Euler-Lagrange 方程。

Result: 证明最小值存在且唯一，其为线性缩放的摆线（cycloid）；最优速率在零风险附近满足 $u^*(e)\sim(9/(2\lambda))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$，指数 $2/3$ 位于 Hölder 窗口 $(1/2,1)$ 内，对应有限时间到达且速度权重趋于零。

Conclusion: 该幂律指数 $2/3$ 与文献中基于幂律拟设得到的结果一致，说明所提出的正则化变分框架能够严格刻画梯度流在有限时间内到达零风险的最优速度律。

Abstract: Prescribing the speed of gradient flow on the risk itself, by the dynamics $\dot w=-u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/\abs{\nabla E(w)}^{2}$, makes the risk $e(t)=E(w(t))$ obey $\dot e=-u(e)$ exactly, whatever the landscape~$E$; the time needed to reach zero risk from $e_0$ is $\int_0^{e_0}\dd e/u(e)$. Minimizing this time alone is ill posed, and we study the regularized problem $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2\abs{u'}^{2}+1/u)\,\dd e:\ u\in H^{1}(0,e_0),\ u\ge0,\ u(0)=0\}$, $λ>0$. We prove that the minimizer exists, is unique, and is a linearly scaled cycloid, and we show that the optimal rate behaves like $u^{*}(e)\sim(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$ near zero risk: the exponent $2/3$ is the one found in \cite{betti2026holder} by a power-law ansatz, and it lies in the Hölder window $(\tfrac12,1)$ where the arrival is in finite time with vanishing weight speed. The proof follows the classical route: existence by the direct method, uniqueness by strict convexity, positivity of the minimizer away from the origin, and the explicit integration of the Euler-Lagrange equation.

</details>


### [632] [Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models into Efficient Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01435)
*Minho Jeong,Dooho Lee,Jinmo Lee,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何将表格基础模型（TFMs）的知识蒸馏到轻量级学生模型，提出一套有效蒸馏配方：以完整标注训练集作为教师上下文，并仅在教师对观测查询与合成查询的预测上训练学生，从而在保持预测性能的同时大幅降低重复推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFMs依赖上下文学习，预测性能强，但每次推理都需重复以标注数据作为条件，导致推理开销高昂。知识蒸馏可将其预测能力迁移到轻量的数据集专用学生模型以降低成本，但由于TFM预测同时依赖标注上下文与查询，存在两个关键设计问题：如何构造教师监督信号，以及扩大查询覆盖是否有助于蒸馏。论文旨在系统考察这两个问题并给出有效配方。

Method: 在两个TFM上、针对神经与树两类学生模型考察上述设计问题，并据此推导蒸馏配方：使用完整的标注训练集作为教师上下文；学生仅在教师对观测查询和合成查询的预测上训练。

Result: 在TabArena上，所得学生模型比经过监督训练、调参并集成的对应模型高出57–98 Elo分。将同一配方不加改动地应用于TALENT，在300个数据集中的236–258个上改进了匹配的默认学生模型，并将主指标中位误差降低4.0–6.4%。蒸馏学生相对其教师实现3.0–21.6倍的中位推理加速。

Conclusion: 以完整标注训练集为教师上下文、并利用观测与合成查询的教师预测训练学生，是一种通用且有效的TFM蒸馏配方，能在预测性能与重复推理成本之间提供实用折中；代码已开源。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance through in-context learning, yet repeatedly conditioning on labeled data makes inference expensive. Knowledge distillation can reduce this cost by transferring their predictive ability to lightweight, dataset-specific students. However, the dependence of TFM predictions on both a labeled context and a query introduces two design questions: how to construct teacher supervision and whether expanding query coverage improves distillation. We examine these questions across two TFMs and both neural and tree-based students, and derive an effective distillation recipe. The recipe uses the full labeled training set as teacher context and trains students solely on teacher predictions for observed and synthetic queries. On TabArena, the resulting students outperform their supervised trained tuned-and-ensembled counterparts by 57-98 Elo points. Applied unchanged to TALENT, the same recipe improves matched default students on 236-258 of 300 datasets and reduces median primary error by 4.0-6.4%. The distilled students also achieve median inference speedups of 3.0-21.6 times over their teachers, offering a practical trade-off between predictive performance and repeated inference cost. Code is available at https://github.com/nums-ai/TFM_Distillation .

</details>


### [633] [ibUMAP: Coherent and Scalable Field Evaluation for UMAP Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01445)
*Bin Chen,Yumeng Xue,Patrick Paetzold,Yunhai Wang,Oliver Deussen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ibUMAP 提出基于 coherent field 的 UMAP 替代方案：从共享嵌入快照同步计算吸引与排斥力，用三个标量矩表示度加权排斥场，并通过基于插值的 FFT 方案高效求值，兼顾速度与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UMAP 依赖随机负采样实现可扩展的布局优化，但这种随机性会导致重跑及下游复用中嵌入不稳定，因为估计的排斥力依赖采样事件的顺序。

Method: ibUMAP 采用相干场式方法：在共享嵌入快照下评估吸引与排斥并同步应用；其度加权排斥场由固定嵌入下负采样的条件期望导出，表示为三个标量矩，并使用基于插值的 FFT 方案在 CPU 与 GPU 上高效求值，避免显式全对计算，同时产生不同于标准在线 UMAP 的优化动态。

Result: 受控实验表明，同步性与 kernel capping 会改变局部-全局保真度权衡，而 FFT 求值仅带来较小的平均最终质量变化。端到端基准显示，在 CPU 上相对 umap-learn 中位加速 3.29 倍（无种子）与 5.79 倍（有种子），在无种子 GPU 执行下于百万级数据集上相对 cuML 加速 1.44 倍，并伴随更高的运行间稳定性与可测量的保真度权衡。

Conclusion: ibUMAP 通过同步场式优化替代随机负采样，在显著提升运行速度与稳定性的同时，带来可控的保真度权衡。

Abstract: UMAP achieves scalable layout optimization through stochastic negative sampling. However, this stochasticity can lead to unstable embeddings across reruns and downstream reuse, as the estimated repulsive forces depend on the ordering of sampling events. We present ibUMAP, a coherent field-based alternative that evaluates attraction and repulsion from a shared embedding snapshot and applies them synchronously. Its degree-weighted repulsive field is motivated by the conditional expectation of negative sampling for a fixed embedding and represented by three scalar moments, which are evaluated efficiently on CPUs and GPUs using an interpolation-based FFT scheme. This formulation avoids explicit all-pairs computations while inducing optimization dynamics that differ from those of standard online UMAP. Controlled experiments show that synchrony and kernel capping alter the local-global fidelity trade-off, whereas FFT evaluation produces small average changes in final quality. End-to-end benchmarks show median speedups of 3.29x unseeded and 5.79x seeded over umap-learn on CPU, and 1.44x over cuML on million-scale datasets under unseeded GPU execution. These gains accompany greater run-to-run stability and measurable fidelity trade-offs.

</details>


### [634] [Repurposing Obsolete Representations for Post-Deployment Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01453)
*Daniel Bethell,Charmaine Barker,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Deep Repurposing（DR），一种无需梯度更新的后验框架，用于在任务出现过时（task obsolescence）时修复深度神经网络，移除失效输出区域并保留有效任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络部署于长期系统中，训练后任务需求可能变化，导致部分原始输出空间（类别、预测区域或学习行为）失效。现有方法要么保留过时行为，要么依赖昂贵的微调，缺乏高效的后验适配手段。

Method: DR 通过估计过时区域与保留区域的潜在几何结构，移除支持过时行为的成分，并借助解析修复映射（analytic repair map）重新分配与保留任务兼容的证据，全程无需梯度更新，从而同时修复预测与表征。

Result: 在多种任务设置下，DR 能移除过时行为并保留保留任务效用；在分类基准上，其保留准确率匹配或超越竞争性的无学习（unlearning）与编辑基线，消除过时预测，且适配速度最高比竞争性无学习方法快 60 倍。

Conclusion: DR 为任务过时场景提供了一种高效的后验模型修复方案，在不进行梯度更新的前提下实现过时行为消除与保留效能维持，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed in long-lived systems, where task requirements may change after training. In such settings, part of the original output space may become obsolete: a class, prediction region, or learned behaviour may no longer be valid. Existing approaches either leave the obsolete behaviour intact or require fine-tuning, which can be expensive. We propose Deep Repurposing (DR), a post-hoc framework for adapting models under task obsolescence. DR estimates the latent geometry of obsolete and retained regions, removes obsolete-supporting components, and reallocates retained-compatible evidence through an analytic repair map without gradient updates. This yields repaired predictions and representations in which obsolete regions no longer act as valid outputs, while useful obsolete structure can support the retained task. Across multiple task settings, DR removes obsolete behaviour while preserving retained utility. More importantly, across classification benchmarks, DR matches or exceeds competing unlearning and editing baselines in retained accuracy, eliminates obsolete predictions, and adapts up to $60\times$ faster than competing unlearning methods.

</details>


### [635] [Streaming algorithms for robust max-min diversification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01456)
*Andrea Pietracaprina,Geppino Pucci,Stefano Zanon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对带离群点的max-min多样化问题，指出AAAI23算法的三大缺陷，提出确定性coreset流式算法，在温和的inlier-outlier分离假设下返回恰好k个inlier的(2+ε)-近似解，内存与摊销更新时间在广泛参数范围内与n无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: max-min多样化的目标函数对噪声点高度敏感。[Amagata, AAAI23]提出鲁棒公式（排除含z个离群点的解）及基于coreset的流式算法，但存在三处不足：(1) coreset构造需对X做离线计算，内存线性于n，违背流处理目标；(2) 从coreset提取解的单遍过程可能永久丢弃距当前解过远的点，导致返回少于k个点（不可行）；(3) 离群点排除保证仅为概率性，且随coreset缩小而变弱。本文旨在解决这些缺陷。

Method: 提出确定性的基于coreset的算法，在自然的inlier-outlier分离假设（与AAAI23类似）下工作。其单遍流式实现无需预先知道数据集参数，能够自适应数据集的倍增维数D，在k、z、ε、D的广泛取值范围内使用与n无关的内存。对于足够长的流，摊销更新时间与coreset大小成正比，因而也与n无关。

Result: 算法返回恰好k个inlier，构成(2+ε)-近似解（对任意ε>0），仅比最优多项式时间顺序近似差ε，即使无离群点亦如此。其离群点排除保证是确定性的，且内存与摊销更新时间在广泛参数范围内与n无关。

Conclusion: 该工作改进了[Amagata, AAAI23]的流式鲁棒多样化算法：用确定性保证替代概率性保证，用与n无关的内存替代线性内存，并保证返回恰好k个点的可行解，同时保持接近最优的(2+ε)近似比。其流式实现自适应倍增维数D，适用于广泛参数范围。

Abstract: Given a set of $n$ points $X$ in a metric space and an integer $k$, max-min diversification aims to select $k$ points of $X$ maximizing their minimum pairwise distance. This objective function is however highly vulnerable to noisy points. In[Amagata, AAAI23], a robust formulation is proposed which addresses this vulnerability by excluding solutions containing any of $z$ outliers, defined as the $z$ points in $X$ with the largest nearest-neighbor distances. That paper also presents a coreset-based streaming algorithm for the new formulation, based on a suitable inlier-outlier separation assumption. However, we identify three shortcomings in the algorithm by [Amagata, AAAI23]: its coreset construction requires an offline computation over $X$, which needs memory linear in $n$, in stark contrast with the typical goals of stream processing; the one-pass procedure used to extract the solution from the coreset may return fewer than $k$ points (hence, an unfeasible solution) because it permanently discards points too far from the current solution; and its outlier-exclusion guarantee is only probabilistic and weakens as the coreset size shrinks. In contrast, we present a deterministic coreset-based algorithm that, under a natural inlier-outlier separation assumption (similar to the one used in [Amagata, AAAI23]), returns exactly $k$ inliers which are a $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximate solution, for any $\varepsilon>0$, thus only $\varepsilon$ above the best polynomial-time sequential approximation, even without outliers. Its one-pass streaming implementation adapts obliviously to the dataset's doubling dimension $D$ and, for wide ranges of $k$, $z$, $\varepsilon$, and $D$, it uses memory independent of $n$. For sufficiently long streams, its amortized update time is proportional to the coreset size, thus also independent of $n$.

</details>


### [636] [Tight Transition Time Bounds for Separable Logistic Regression at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01459)
*Haodong Wen,Kaiyue Wen,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究大步长梯度下降在可分逻辑回归中的 Edge of Stability 转变时间，否证了已有“与步长 η 无关”的猜想，给出最坏情形转变时间为 Θ((log η)^{min{n-2,d-2}})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作在 d=2 时给出 Θ(1) 的紧界并猜想任意 d≥2 下转变时间与步长 η 无关；本文旨在检验并推翻这一猜想，刻画转变时间对 η、样本量 n、维度 d 的精确依赖。

Method: 在线性可分数据上分析大步长常数步长的梯度下降动力学；针对“对梯度贡献最大的样本在迭代中反复切换”这一核心困难，采用对维度与样本量的归纳法控制该切换行为，并构造匹配的困难实例以证明下界。

Result: 对任意固定样本量 n≥2 和充分小的间隔 γ，最坏情形转变时间为 Θ((log η)^{min{n-2,d-2}})，且在 d≥2 上一致成立，从而给出与 η 相关的多项式对数级上界，否证了原有猜想。

Conclusion: 转变时间并非与 η 无关，而是随 η 呈 (log η) 的多项式增长，其指数由样本量与维度的较小者决定；这一结论刻画了 Edge of Stability 下逻辑回归动力学转变的精确复杂度。

Abstract: We study logistic regression on linearly separable data under gradient descent with a large constant stepsize $η$.
