Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.

</details>


### [673] [Debias Anything: Fairness with Diversity without Supervision in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01815)
*Théau d'Audiffret,Mariia Vladimirova,Jean-Yves Franceschi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种通用后训练方法，通过视觉-语言嵌入空间适配器实现扩散模型公平性与多样性的联合引导，无需敏感属性标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型会复现并放大训练数据中的人口统计失衡。现有去偏方法（分类器引导、显式文本条件）降低适用性与输出多样性；而仅提升多样性的方法又无法保证公平的属性表示。因此需要一种同时兼顾公平与多样、且通用性强的方案。

Method: 在冻结的扩散模型上接一个适配器，连接到预训练的视觉-语言嵌入空间，从而在无需敏感属性标注的情况下提供公平与多样性引导。公平性方面，用成对文本提示定义属性方向，引导批内属性比例趋向目标分布；多样性方面，引入基于该表示语义估计之间不一致程度的评分。该框架同时支持无条件与文本条件扩散模型，且不需要敏感属性的先验知识或数据。

Result: 实验证实该方法在达到相当公平性水平的同时，提升了生成质量与多样性评分。

Conclusion: 该方法可通用于任意扩散模型和任意敏感属性，在不依赖敏感属性标注的前提下联合提升公平性与多样性，并保持较好的生成质量。

Abstract: Although diffusion models produce high-quality images, they also reproduce and amplify demographic imbalances in their training data. Debiasing their generation process post-training w.r.t. some sensitive attribute usually relies on classifier guidance or explicit text extra-conditioning, but this reduces methods' applicability and output diversity. Conversely, methods promoting diversity alone do not ensure fair attribute representation. In this paper, we propose a method tackling fairness and diversity jointly that is generally applicable to any diffusion model and any sensitive attribute. To this end, an adapter connects the frozen diffusion model to a pretrained vision-language embedding space, enabling fairness and diversity guidance without sensitive-attribute annotations. For fairness, pairs of text prompts define attribute directions which guide batch composition towards specific proportions. For diversity, we introduce a score measuring disagreement between the semantic estimates derived from this representation. The formulation supports unconditional and text-conditional diffusion models, while requiring no prior knowledge or data of sensitive attribute. Experiments confirm that our method improves quality and diversity scores at comparable fairness levels.

</details>


### [674] [MECHVAR: Variance-Guided Mechanism Discrimination for Autonomous Machine Learning Experiment Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01819)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MECHVAR：一种面向有限机制库的可执行探针选择准则，以预测响应后验加权方差为打分，等价于Box–Hill后验加权成对KL，支持O(KE)向量化重打分与可加审计，兼顾轻量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准性能提升常具机制模糊性：即使复现了改进，也难以识别其成因。为在有限实验预算下判别候选机制，需要一种可执行的序贯实验选择方法。

Method: 将问题形式化为有限库机制判别：后验加权候选机制、可执行探针与预算约束下的序贯探针选择。MECHVAR选择使预测响应后验加权方差最大的探针；在共享高斯预测模型下，该分数与经典Box–Hill后验加权成对KL准则成正比，具备O(KE)向量化重打分与机制对层面的可加审计；当预测响应间隔较小时，局部展开表明其与期望信息增益(EIG)相联系。

Result: 25分组压力审计中，MECHVAR在若干中等误设情形优于confirmation-first，但与EIG的主要比较在统计上未决。留出Digits循环中，机制识别归一化AUC：MECHVAR 0.8975，score-greedy 0.7825，EIG 0.9092。K=100、E=200时，记录环境下单线程全库打分为MECHVAR 10.36微秒，六节点求积EIG为57.69毫秒。

Conclusion: 当共享预测尺度是可接受的近似时，MECHVAR为有限库实验选择提供了一种轻量、可审计的采集准则；其判别精度与EIG相当且计算效率显著更高。

Abstract: Benchmark gains are often mechanism-ambiguous: reproducing an improvement does not by itself identify why it occurs. We study finite-library mechanism discrimination, where posterior-weighted candidate mechanisms, executable probes, and a limited experimental budget define a sequential experiment-selection problem. MECHVAR selects the next probe by maximizing the posterior-weighted variance of its predicted responses. Under a shared-Gaussian predictive model, this score is exactly proportional to the classical Box--Hill posterior-weighted pairwise-KL criterion, yet it admits O(KE) vectorized rescoring and a transparent additive audit over mechanism pairs. A local expansion further links the score to expected information gain (EIG) when predicted response separations are small. In a 25-block stress audit, MECHVAR outperforms confirmation-first in several moderate misspecification regimes, while its primary comparisons with EIG remain statistically unresolved. In a held-out Digits loop, normalized mechanism-identification AUC is 0.8975 for MECHVAR, 0.7825 for a score-greedy policy, and 0.9092 for EIG. At K = 100, E = 200, median single-thread full-library scoring is 10.36 microseconds for MECHVAR versus 57.69 ms for six-node quadrature EIG in the recorded environment. MECHVAR therefore provides a lightweight, auditable acquisition rule for finite-library experiment selection when a shared predictive scale is a defensible approximation.

</details>


### [675] [Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01827)
*Kevin Tirta Wijaya,Alston Lo,Michael Sun,Wojciech Matusik,Vahid Babaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISMS 提出以专家成对排序替代绝对分数回归来驱动科学设计筛选，并按 Fisher 信息准则在低成本到高成本排序器之间升级查询，在迭代筛选与生成式优化中均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算方法可大规模产生候选分子、材料与设计，导致"验证拥堵"：候选充裕而实验验证能力稀缺，因此关键在于筛选（curation）——挑出少量有前景的设计做昂贵实验。现有筛选方法多依赖预测绝对分数的回归模型，但训练这类模型本身需要大量实验数据。论文指出科学设计发现本质上是"比较性"的，有用的筛选信号不必是绝对测量，成对排序更容易获得。

Method: PRISMS 框架：以来自一个或多个专家（可为计算工具或人类，涵盖从经验规则、agentic 工作流到资深科学家等多保真度层级）的成对排序作为主要筛选信号，不依赖数据饥渴的回归器。当专家在保真度与成本上存在差异时，PRISMS 依据 Fisher 信息准则，将成对查询从低保真度排序器逐步升级（escalate）到高保真度排序器，实现选择性升级。

Result: 在从固定药物发现库中选取设计的迭代筛选任务中，PRISMS 达到 top-10 发现召回率 50% 所需轮数比纯回归主动学习少约 42%，比无选择性升级的基于排序方法少约 15%。在不限于预定义库、需生成新设计的优化任务中，PRISMS 的超体积（hypervolume）比贝叶斯优化基线高约 18.8%。

Conclusion: 以成对排序为核心的筛选范式可在不依赖大量绝对标注数据的前提下有效识别高潜力候选；结合基于 Fisher 信息的选择性保真度升级，可显著提升筛选与优化的样本效率，为缓解科学设计验证拥堵提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. Here, we propose that curation can instead be primarily driven by expert pairwise rankings, which are substantially easier to gather. The expertise can come from computational tools or human input of multiple levels of fidelity, ranging from empirical rules of thumb to agentic workflows and experienced scientists. We introduce PRISMS, a framework that uses pairwise rankings from one or more experts, potentially spanning multiple levels of expertise, to identify the most promising candidates without relying on data-hungry regressors. When experts differ in fidelity and cost, PRISMS escalates pairwise queries from lower- to higher-fidelity rankers based on a Fisher-information criterion. In iterative screening that selects designs from fixed drug discovery libraries, PRISMS achieves 50% top-10 discovery recall in ~42% fewer rounds than regression-only active learning, and in ~15% fewer rounds than the ranking-based method with no selective escalation. In optimization that generates new designs without restriction to a predefined library, PRISMS achieves ~18.8% higher hypervolume than the Bayesian optimization baseline.

</details>


### [676] [Pooling Helps, Learned Weighting Hurts In-Context: Decomposing Group Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01831)
*Michael Fore,James Mason Inder,Mrishika Nair,Praneetha Vaddamanu,Sharlina Keshava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对 Chronos-2 提出的 group attention 进行机制分解，发现其收益主要来自 V/O 的无权重池化，而学习式 Q/K 加权对多变量预测有益或无害，却显著损害多数 ICL 配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chronos-2 引入的 group attention（在固定 patch 索引上对一组变量做注意力）被整体接受为有效设计，但其收益到底来自机制的哪一部分、以及是否同时适用于多变量（MV）和上下文学习（ICL）两种场景尚不清楚。作者希望拆解该设计，判断各组成部分的真实贡献与适用边界。

Method: 在推理阶段直接编辑注意力矩阵 α，将单个注意力头的两条通路分离：V/O（对组内变量做加权摘要的投影）与 Q/K（决定权重的学习式加权）。通过将 α 均一化（即保留 V/O 而消去 Q/K 加权）来剥离两者贡献；并进一步按层隔离影响，检验仅在第一层（first block）将 α 均一化的效果。

Result: 均一池化（仅有 V/O、无 Q/K 加权）在 20 个传感器网络配置中的 18 个上表现正向；学习式 Q/K 加权则按组类型分化——对 MV 的贡献为正或可忽略，但在 10 个传感器网络 ICL 配置中的 8 个上明显退化，其中 4 个甚至劣于单变量推理。按层分析显示，仅在第一层将 α 均一化即可改善所有测试的 ICL 配置。

Conclusion: group attention 的收益主要来自 V/O 的均匀池化而非学习式 Q/K 加权；Q/K 加权仅在 MV 场景下有益或中性，对 ICL 反而有害，尤其在中后层。将第一层的 α 均一化是一种简单且普适的 ICL 改进手段，表明跨变量注意力设计应按场景分别评估与裁剪。

Abstract: Group attention, introduced by the time series forecasting model Chronos-2, attends over the variates of a group at a fixed patch index and serves both multivariate (MV) and in-context learning (ICL) forecasting. Rather than evaluating this cross-variate attention design as a whole, we ask which part of the mechanism earns the benefit and probe its applicability to both MV and ICL regimes. By editing the attention matrix $α$ at inference we separate the two pathways a head comprises: V/O, which projects a weighted summary of the group, and Q/K, which decides the weights. Uniform pooling (V/O without any Q/K weighting) is positive on 18 of our 20 sensor-network configurations, while the learned weighting (Q/K) splits by group type: its contribution is positive or negligible for MV, but materially degrades 8 of the 10 sensor-network ICL configurations, leaving 4 of them worse than univariate inference. By isolating the impact of different layers, we find that uniforming $α$ in the first block alone improves every ICL configuration we test.

</details>


### [677] [Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01882)
*Zhuoran Li,Yunzhan Li,Xun Wang,Yihan Du,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OMAF（Online MARL via one-step Flow model），用基于Transformer的单步流策略替代扩散策略的迭代采样，结合近似路径分数代理与联合优化方案（softmax Q值与联合流策略目标），在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个任务上取得更优性能，回报最高提升3.4倍，样本效率提升10.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）需要在表达复杂多模态动作分布（表达力）与训练/执行效率之间取得平衡。生成式策略（尤其是扩散策略）能忠实建模复杂多模态协调行为，但其迭代采样开销大，难以扩展到在线多智能体场景。因此需要一种既具表达力又具备高效一步动作生成能力的在线MARL框架。

Method: 1) OMAF框架：将表达性生成策略与一步动作生成结合，消除迭代采样。2) 采用基于Transformer的流（flow）策略来刻画复杂协调行为。3) 引入近似路径分数代理（approximate path score surrogate），为同步的流策略优化提供有原则的路径。4) 提出联合优化方案，将softmax Q值估计与联合流策略目标耦合，实现稳定且样本高效的协调策略学习。

Result: 在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个标准任务上，OMAF持续取得优于基线的性能：回报最高提升3.4倍，样本效率最高提升10.5倍。同时消除了迭代采样，大幅降低训练开销且未牺牲策略表达力。

Conclusion: OMAF验证了单步流策略范式作为在线MARL的表达性强且计算高效方案的有效性，兼具生成式策略的表达力与一步生成的效率，适合在线多智能体协调学习的可扩展应用。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

</details>


### [678] [Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01892)
*Feiyu Gavin Zhu,Xiaoyu Zhu,Jiqi Yang,Rui Yang,Arnab Kumar Mondal,Yancheng Wang,Xinke Deng,Jean Oh,Reid Simmons,Joerg Liebelt,Xiang Kong,Zhongyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR) 框架，将多模态智能体的推理过程从开放式生成改为从预设候选推理中进行选择，从而大幅降低推理延迟并保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型多模态智能体在每次动作前生成自由形式推理时，受限于模型容量，往往产生冗长但缺乏有效指导的推理内容，同时带来高额推理开销。因此需要一种既能保证指导质量又能降低推理成本的方法。

Method: SSR 将反复出现的高层推理表示为预先指定、可复用的自然语言候选，模型每轮根据当前上下文对这些候选进行似然度打分并选择，无需额外任务头。利用预设推理轨迹可实现并行打分：通过 teacher-forced prefilling 与共享上下文 KV cache，在同一候选项内及跨候选项并发计算 token 似然。

Result: 在七个多模态搜索基准上使用 2B 和 4B 模型评估，在多种强化学习目标和监督微调设置下，SSR 在任务性能不下降的情况下获得显著效率提升：成功率达到与同规模领先搜索智能体相当的水平，同时每轮推理延迟降低超过 90%，每问题总模型推理延迟降低 28-54%。

Conclusion: 将推理重构为选择而非开放式生成，可在小模型上兼顾推理质量与效率，为多模态智能体提供了一种高性价比的结构化推理方案。

Abstract: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.

</details>


### [679] [Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01896)
*Qijia He,Ruinan Jin,Jun Luo,Shaofeng Zou,Yingbin Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为异步强化学习（RL）中陈旧rollout问题建立收敛界，提出GMC-GRPO方法以最小化比值偏差，改进延迟依赖并提升大延迟下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步RL提升大语言模型后训练效率，但引入早期策略产生的陈旧rollout；关于陈旧性如何影响收敛、以及如何缓解其影响的理论理解仍然有限。

Method: 推导GRPO类算法的收敛界，刻画梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差之间的权衡；针对轨迹级重要性加权估计器，在二阶矩一致受控条件下，延迟通过裁剪或重缩放引入的偏差进入收敛界。据此提出group mass capping GRPO（GMC-GRPO），在共享同一二阶矩保证的一类加权估计器中最小化基于比值的偏差界。同时建立异步GMC-GRPO的收敛保证并进行分析。

Result: 与TIC-GRPO相比，GMC-GRPO将四阶延迟项的阈值依赖从O(ε^{-4})改进为O(ε^{-2})（ε→0，1+ε为比值阈值）；在局部策略重叠下，调步长后延迟相关项按G^{-2/5}下降（G为组大小）。固定行为与当前策略时，组重缩放偏差随G→∞消失，而逐轨迹裁剪偏差可能持续存在。在Qwen3模型和推理基准上的实验表明对陈旧rollout鲁棒性提升，大延迟下GMC-GRPO在稳定基线中性能最佳。

Conclusion: 该工作从理论上刻画了异步GRPO中陈旧性—收敛的权衡，并提出GMC-GRPO有效缓解偏差、改善延迟依赖，在理论与实验上均优于对比方法。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from $O(ε^{-4})$ to $O(ε^{-2})$ as $ε\to0$, where $1+ε$ is the ratio threshold. Under local policy overlap, the delay-dependent term decreases as $G^{-2/5}$ after tuning the step size, where $G$ is the group size. For fixed behavior and current policies, the bias introduced by group rescaling also vanishes as $G\to\infty$, whereas the bias from trajectory-wise clipping can persist. Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.

</details>


### [680] [Higher-Order Positional Encodings for Graph Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01903)
*Caleb Stam,Aagrim Hoysal,Sanjukta Krishnagopal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"高阶位置编码"（higher-order positional encodings）：通过将图提升为团复形并利用Hodge拉普拉斯算子构造编码，使标准图学习模型（如Graph Transformer）无需修改骨干网络即可利用高阶拓扑信息，并从理论上证明其表达能力强于标量图谱滤波器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实系统常存在成对关系无法刻画的高阶（群体）交互。现有图位置编码仅由原始图计算，无法直接捕获观测到的高阶交互；拓扑深度学习虽通过将图提升为单纯复形来应对，但通常需在高阶神经网络表示上执行消息传递或注意力，改动了模型骨干。因此需要一个既保留标准图学习流程又能注入高阶拓扑信息的方案。

Method: 1）提出以位置编码为载体的表示学习范式：将图提升为高阶结构（团复形），基于提升后的关联结构构造位置编码，从而让标准图模型直接使用而无需修改骨干。2）给出高阶位置编码表达能力的理论刻画，证明由高阶提升诱导的节点级算子能以标量图谱滤波器无法实现的方式混合图拉普拉斯频率。3）依据该理论，用团复形导出的Hodge拉普拉斯算子实例化高阶位置编码。

Result: 在ZINC数据集与受控合成基准上，使用Graph Transformer进行实验，预测性能取得提升；固定1-骨架（fixed 1-skeleton）实验表明，当单元（cells）独立于图被提供时，该流程仍能传递高阶信息。

Conclusion: 高阶位置编码构成了连接图位置编码与拓扑深度学习的原理性桥梁：它在不改变模型骨干的前提下赋予图模型利用高阶拓扑的能力，且具备可证明的更强表达性，为融合拓扑深度学习与标准图学习提供了新路径。

Abstract: Many real-world systems exhibit higher-order interactions among groups of entities that cannot be captured by pairwise relationships alone. Graph Transformers and Graph Neural Networks increasingly rely on positional encodings to enrich graph representations, yet existing positional encodings are computed solely from the original graph and therefore cannot directly capture observed higher-order interactions. Topological Deep Learning addresses this limitation by lifting graphs to simplicial complexes, but typically requires performing message passing or attention on higher-order neural network representations. We introduce a representation learning paradigm that enriches graph representations with higher-order topology through positional encodings, enabling standard graph learning models to exploit lifted incidence structure without modifying the backbone. We derive a theoretical characterization of the expressivity of higher-order positional encodings, proving that node-level operators induced by higher-order lifts can mix graph Laplacian frequencies in ways that scalar graph spectral filters cannot. Guided by this theory, we instantiate higher-order positional encodings using Hodge Laplacians derived from clique complexes. Experiments with Graph Transformers on ZINC and controlled synthetic benchmarks demonstrate improvements in predictive performance, while a fixed-1-skeleton experiment shows that the pipeline can transmit higher-order information when cells are supplied independently of the graph. Together, our results establish higher-order positional encodings as a principled bridge between graph positional encodings and topological deep learning.

</details>


### [681] [Same Reward, Different Skills: When Multimodal RL Learns to Look](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01908)
*Haocun Ye,Xinlong Jiang,Qile Chen,Bingyu Wang,Teng Zhang,Shubai Chen,Tingyu Wu,Zhenkun Zheng,Yiqiang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"视觉可解性"设计准则（视觉证据对正确答案必需且任务可学），在反事实坐标场景上用标准GRPO训练7B模型，目标发现准确率从0.425提升至0.875，并通过灰底图与文字描述对照实验证明增益源于真实视觉学习信号而非提示中的图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR可提升视觉语言基准分数，但即使训练时不提供视觉信息也能获得提升，说明提示中的图像未必进入学习信号；同时长时间真实图像训练会侵蚀grounding能力。二者共同暴露同一缺口：图像存在于提示中不等于存在于学习信号中。因此需要明确的设计准则来保证训练真正依赖视觉证据。

Method: 提出"视觉可解性"设计准则：视觉证据必须是正确答案的必要条件，且任务保持可学习。据此构造反事实坐标场景任务，问题固定且目标从不被命名，正确答案必须通过图像定位目标。使用标准GRPO与正确性+格式奖励训练7B模型，并设置两组对照：将测试图像替换为灰色画布；以灰色画布训练并在匹配步数30与四个随机种子下测试真实图像。另加文字描述对照，在相同图像、奖励与预算下加入回答训练问题的描述。

Result: 7B模型在比训练场景更密集的留出场景上，目标发现准确率从0.425提升至0.875，并在未训练过的问题类型上也有提升。灰底测试图像使发现率降为零；灰底训练在30步与四个种子下基本无增益，即使随后用真实图像测试；所学技能可迁移到独立于训练语料构建的grounding任务；加入回答训练问题的描述后，增益减少近三分之二。

Conclusion: 仅当视觉证据是正确答案的必要条件时，强化学习才会真正学习视觉能力；改变奖励所要求的内容会改变RL学到的内容，验证了视觉可解性作为设计准则的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language benchmark scores even without visual information during training. With images at test, blind-trained models recover roughly half of the real-image gain at 3B and nearly four fifths at 7B. Prolonged real-image training can erode grounding while benchmark gains persist. Both findings expose the same gap: an image in the prompt is not an image in the learning signal. Our design rule, visual resolvability, asks that visual evidence be necessary for a correct answer and that the task remain learnable. We test it on counterfactual coordinate scenes in which the question stays fixed and the target is never named, so a correct answer requires finding the target in the image. With standard GRPO and correctness-and-format rewards, a 7B model raises its accuracy at finding the target (discovery) from 0.425 to 0.875 on held-out scenes denser than any it trained on, and it improves on question types it never trained on. Two controls locate the source of the gain. Replacing test images with gray canvases drops discovery to zero; training on gray canvases instead, at matched step 30 and in each of four seeds, yields essentially none of the gain even when the model is then tested with real images. The learned skill carries over to grounding tasks built independently of the training corpus. A caption that answers the training question, added to the same images, reward and budget, cuts the gain by nearly two thirds. Changing what reward requires changes what RL learns.

</details>


### [682] [Learning to Predict Distributions over Weight Updates for Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01934)
*Azal Ahmad Khan,Keshav Ramji,Tahira Naseem,Ali Anwar,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究仅用输入查询作为条件信号的 Hypernetwork 用于 LoRA 适配，并提出分布式 Hypernetwork，可生成 LoRA 参数分布而非单点估计，从而支持基于权重采样的测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Hypernetwork 多依赖任务描述或示例等额外信号来动态适配 LLM 参数，作者希望探究仅凭输入查询本身能提供多少适配信号，并进一步探索适配器分布带来的测试时扩展潜力。

Method: 提出 query-conditioned Hypernetwork 用于 LoRA 估计，并引入分布式 Hypernetwork，通过可微 Monte Carlo 近似的端到端损失进行训练，探索回归型与凸组合型等多种分布参数化方式。

Result: 即使仅使用学习分布的均值，也能优于确定性 Hypernetwork；采样权重更新可为同一查询生成多个适配模型，性能随采样数增加而提升，并优于对应的 token 采样适配基线；生成的更新还能跨查询迁移。

Conclusion: 查询条件化的权重更新分布可同时支持模型适配与测试时扩展，且 Hypernetwork 学习到了可复用的适配结构。

Abstract: Hypernetworks have recently shown success in dynamically adapting the parameters of Large Language Models (LLMs) at runtime based on signals such as task descriptions or additional demostrations. Here we ask: how much adaptation signal can be obtained using only the input query to an LLM?. To answer this, we study query-conditioned Hypernetworks for LoRA estimation. Further, we introduce distributional Hypernetworks, able to produce not only point estimates of parameter adaptors, but also a distribution over possible LoRAs. For this we propose a simple end-to-end loss using a differentiable Monte Carlo approximation and explore multiple distribution parametrizations including regression and convex combination variants. Results show that even using the mean of the learned distribution can outperform deterministic hypernetworks. Crucially, the learned distribution enables a different form of test-time scaling: instead of spending additional compute only by sampling more token sequences from a fixed model, we sample weight updates, yielding multiple adapted models for the same query. Performance improves as more weight samples are considered and remains stronger than corresponding token-sampling adaptation baselines. Finally, we find that generated updates can transfer across queries, suggesting that the hypernetwork learns reusable structure in how the model should adapt. Together, these results show that query-conditioned distributions over weight updates can support both adaptation and test-time scaling.

</details>


### [683] [Graph Representation via Elements of Discrete Morse and Cobordism Theories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01937)
*Jennifer Rozenblit,Chenguang Yang,Yuxin Liu,Yuzhou Chen,Yulia Gel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张低维拓扑（尤其离散Morse理论与cobordism理论）可为机器学习提供互补视角，并提出MG-Diff流水线，用Morse理论工具改进图扩散模型，同时在正决策间隙下给出稳定性理论保证，并在时空图预测与图再生任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑天然适合刻画非线性、多尺度、非平稳结构，但在机器学习中其应用基本局限于拓扑数据分析（TDA）。低维拓扑中大量工具（如Morse理论）仍几乎只停留在纯数学领域，对数据生成过程与学习任务的隐藏结构而言，是一类强大却几近未被探索的互补视角，因此作者希望把这类工具引入机器学习建模。

Method: 引入cobordism（配边）理论的概念，并利用离散Morse理论工具，构建流水线MG-Diff，将其用于为图扩散模型提供诱导式扩散引导（induced diffusion guidance）。方法上还推导理论保证与充分条件：在正决策间隙（positive decision-gap）条件下，Morse理论工具及其诱导扩散引导的应用在小扰动下保持稳定。

Result: 在正决策间隙假设下，证明了Morse理论工具及其诱导扩散引导在小扰动下的稳定性，给出的充分条件与理论保证成立；并在时空图预测（spatio-temporal graph forecasting）与图再生（graph regeneration）两个任务上展示了离散Morse理论应用于图扩散模型的实用效果。

Conclusion: 离散Morse理论能有效服务于图扩散模型，所提MG-Diff在时空图预测与图再生中体现价值；这些应用只是低维拓扑可为机器学习领域贡献的一小部分，作者认为其潜力远不止于此。

Abstract: Topology is, by its nature and design, suited to structure that is nonlinear, multiscale, and nonstationary - however, within machine learning, its use remains largely confined to topological data analysis. We advocate that tools from low-dimensional topology which have remained almost exclusively contained within the domain of pure mathematics (such as Morse theory) offer a strong, complementary, and yet virtually unexplored perspective on the hidden structure of data-generating processes and learning tasks built upon them. Here we introduce concepts from cobordism theory and harness tools from discrete Morse theory to improve the performance of graph diffusion models through our pipeline MG-Diff. Further, we derive theoretical guarantees and sufficient conditions so that under a positive decision-gap, the Morse-theoretic tools and their application for induced diffusion guidance are stable under small perturbations. Finally, we illustrate the utility of discrete Morse theory in application to graph diffusion models for spatio-temporal graph forecasting and graph regeneration, and argue that these applications are only a small window into the part of what low-dimensional topology can offer to the field of machine learning.

</details>


### [684] [Sharp Non-Asymptotic Analysis of the Penalized Challenger in $β$-EB-TCI for Bernoulli Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01951)
*Nam Nguyen,Tuan Quang Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Bernoulli臂top-two算法（β-EB-TCI）在固定置信度最佳臂识别中的非渐近行为，证明其停时达到T_β^⋆(μ)log(1/δ)，并给出高概率与期望样本复杂度结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Top-two算法虽简单有效，但其尖锐的非渐近行为（尤其是高概率界与期望样本复杂度）尚不清楚；本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 针对Jourdan等人的经验最优top-two规则β-EB-TCI（挑战者由带对数计数惩罚的Bernoulli运输代价选出）进行停时分析；证明经验领先者成为真实最优且采样比例接近β后，停时为T_β^⋆(μ)log(1/δ)加低阶集中项，且该阶段每个挑战者被线性采样；在此基础上推导所有唯一最优臂Bernoulli实例的高概率界，并借助有限均值充分探索条件得到尖锐期望复杂度。

Result: 得到停时T_β^⋆(μ)log(1/δ)的尖锐非渐近界；在充分探索条件下给出尖锐期望样本复杂度；对无强制探索的Bernoulli规则，在所有臂均值两两不同时得到尖锐期望结果；加入贡献O(√(Kt))拉动的温和强制探索后，得到任意臂数下的自包含期望样本复杂度定理。

Conclusion: 本文刻画了top-two算法的主要剩余难点是控制经验领先者何时永久正确；同时指出通过单一指标比较论证处理相等次优均值的证明策略存在局限。

Abstract: Top-two algorithms are simple and effective for fixed-confidence best-arm identification, but their sharp non-asymptotic behavior is still not well understood. We study this problem for Bernoulli bandits through $β$-EB-TCI, the empirical-best top-two rule of Jourdan et al., whose challenger is chosen using a Bernoulli transportation cost with a logarithmic count penalty. We prove that, after the empirical leader has become the true best arm and its sampling fraction stays close to $β$, the stopping time is $T_β^{\star}(μ)\log(1/δ)$ up to lower-order concentration terms. We also show that, in this regime, every challenger is sampled linearly often. Thus, for the original algorithm without forced exploration, the main remaining difficulty is to control when the empirical leader becomes permanently correct. These results imply a non-asymptotic high-probability bound for all Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm. If the algorithm satisfies a finite-mean sufficient-exploration condition, the bound further yields the sharp expected sample complexity. In particular, this gives the sharp expectation result for the unguarded Bernoulli rule when all arm means are pairwise distinct, using the sufficient-exploration result of Jourdan et al. Finally, if we add a mild forced-exploration rule that contributes only $O(\sqrt{Kt})$ pulls up to time $t$, we obtain a self-contained expected sample-complexity theorem for any number of arms under the unique-best-arm assumption. We also identify a limitation of proof strategies that try to handle equal suboptimal means through a single index-comparison argument.

</details>


### [685] [Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01955)
*Yusuf Afifi,Artur Kiulian,Anton Polishko,Mykola Khandoga,Hamudi Naanaa,Alina Krasnobrizha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个基于2100+个已结算Polymarket问题构建的智能体预测环境、数据集与评测框架，智能体在rollout时自主获取证据（网页搜索、页面阅读、金融时序，受分层泄露过滤约束），并用单轮GRPO以Brier分数为奖励训练Qwen3.5-35B-A3B；训练后校准提升30-40%，搜索次数由3.8降至2.25，且在相同评测框架下推理成本约为前沿模型的5%即可在基于证据的预测任务上超过所有测试的前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测类工作要么在训练前冻结研究上下文，要么仅在测试阶段进行agentic研究，导致"收集证据"这一技能从未被奖励信号塑造，模型无法学会如何在预测中有效检索与筛选信息。

Method: 构建基于2100+个已结算Polymarket问题的智能体预测环境、数据集与harness；智能体在rollout阶段自主获取上下文，包括网页搜索、页面阅读与金融时间序列，并通过分层泄露过滤仅允许访问每个问题截止时间之前发布的信息；对Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（3B激活参数）以单轮GRPO、Brier分数作为奖励进行训练。

Result: 训练改变了智能体与信息交互的方式：校准度提升30-40%，每次rollout的搜索次数从3.8降至2.25，体现出证据纪律的习得；在相同评测框架下与四个前沿模型对比，训练后的策略在基于证据的预测上领先于所有被测前沿模型，包括Claude Opus 4.5（soft-Brier 0.254 vs. 0.256，n=265），推理成本仅约5%；且在人群本身尚未形成定论的最难问题上优势最大。

Conclusion: 该工作将证据收集能力纳入奖励塑造，验证了端到端训练agentic预测技能的有效性，并以约5%推理成本取得超越前沿模型的表现；同时公开环境、数据集与逐rollout记录，作为可复用的时间预测智能体harness。

Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can train language models to forecast real-world events, but prior forecasting work either freezes research context before training or deploys agentic research only at test time, so the skill of gathering evidence is never shaped by the reward. We introduce an agentic forecasting environment, dataset, and harness built from 2,100+ resolved Polymarket questions; the agent acquires its own context at rollout time (web search, page reading, and financial time series, all restricted by layered leak filtering to information published before each question's cutoff), and we train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (3B active parameters) on it with single-epoch GRPO under a Brier-score reward. Training changes how the agent interacts with information: calibration improves 30-40%, and search attempts fall from 3.8 to 2.25 per rollout as evidence discipline is learned. Evaluated in an identical harness against four frontier models, the trained policy also finishes ahead of every frontier model tested at evidence-based forecasting, including Claude Opus 4.5 (soft-Brier 0.254 vs. 0.256, n=265), at about 5% of the inference cost, and its margin is widest on the hardest questions, the ones the crowd itself had not decided. We release the environment, dataset, and per-rollout records as a reusable harness for temporal forecasting agents.

</details>


### [686] [FastCI: Efficient GPU-Intensive CI for LLM Training Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01967)
*Tianshuo Qiao,Naiqian Zheng,Xiaopeng Liu,Shuguang Wang,Diandian Gu,Xuanzhe Liu,Xin Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FastCI 通过运行时证据选择受影响测试、剪枝等价上下文中的冗余测试、优先调度高风险测试并优化测试负载，在大模型训练框架的 CI 中实现时延降低 77.5%、GPU 资源节省 63.9%、修改代码覆盖率保留率提升 3.2%，并已部署于字节跳动 LLM 训练框架的 CI 流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型规模与复杂度持续增长，其训练框架迭代速度极快，持续集成（CI）对保障框架质量与稳定性至关重要。但与传统软件不同，LLM 训练框架的 CI 依赖 GPU 密集型测试（通常是完整模型训练或评估），导致 CI 本身成为快速迭代开发的瓶颈。

Method: FastCI 采用四项核心机制：1）利用运行时证据（runtime evidence）选择受变更影响的测试；2）剪枝在等价上下文中执行变更代码的测试；3）对高风险测试进行优先级排序，以更早暴露潜在失败；4）在各测试预期验证范围之外的维度上优化测试负载。

Result: 在实际 LLM 训练框架的 CI 工作负载上评测：相比当前部署的 CI 流水线，FastCI 将 CI 时延降低 77.5%，GPU 资源使用减少 63.9%，同时将修改代码覆盖率保留率（modified code coverage retention）提升 3.2%。

Conclusion: FastCI 有效缓解了 LLM 训练框架 CI 的 GPU 资源与时延瓶颈，在显著提升效率的同时未牺牲（甚至略提升）代码覆盖率保障，并已在字节跳动 LLM 训练框架的 CI 流水线中落地集成。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) keep growing in size and complexity, their training frameworks evolve at a rapid pace as well. Therefore, continuous integration (CI) is critical for maintaining the quality and stability of these frameworks. However, unlike traditional software, CI for LLM training frameworks relies on GPU-intensive tests, which usually involve complete model training or evaluation. This leads CI itself to become a new bottleneck for fast-paced development. In this paper, we introduce FastCI, a framework that improves the efficiency of CI for LLM training frameworks. FastCI leverages runtime evidence to select affected tests and prune tests that execute changed code in equivalent contexts. Then FastCI prioritizes high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and optimizes test workloads along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test. Evaluated on the CI workload of our LLM training framework, FastCI reduces the CI latency by 77.5% and the GPU resource usage by 63.9%, while improving the modified code coverage retention by 3.2%, compared with the currently deployed CI pipelines. FastCI has now been integrated into the CI pipelines of our LLM training framework at ByteDance.

</details>


### [687] [Sim+Real: Joint Simulation - Experiment Training Improves Balanced Prediction in Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01974)
*Mahindra Rautela,Alexander Scheinker,Ayan Biswas,Diane Oyen,Nathan DeBardeleben,Earl Lawrence*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将仿真-实验预测建模为多目标学习问题，在四个流体系统上比较了仅仿真、仅实验、仿真→实验微调与联合训练四种策略，发现联合训练在仿真与实验域间取得最佳平衡，并显著缓解仿真域遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真与实验测量为学习时空物理系统提供互补数据，但标准的"仿真→实验"微调仅在迁移后优化实验目标，导致仿真性能退化（仿真域遗忘）。因此需要一种能同时兼顾仿真与实验性能的学习框架。

Method: 将仿真-实验预测形式化为带有域特定仿真风险与实验风险的多目标学习问题。在RealPDEBench的四个流体系统和两种模型容量下，对比Simulation only、Experiment only、Sim→Exp、Joint training四种训练方式，并对每个最终模型在两个留出域上均进行评估，考察不同仿真-实验评估权重下的表现。

Result: Sim→Exp倾向于更强地特化于实验数据，代价是仿真域的遗忘。Joint training在较宽的仿真-实验评估权重范围内始终取得最佳平衡性能，同时相对Sim→Exp大幅提升仿真保留能力；联合训练还能更好地保留实验中未测量的纯仿真场。

Conclusion: 联合训练是兼顾仿真与实验域性能的有效策略，能缓解微调引起的仿真域遗忘，并在仿真-实验权衡中表现最优。项目主页：https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph。

Abstract: Simulation and experimental measurements provide complementary data for learning spatiotemporal physical systems, but standard simulation-to-experiment fine-tuning optimizes only the experimental objective after transfer and can degrade simulation performance. We formulate simulation--experiment prediction as a multi-objective learning problem with domain-specific simulation and experimental risks. On four fluid systems from RealPDEBench and two model capacities, we compare Simulation only, Experiment only, Sim$\rightarrow$Exp, and Joint training, evaluating every final model on both held-out domains. Sim$\rightarrow$Exp tends to specialize more strongly to experimental data at the cost of simulation-domain forgetting. Joint training consistently achieves the best balanced performance over a broad range of simulation--experiment evaluation weightings, while substantially improving simulation retention over Sim$\rightarrow$Exp. Joint also better preserves simulation-only fields absent from experimental measurements. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph.

</details>


### [688] [The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01980)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Alice E. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示了线性优化中决策聚焦学习的非光滑性在数据分布平均下呈现局部二次行为，推导出闭式曲率（正规扇壁上的矩阵值测度），提出仅需一次投影的可处理近似并证明其弱收敛，应用于决策感知的场景生成，在电池套利中较均匀分配降低30.8%的后悔值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性优化中优化器的不连续性导致小的成本误差可能不改变决策或将其移至不同顶点，决策聚焦学习的梯度/曲率分析因此困难。

Method: 证明逐点非光滑行为在数据分布平均后局部变为二次；推导闭式曲率，即支撑在正规扇壁上的矩阵值测度，仅依赖可行集、数据分布仅作为权重；提出可用一次到可行集投影计算的可处理近似，并证明其弱收敛到真实总体曲率。

Result: 实验验证了二次与弱收敛规律；在电池套利任务上相比均匀分配取得30.8%的后悔值改进。

Conclusion: 所提曲率理论与近似为决策聚焦学习提供了可处理工具，并成功应用于期望成本线性优化的决策感知场景生成。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.

</details>


### [689] [Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01981)
*Sibylle Marcotte,Joan Bruna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究深度自注意力模型在"对偶"机制下的表达能力：证明仅用两个冻结的单头残差softmax注意力块（高斯初始化投影矩阵），通过改变块的应用顺序、符号与持续时间，即可将任意N条n令牌序列的集合映射到任意另一集合，得到连续与有限深度下的通用插值保证，并刻画因果掩码带来的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用逼近性是学习架构能否受益于缩放律的必要定性性质，但现有结果通常依赖无限宽度极限。作者转而关注深度主导的"对偶"机制，受Looped Transformers等循环复用模型的启发，探讨在跨层强参数共享条件下，逼近能力能否完全由深度提供。

Method: 将通用逼近问题形式化为通用插值：寻找一组预先固定的、与输入输出集合无关的参数（每个参数定义一个注意力块），仅允许根据具体插值任务改变块的施加顺序、符号和持续时间。方法上采用残差softmax注意力，仅使用两个冻结的单头块，其投影矩阵为高斯初始化。

Result: 主结果证明，仅两个冻结的单头残差softmax注意力块即可实现上述通用插值，该结论在连续深度与有限深度两种设定下均成立。此外，论文刻画了因果掩码所施加的限制，并给出了相应的通用插值保证。

Conclusion: 深度本身即可为自注意力模型提供通用逼近能力，且无需无限宽度或依赖输入训练参数；参数共享的有限冻结块通过顺序、符号与持续时间的调度即可实现通用插值。因果掩码会带来一定限制，但在相应刻画下仍可获得通用插值保证。

Abstract: Universal approximation is a necessary qualitative property of learning architectures to benefit from scaling laws. While it is generically verified on a variety of neural architectures and random feature models, it typically involves infinite width limits. In this work, we focus on deep self-attention models and consider instead the `dual' regime, where approximation power is enabled entirely by depth, and featuring strong parameter sharing across layers, motivated by recent models such as the Looped Transformers. More specifically, we ask whether one can find a predefined finite set of parameters, each defining an attention block, such that the resulting finite set of transformations can map any collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens to any other collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens. Crucially, these transformations are \emph{fixed independently of the input and output} collections: only the order in which the blocks are applied, their signs, and their durations depend on the particular interpolation task. Our main result establishes it for residual softmax attention using only two frozen single-head blocks with Gaussian-initialized projection matrices. The result holds at both continuous and finite depth. We also characterize the restrictions imposed by causal masking and establish corresponding universal interpolation guarantees.

</details>


### [690] [Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02012)
*Tristan Shah,Wooyoung Chung,Volodomyr Makarenko,Juan Wachs,Stas Tiomkin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出F-CIP，一种仅由系统动力学定义的、无需变量选择的无监督强化学习内在动机目标，可实现平衡与可控性等基础行为的自主发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习依赖人工设计奖励信号，需针对每个新任务进行领域专家工程；无监督RL通过内在动机（IM）减少这种工程，但现有IM目标仍需选择信息变量，从而重新引入了本应消除的领域专业知识。

Method: 提出Forward CIP（F-CIP），对Controllable Information Production（CIP）目标进行RL原生形式化，其定义仅依赖系统动力学，无需选择信息变量；并证明F-CIP与RL兼容，可与现有算法结合使用。

Result: 使用F-CIP训练智能体可无监督地发现平衡、维持可控性等基础行为；结合简单的前向速度奖励，可产生跳跃、奔跑等协调步态，而这些行为原本需要奖励工程才能学会。

Conclusion: F-CIP提供了一种无需领域专家设计奖励信号的无监督RL路径，能够自主涌现基础及复杂机器人行为，减少奖励工程负担。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful paradigm for training agents, yet its success rests on domain expertise of human engineers who design informative reward signals for every new task. Unsupervised RL aims to reduce this engineering with intrinsic motivation (IM): reward signals that emerge from the agent environment interaction itself. Existing IM objectives, however, involve the selection of information variables, which re-introduces domain expertise the field has sought to eliminate. We introduce Forward CIP (F-CIP), an RL-native formulation of the Controllable Information Production (CIP) objective, which is defined by the system's dynamics alone and requires no such selection. We prove that F-CIP is compatible with RL and demonstrate its effectiveness with existing algorithms. Training agents with F-CIP results in unsupervised discovery of primitive behaviors such as balancing and maintaining controllability, which are essential for more complex robot behaviors. Paired with a simple forward-velocity reward, our method produces coordinated gaits such as hopping and running which otherwise require reward engineering to learn.

</details>


### [691] [BranchIP: Learning Adaptive Equivariant Computation for Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02013)
*Laura Zichi,Gil Harari,Chuin Wei Tan,Marc L. Descoteaux,Albert Zhu,Menghang Wang,Yoel Zimmermann,H. T. Kung,Boris Kozinsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BranchIP框架，通过学习自适应张量积计算并结合蒸馏损失训练单一模型，在保持物理精度的同时加速等变MLIP并减少显存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等变机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）虽革新了原子尺度建模，但精确处理复杂材料与分子体系需要昂贵模型，限制了模拟的时空尺度，其中张量积是主要计算瓶颈；近期基础规模MLIP的兴起进一步加剧该问题。

Method: 提出Branch Interatomic Potential（BranchIP），一个用于学习自适应张量积计算的单模型框架，并采用新颖的蒸馏损失进行训练。

Result: 在两个具物理意义体系（多相催化体系与质子传导固态酸电解质）上，跨模型规模最高加速2.4倍、显存降低2.6倍，同时保持物理保真度。

Conclusion: 学习的自适应计算提升了MLIP效率，并通过揭示哪些相互作用需要更深计算、计算深度如何关联化学复杂度与动力学，提供了模型可解释性。

Abstract: Equivariant machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have revolutionized atomistic modeling, but accurate treatment of complex materials and molecular systems demands expensive models. This limits simulation length- and time-scales, with tensor products a key computational bottleneck. The recent emergence of foundation-scale MLIPs further exacerbates this challenge. We present Branch Interatomic Potential (BranchIP), a single-model framework for learned adaptive tensor product computation, trained with a novel distillation loss. In our experiments on two systems of physical interest, a heterogeneous catalysis system and a proton-conducting solid acid electrolyte, BranchIP accelerates MLIPs across model sizes by up to $2.4\times$ while reducing memory usage by up to $2.6\times$. This is achieved while maintaining physical fidelity. Furthermore, the learned adaptive computation provides model interpretability by revealing which interactions demand deeper computation and showing how computational depth relates to chemical complexity and dynamics.

</details>


### [692] [On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02015)
*Michael Sullivan,Alexander Koller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM推理模型中的语言漂移现象：理论证明RLVR优化压力允许无界语言漂移而SFT不会，实证表明漂移源于在新颖推理任务上进行RLVR，并证明约束漂移必然损害期望奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR后训练使LLM具备强大推理能力，但其思维链（CoT）中日益出现非标准、无意义的语言使用（语言漂移），该现象虽被记录且可能损害CoT可监控性，但其成因尚不明确。本文旨在揭示语言漂移产生的条件。

Method: 结合理论分析与实证验证：理论上证明RLVR优化压力允许无界语言漂移，而监督微调（SFT）不允许；实证上考察语言漂移是否特定地出现在针对新颖推理任务（即目标行为无法从基座模型中引出）的RLVR过程中。

Result: 理论上证明RLVR优化压力可导致无界语言漂移而SFT不会；实证显示语言漂移专门在针对新颖推理任务进行RLVR时出现；并证明无法在不约束期望奖励的前提下约束语言漂移。

Conclusion: 在前沿RLVR后训练中，提升CoT可监控性与保持性能之间存在固有张力：约束语言漂移必然损害期望奖励，因此二者无法兼得。

Abstract: Recent advances in LLM reasoning models---driven primarily by the paradigm of post-training via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR)---have enabled them to accomplish impressively complex tasks. However, in parallel with their rising capabilities, LLMs have increasingly displayed signs of language drift in their chains of thought (CoTs): unusual, non-standard, and seemingly nonsensical language use. Although it is well-documented---and can potentially impair CoT monitorability---the causes of language drift are thus far poorly understood. In this paper, we identify the conditions under which language drift occurs: we prove theoretically that RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift, while supervised fine-tuning does not. We then show empirically that language drift specifically arises during RLVR on novel reasoning tasks---i.e. when the target behavior cannot be drawn out of the base model. Finally, we prove that it is not possible to constrain language drift without constraining expected reward, suggesting that CoT monitorability cannot be improved without harming performance during RLVR post-training at the frontier.

</details>


### [693] [Relative Transitions, Not Absolute Destinations: A Transfer-and-Ground Framework for Target-Trajectory-Free Human Mobility Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02033)
*Yidi Wang,Yunhe Zhang,Bangchao Deng,Dingqi Yang,Pengyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究"无目标轨迹"的轨迹生成问题：仅利用源城市轨迹与目标城市POI坐标和类别，提出Nomad框架，将轨迹生成分解为"学习相对转移先验"与"在目标POI图上落地"两步，在十个城市、14组迁移实验中于分布保真度和下游效用上均优于适配基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹生成器大多依赖部署城市自身的观测数据，因而恰恰无法服务于那些缺乏轨迹数据、但POI可从公开地图获取的城市。作者希望在不使用目标城市任何轨迹或轨迹派生统计量的前提下，实现跨城市可迁移的轨迹生成。

Method: 提出Nomad，一个"迁移-落地"（transfer-and-ground）框架，把"人如何移动"与"移动在何处实现"解耦。训练阶段，用历史条件化的流匹配模型从源城市轨迹中学习转移先验，其输出为语义位移（POI上下文之间）、地理位移与经过时间；推理阶段，通过行为图与"探索-返回"游走，将采样到的转移落到目标城市POI地图上，从而避免预测与城市绑定的绝对目的地。

Result: 在十个城市、14组迁移设置上的大量实验表明，Nomad在轨迹保真度与下游效用上均优于各类适配基线；相较各指标最优基线，分布保真度平均误差降低约15%，下游效用平均误差降低约3%。

Conclusion: 用上下文条件化的相对转移替代城市绑定的绝对目的地预测，可在不假设完整移动分布不变的前提下直接检验表示层面的可迁移性，为缺乏轨迹数据的目标城市提供了可行的轨迹生成方案。

Abstract: Individual mobility trajectories support urban analysis and location-based services, yet most trajectory generators require observations from their deployment city. This assumption excludes precisely the cities where trajectories are unavailable even though points of interest (POIs) and their attributes can be obtained from public maps. We study target-trajectory-free generation: learning from POIs and trajectories in source cities while utilizing only POI coordinates and categories in a target city, with no target trajectory or trajectory-derived statistic available for training, model selection, or generation. Existing trajectory generators typically predict absolute destinations, entangling reusable movement behavior with city-specific POI identities and spatial layouts. Our core insight is to replace this city-bound output with context-conditioned relative transitions. We propose Nomad, a transfer-and-ground framework that separates learning how people move from determining where those movements are realized. Specifically, a history-conditioned flow-matching model learns from source trajectories a transition prior over semantic displacement between POI contexts, geographic displacement, and elapsed time; at inference, a behavior graph and an exploration--return walk ground sampled transitions onto the target POI map. This factorization enables a direct test of representation level transferability without assuming invariance of the full mobility distribution. Extensive experiments across ten cities and 14 transfers show that Nomad outperforms adaptation baselines in trajectory fidelity and downstream utility, lowering the average error over the best baseline of each metric by about 15% in distributional fidelity and about 3% in downstream utility.

</details>


### [694] [Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02043)
*Jinhwan Sul,Panagiotis Theodoropoulos,Vincent Pacelli,Jaemoo Choi,Evangelos Theodorou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分布鲁棒薛定谔桥（DRSB），在初始分布存在不确定性时学习单一控制器，最小化最坏情况下的控制能量与终端分布KL惩罚目标，并给出交替优化算法及Wasserstein、Sinkhorn两种变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准薛定谔桥在测试时若初始分布发生偏移，学到的动力学可能无法恢复目标分布，因此需要一种对初始分布不确定性具有鲁棒性的传输方法。

Method: DRSB目标由控制能量与终端分布和目标分布之间的KL惩罚组成；在名义分布周围的模糊集内寻找使最坏情况目标最小的单一控制器。作者推导了该目标的精确变分形式，并将固定终端成本子问题与随机最优控制及分布鲁棒优化相联系，进而提出交替算法：更新对抗性初始分布、估计终端对数密度比、训练控制器。基于随机控制最优性条件，提出Wasserstein与Sinkhorn变体以近似对抗更新所需梯度。

Result: 在二维传输任务与图像到图像翻译任务上，DRSB相较标准SB对输入扰动表现出更好的鲁棒性，但名义性能有所折衷；在高斯混合传输上，Sinkhorn DRSB在两个未见噪声水平下的平均切片Wasserstein距离均低于固定水平噪声增强方法。

Conclusion: DRSB通过在初始分布模糊集上优化最坏情况目标，为初始分布偏移下的随机传输提供了鲁棒框架，但需在鲁棒性与名义性能之间权衡。

Abstract: Schrödinger bridge (SB) learns stochastic transport between prescribed initial and target distributions. When the initial distribution shifts at test time, the learned dynamics can fail to recover the target distribution. We introduce the Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge (DRSB), which learns a single controller that accounts for uncertainty in the initial distribution. The DRSB objective consists of control energy and a KL penalty between the resulting terminal distribution and the target distribution. DRSB seeks a single controller that minimizes the worst-case value of this objective as the initial distribution varies within an ambiguity set around the nominal distribution. We derive an exact variational formulation of this objective and connect its fixed-terminal-cost subproblem to stochastic optimal control and distributionally robust optimization. This formulation motivates an alternating algorithm that updates the adversarial initial distribution, estimates the terminal log-density ratio, and trains the controller. We develop Wasserstein and Sinkhorn variants using stochastic control optimality conditions to approximate the gradients required for adversarial updates. Experiments on two-dimensional transport tasks and image-to-image translation show improved robustness to input perturbations relative to standard SB, with a tradeoff in nominal performance. On Gaussian mixture transport, Sinkhorn DRSB also achieves lower mean sliced Wasserstein distance than fixed-level noise augmentation at both tested unseen noise levels.

</details>


### [695] [Foundations without Fundamentals: Zero-Shot Blind Spots in Time Series FMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02058)
*Nafiseh Ghoroghchian,Haipeng Zhang,Shuyi Han,Alex Labach,George Stein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SimpleTimeBench 诊断基准，发现主流多元时间序列基础模型（Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto）在单调趋势、周期信号、领先指示变量等"平凡"任务上零样本预测表现不佳，且微调会损害其他基础模式，说明预训练规模与基础时序推理能力之间存在鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在广泛基准上取得成功，但其是否真正内化了基础时序逻辑（尤其在有外生协变量支持时）尚未被充分检验。作者希望探究这些模型是否具备捕捉简单可预测函数所需的归纳偏置。

Method: 提出 SimpleTimeBench，一个针对单元与多元时序"单元测试"式的诊断套件，覆盖单调趋势、周期信号、领先指示协变量等本应近乎完美预测的基础原语场景；对 Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto 等主流多元 TSFM 进行零样本评估，并对 Chronos-2 进行微调对比。

Result: 主流多元 TSFM 在这些简单输入上频繁给出次优的零样本预测；微调 Chronos-2 虽能改善特定任务，却会削弱其他基础模式的表现，而非提升可泛化的基础能力；这些失败并非合成数据的特例，在真实传感器预测中同样存在，模型持续未能有效利用观测协变量中的领先指示变量。

Conclusion: 当前 TSFM 存在预训练规模与基础时序推理之间的能力鸿沟，可能缺乏捕捉简单可预测函数所需的归纳偏置；无法利用简单关系限制了现有多元模型的实用性与可靠性。

Abstract: Despite the success of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) on broad benchmarks, their ability to internalize basic temporal logic, especially in settings supported by exogenous covariates, remains under-examined. We introduce SimpleTimeBench, a diagnostic univariate and multivariate "unit test" suite for primitives such as monotonic trends, periodic signals and leading indicator covariates, scenarios where near-perfect forecasts should be trivial. Surprisingly, prominent multivariate TSFMs (Chronos-2, Moirai and Toto) frequently produce suboptimal zero-shot forecasts for these inputs. While fine-tuning Chronos-2 improves its behaviour on specific tasks, we show that this adaptation degrades performance on other fundamental patterns rather than enhancing its generalizable foundational capabilities. This reveals a gap between pre-training scale and basic temporal reasoning, suggesting that current TSFMs could potentially lack the inductive biases needed to capture simple predictable functions. We further demonstrate that these failures are not merely synthetic curiosities: they persist in real-world sensor forecasting, where TSFMs consistently underutilize leading indicators available in observed covariates. This inability to capture simple relationships limits the practical utility and reliability of current multivariate models.

</details>


### [696] [Learn the Directions, Normalize the Gains: Post-Training Normalization for LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02067)
*Zailong Tian,Yanzhe Chen,Zhuoheng Han,Houfeng Wang,Lizi Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出LoRA更新存在"适配失衡"（少数奇异方向主导），提出免训练、无推理开销的后处理归一化方法LoRA-Norm，通过谱重平衡与核范数恢复在保留方向的同时重新分配增益，在多种骨干与任务上同时提升专业化与能力保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA虽能高效实现任务特化，但其学得的更新会损害目标任务之外的能力。作者识别出"适配失衡"现象：少数奇异方向主导了训练所得更新，使性能对增益分配方式敏感。核心洞见是"学会在哪里适配"并不保证"适配增益被良好平衡"，因此需要在训练之外对增益分配进行纠正。

Method: 提出LoRA-Norm，一种训练后归一化方法：在保留已学得方向的前提下重新平衡其增益。方法包含两部分——谱重平衡（对奇异值施加固定的非线性变换）与核范数恢复（保持原有总谱质量不变）。该方法无需校准数据、无需额外训练，也不引入推理开销。

Result: 在两个骨干网络和三个适配任务上，LoRA-Norm提升了平均任务专业化与能力保持，且在两项指标上均优于所评估的事后谱剪枝与梯度引导编辑配置。此外，更强的函数等化并未带来一致收益，说明"平衡适配器增益"与"等化其响应"是不同目标。

Conclusion: 适配失衡是LoRA更新的关键问题，仅优化适配位置不足以保证增益均衡。LoRA-Norm以零成本后处理方式有效缓解该问题，实现专业化与通用能力的更优权衡；同时表明增益平衡与响应等化应作为两个独立目标加以区分。

Abstract: While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient task specialization, its learned updates can compromise capabilities beyond the target task. We identify \textbf{adaptation imbalance}: a few singular directions dominate the trained update, leaving its performance sensitive to how gains are allocated. We argue that \textbf{learning where to adapt does not ensure that adaptation gains are well balanced}. This motivates \textbf{LoRA-Norm}, a post-training normalization method that retains learned directions while rebalancing their gains. LoRA-Norm combines spectral rebalancing, a fixed nonlinear transformation of singular values, with nuclear-norm restoration, which preserves the original total spectral mass. It requires no calibration data or additional training and introduces no inference overhead. Across two backbones and three adaptation tasks, LoRA-Norm improves average specialization and capability retention, outperforming the evaluated post-hoc spectral pruning and gradient-guided editing configurations on both measures. Stronger functional equalization brings no consistent additional gains, revealing that balancing adapter gains and equalizing their responses are distinct objectives.

</details>


### [697] [Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02098)
*Chuqin Geng,Li Zhang,Haolin Ye,Mark Zhang,Luke Zhang,Xujie Si*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示机制可解释性中"干预定义的忠实度"目标本身存在缺陷：它可能偏好一个行为复现更差的等大电路，形成目标层面的恢复差距，说明仅改进发现算法不够。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化电路发现通常被当作搜索问题，隐含假设"更好的归因或优化就能找到更好的机制"。但这一假设依赖一个前提：评估目标本身能识别出更好的电路。作者质疑该前提是否成立。

Method: 在4个人类参考任务及InterpBench上，固定采用普通重采样，比较"验证忠实度"与"留出提示上的行为表现"。行为标准为与完整模型的一致性（包含其错误），仅在Greater-Than任务上使用语义准确率。通过受控参考编辑检验误排序，并复现EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP四种方法。进一步以"上下文失真"作为解释，将受赠者完整模型执行中被剔除的信号恢复，验证其能否修复误排序。

Result: 受控参考编辑在无任何发现算法参与下即显示误排序；EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP输出呈现同样失败。重采样下，KL在人类参考任务上对9.4%–41.2%的候选对产生误排序。恢复被剔除信号后，在验证集与留出提示上修复了发现池中100个持续KL误排序中的96个，而电路及其原始行为分数保持不变。

Conclusion: 干预定义的忠实度会因其目标奖励错误候选而导致恢复差距；上下文失真是其重要机制。当评估目标本身偏向错误电路时，仅靠更优的发现算法不足以解决问题。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to recover the internal computations responsible for model behavior. Progress in automated circuit discovery is often framed as a search problem: better attribution or optimization should identify better mechanisms. This assumes that the evaluation objective can recognize a better circuit once it is found. We show that intervention-defined faithfulness can instead prefer an equally sized circuit that reproduces the model's behavior less well, creating an objective-level recovery gap. Across four human-reference tasks and InterpBench, we compare validation faithfulness with behavior on held-out prompts under fixed ordinary resampling. The behavioral criterion is agreement with the intact model, including its mistakes, except on Greater-Than, where we use semantic accuracy. Controlled reference edits reveal misranking without any discovery algorithm, and outputs of EAP, EAP-IG, ACDC, and Edge-SP exhibit the same failure. Under resampling, KL misranks 9.4%-41.2% of candidate pairs across these methods on the human-reference tasks. We investigate context distortion as an explanation: replacing excluded signals changes the inputs on which retained components operate. Restoring selected signals from the recipient's intact-model execution repairs 96 of 100 persistent KL misrankings from the discovery pool on both validation and held-out prompts. The circuits and their original behavioral scores remain unchanged. These findings show why better discovery alone is insufficient when its objective rewards the wrong candidate.

</details>


### [698] [Local Support Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02126)
*Assaf Ben-Kish,Akarsh Kumar,James Glass,Raja Giryes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将灾难性遗忘视为各权重矩阵输入空间中的几何问题，提出Local Support Learning (LSL) 框架：在微调时同时训练一个权重适配器和一个基于高斯混合模型(GMM)的门控函数，使更新仅作用于当前阶段的数据分布，从而在无历史数据条件下保留旧能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在持续学习新任务时会出现灾难性遗忘。作者从几何视角审视遗忘问题，发现梯度优化器在一种自然的"保持目标"下所产生的更新是次优的，说明现有基于梯度的训练方式本身在保留旧能力方面存在结构性缺陷，因此需要新的训练范式。

Method: 提出LSL通用框架，在不访问旧数据的前提下增强梯度训练。其核心是解耦两个组件：一是常规权重适配器，照常最小化损失；二是门控函数，仅在属于自身训练分布的输入激活上启用适配器，使权重更新具备局部性。为让该门控在只训练当前阶段数据的情况下仍能正确路由所有阶段的数据，采用高斯混合模型(GMM)构建门控，其似然在远离训练数据时迅速衰减，从而自然地对历史阶段数据保持关闭。

Result: 该方法能够解决参数量达70亿的LLM中的遗忘问题，在多个训练阶段上同时保留预训练能力与微调能力；在内存与计算上高效，对超参数选择稳健，并展现出可扩展的潜力。

Conclusion: LSL是一种后训练阶段的通用方案，通过将遗忘建模为输入空间的几何问题并借助GMM门控实现局部化更新，有效缓解了大模型持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，兼顾效果、效率与鲁棒性。

Abstract: We explore catastrophic forgetting in the context of large pre-trained models. By considering forgetting as a geometric problem in the input space of each weight matrix, we uncover a natural retention objective under which updates produced by gradient-based optimizers are suboptimal. Following this observation, we propose Local Support Learning (LSL), a general-purpose framework that augments gradient-based training for retention of prior capabilities without access to prior data. During a new learning phase, LSL pairs two components with distinct roles: a standard weight adapter, trained as usual to minimize the loss, and a gating function that enables the adapter only on input activations from its own training distribution, making the update local to that distribution. The key challenge is that this gate must route data from all learning phases while training only on data from the current one. We address this with a gate based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), whose likelihood decays rapidly away from its training data, giving it a natural tendency to stay closed on data from prior phases. We show that this post-training approach can resolve forgetting in LLMs of up to 7 billion parameters, retaining both pretrained and finetuned capabilities across multiple training phases, while being efficient in memory and compute, robust to hyperparameter choice, and showing scaling potential.

</details>


### [699] [Linear Programming Representations and Strongly Polynomial Algorithms for Robust Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02131)
*Han Zhong,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究有理多面体状态-动作矩形不确定奖励与转移下RMDP的LP表示与强多项式算法，构造单一LP恢复鲁棒最优值及全部最优平稳随机策略，并对鲁棒策略迭代给出通用复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）在不确定环境中具有重要应用，但现有工作缺乏对其线性规划表示的统一刻画，且对一般多面体不确定性集合的强多项式复杂度界尚不完善，尤其$\ell_1$、$\ell_\infty$以外的不确定性集合缺乏紧致界。

Method: 通过编码有限步鲁棒策略迭代序列，构造一个单一线性规划，其最优解可恢复鲁棒最优值与所有最优平稳随机策略；在固定折扣下，该LP具有多项式维数和编码长度，并可在强多项式时间内构造。同时提出鲁棒策略迭代的通用复杂度分析，将不确定集合上最小化代价与策略评估所需迭代次数相结合。

Result: 该LP在固定折扣下可在强多项式时间内构造；通用复杂度分析改进了$\ell_1$和$\ell_\infty$ RMDP的已知复杂度界，并为一般区间、加权$\ell_1$、Wasserstein RMDP以及具备这些不确定集合的回合制随机博弈建立了新的强多项式界。

Conclusion: 该工作为多面体不确定RMDP提供了统一的LP表示与强多项式算法框架，扩展了强多项式可解的不确定性集合类，并推进了RMDP及随机博弈的复杂度理论。

Abstract: We study linear programming (LP) representations and strongly polynomial algorithms for robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) with rational polyhedral state-action rectangular uncertainty in rewards and transitions. By encoding a finite sequence of robust policy-iteration steps, we construct a single LP whose optimal solutions recover the robust optimal value and all optimal stationary randomized policies. At fixed discount, the LP has polynomial dimension and encoding length and can be constructed in strongly polynomial time. We also develop a general complexity analysis of robust policy iteration that combines the cost of minimizing over uncertainty sets with the number of iterations needed to evaluate a policy. For a fixed discount factor, we use this analysis to improve the known complexity bounds for $\ell_1$ and $\ell_\infty$ RMDPs and establish new strongly polynomial bounds for general interval, weighted $\ell_1$, and Wasserstein RMDPs, as well as turn-based stochastic games with these uncertainty sets.

</details>


### [700] [Faynt: Scaling and Optimizing Policies for Competitive Melee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02144)
*Ali Janati,Nikita Kuzmin,Rohit Swamy,Charles Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Faynt系列Transformer策略（10M与75M参数），单一checkpoint控制《任天堂明星大乱斗DX》全部26个角色；经RL后10M在同角色对战中胜率98.4%，并在零延迟条件下全胜私有Slippi-AI模型；同时开源权重、基准与自动锦标赛平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对战AI多依赖角色专用模型且带有额外动作延迟，缺乏统一、可复现的多角色策略与规模化训练范式，作者希望用单一checkpoint覆盖全角色并系统性研究架构、优化、规模缩放与超参迁移。

Method: 基于约84万人类录像进行预训练；研究架构、优化、scaling与超参数迁移；后训练结合排名与结果驱动的课程学习、75M到10M蒸馏，以及在Fox镜像对局上的RL；推理在NVIDIA T4上优化。

Result: 10M模型对14个专家及多角色版本取得240/244（98.4%）胜率且对所有版本保持胜绩；对私有零延迟Slippi-AI在两种条件设置下68局全胜；初始152局基准上监督10M胜率69.7%，高于预训练75M的45.4%，尽管其留出控制器预测损失更高；加权验证损失与四种策略胜率排序一致；监督后训练后伤害更低、早期领先更大、首命失利后翻盘更多；推理平均每决策5.2ms（10M）与8.7ms（75M）。

Conclusion: 单checkpoint多角色Transformer策略可超越带延迟的专家对手，且小模型经蒸馏与后训练在胜率上优于大模型，加权验证损失可有效用于监督checkpoint选择；作者开源权重、两套基准与自动锦标赛平台以推动可复现研究。

Abstract: We introduce Faynt, a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee, each controlling all 26 characters with a single checkpoint. After reinforcement learning (RL), the 10M wins 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen specialist and multi-character releases on their supported rosters, with a winning record against every release. These opponents retain 21- or 24-frame action delays; Faynt uses no added delay, and we have not isolated the effect of this difference. In a separate evaluation against a privately supplied zero-delay Slippi-AI model, the 10M wins all 68 games across two conditioning settings. We study architecture, optimization, scaling, and hyperparameter transfer to guide pretraining on approximately 840,000 human replays. Post-training combines rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and RL restricted to Fox mirror matches. On the initial 152-game benchmark, the supervised 10M wins 69.7% of games, compared with 45.4% for the pretrained 75M, despite higher overall held-out controller-prediction loss. The weighted validation loss used for supervised checkpoint selection agrees with the win-rate ordering of all four pretrained and supervised policies. After supervised post-training, both models take less damage per minute, build larger early leads, and win more often after losing the first life. Optimized inference on recorded game states averages 5.2 ms per decision for the 10M and 8.7 ms for the 75M on an NVIDIA T4, excluding emulator execution and communication. We open-source the weights, both benchmark suites, and a platform for automated model tournaments.

</details>


### [701] [Muon meets Tamed Langevin: Momentum Preconditioning beyond Convex and gradient-Lipschitz Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02158)
*Nikolaos Makras,Sotirios Sabanis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非凸且非全局梯度Lipschitz势能下矩阵空间Gibbs分布的采样问题，提出一类非二次动能构造的新型动量预条件欠阻尼Langevin系统，并证明其收敛性与离散算法稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典欠阻尼Langevin采样算法通常依赖势能凸性或全局梯度Lipschitz假设，因而无法处理矩阵空间中既非凸又梯度不全局Lipschitz的Gibbs分布采样问题。本文旨在放松这些假设，拓展可采样分布的范围。

Method: 引入一族非二次动能，构造带动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin系统，其中动能梯度充当对动量的光滑谱"驯化"（spectral taming）；并在放松的势能假设下分析连续动力学的性质及Euler-Maruyama离散化。

Result: 证明该动力学保持目标Gibbs测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下指数收敛至平衡；同时证明对应Euler-Maruyama离散化具有关于时间一致的矩界，且无需对势能梯度作任何修正。

Conclusion: 所提非二次动能与动量预条件框架在非凸、非全局梯度Lipschitz势能下为矩阵空间Gibbs采样提供了具理论保证的稳定算法。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions on matrix spaces whose potential energies are neither convex nor globally gradient-Lipschitz. We introduce a family of non-quadratic kinetic energies that lead to a new underdamped Langevin system with momentum preconditioning, in which the gradient of the kinetic energy acts as a smooth spectral taming of the momentum. We prove that, under these relaxed assumptions on the potential, the resulting dynamics leaves the target Gibbs measure invariant, and we establish exponential convergence to equilibrium in a weighted total variation distance. Finally, we show that the corresponding Euler-Maruyama discretization admits moment bounds that are uniform in time, without any modification of the potential gradient, which ensures the stability of the resulting sampling algorithm.

</details>


### [702] [When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02159)
*Scott W. Viteri,Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez,Clark Barrett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出以"反事实信息"为核心的形式化探索准则，通过构造单一环境证明计数、预测误差、empowerment与信息增益等内在奖励的最优策略在该准则下可能帕累托次优，并给出其成功的条件及改进目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内在奖励（预测误差、学习进步等）被广泛用于引导强化学习中的探索，但最大化这些奖励并不必然产生最具信息量的经验，缺乏统一标准来评判探索质量。

Method: 提出基于反事实信息的探索准则：比较不同策略所获取的信息，即其历史轨迹在多大程度上可替代替代策略下的经验；据此构造一个简单环境，检验计数型、预测误差型、empowerment和信息增益目标的最优策略表现，并分析其失效原因与成立条件，进而设计新目标函数。

Result: 在构造的单一环境中，指定形式的多类内在奖励其最大化策略在反事实信息获取上均为帕累托次优；论文阐明了这些失败的原因，给出了内在奖励能够鼓励最优探索的条件，并构造出一个在探索严格改进时赋予更高价值的新目标。

Conclusion: 反事实信息为探索提供了统一的形式化评判标准，揭示主流内在奖励的局限；所提条件与目标函数为设计更优的探索奖励提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, simple environment in which specified count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, and information-gain objectives have maximizing policies that are Pareto-suboptimal at acquiring counterfactual information. We explain these failures and establish conditions under which existing intrinsic rewards successfully encourage optimal exploration. We also construct an objective that assigns a higher value whenever exploration strictly improves under our criterion.

</details>


### [703] [Effective Resistance and Graph Neural Network Reliability in Tissue-Specific Interactomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02175)
*Jianru Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验组织特异性互作结构中的有效电阻是否能提供"哪些预测不可信"的信息。结果显示有效电阻被度数的倒数主导（Spearman -0.955），但扣除该退化极限后的残差在24个网络中的19个能解释额外逐节点损失，且效应随深度单调增强，不过对选择性预测的改善微乎其微。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质功能注释不仅需要知道模型预测什么，还需要知道哪些预测不可信。作者希望探究组织特异性互作结构是否携带这种"不可信度"信息。

Method: 以有效电阻（effective resistance，此前用于通过重连缓解过挤压）作为候选信号，在24个组织特异性互作组中分析。将其与度数倒数对比、与度保持零模型图对比，并在控制预测熵、度数、注释基数、局部结构和仅特征难度后，检验残差对逐节点损失的额外解释力，同时减去置换下限。

Result: 有效电阻在24个网络中均被度数倒数主导，且随共表达过滤网络增大而退化加深（Spearman -0.955）。残差对退化极限的偏离在全部24个网络中超过度保持零图。控制多种因素后，残差在24个留出网络中的19个解释了额外逐节点损失，且在每个深度均成立并随深度单调增强。增量达控制变量未解释方差的0.37%，为置换下限的5.6倍；而在度保持零世界中重训模型时仅为1.5倍。选择性预测改善可忽略。

Conclusion: 该信号具有可复现性，但受度数退化限制。

Abstract: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. The increment reaches 0.37% of the variance the controls leave unexplained, 5.6 times a permutation floor, against 1.5 times when the model is retrained in a degree-preserving null world. Selective prediction improves negligibly. The signal is reproducible; degree degeneration bounds it.

</details>


### [704] [From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02179)
*Siqi Zhu,Suozhi Huang,Kaixuan Zhang,Yuheng Yang,Zhanyang Jin,Yihang Sun,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）中教师信号如何影响参数变化，发现损失平均方式、Adam一阶矩、BF16舍入及top-64 KL梯度等因素共同决定教师信号的实际作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOPD旨在将多个RL训练教师的能力整合到单一学生模型中，但教师信号如何影响参数变化尚缺乏深入理解，本文希望填补这一空白。

Method: 以Qwen3-1.7B为研究对象，使用从其同一初始化出发经RL训练的四个领域教师，对比梯度、优化器更新与任务学习曲线，并辅以SmolLM3-3B诊断。

Result: 发现四类现象：(1) 损失平均隐含地加权响应，token平均偏向长响应，等化领域贡献仍保留领域内加权；(2) Adam一阶矩削弱参数更新差异，教师间余弦相似度0.83，平均规则间0.96，尽管原始梯度不同；(3) BF16舍入掩盖微小变化，约97%的FP32主权重偏离初始化，仅7–11%的BF16权重如此；(4) top-64交集KL梯度与Qwen全词表梯度高度吻合，但对任务性能的影响取决于平均方式：响应平均下数学准确率比采样token策略梯度(PG)高2.6分，全局token平均下则低2.1分。

Conclusion: 教师信号的有效性受损失平均、优化器动态、数值精度与梯度近似方式的多重调节；top-64 KL梯度可作为全词表梯度的有效近似，但其收益高度依赖平均策略。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored. We study Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the same initialization as the student, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics. We find that several factors influence teacher signals. First, loss averaging implicitly weights responses: token averaging favors longer responses, and equalizing domain contributions retains this weighting within domains. Second, Adam's first moment reduces differences in parameter updates: the cosine similarity is 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules, despite differences in raw gradients. Third, BF16 rounding hides small changes: about 97\% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization, but only 7--11\% of BF16 weights do. Finally, the top-64 intersection KL gradient closely matches Qwen's full-vocabulary gradient, but the effect on task performance depends on averaging: mathematics accuracy is 2.6 points higher than with sampled-token policy-gradient (PG) under response averaging and 2.1 points lower under global token averaging.

</details>


### [705] [SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02182)
*Joohwan Ko,Tetiana Parshakova,Diana Cai,Robert M. Gower*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SoftServe: 一类无需线搜索或曲率修正的拟牛顿方法，通过变分目标导出正定曲率估计，提供对角与Kronecker分解变体，并利用耦合Newton-Schulz迭代实现GPU友好运算，在病态问题上优于Adam、Muon、SOAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拟牛顿方法在大规模无约束凸优化中高效，但用于深度学习受限于两个障碍：非凸性与超大参数量。

Method: 基于Berglund等(2025)的变分目标导出正定曲率估计（即使存在负曲率）；开发对角和Kronecker分解变体，构造上保持正定性并可扩展至超大神经网络；采用稳定的耦合Newton-Schulz迭代完成矩阵运算，用GPU友好的矩阵乘法替代昂贵的矩阵分解。

Result: 在严重病态问题上表现优异，包括循环网络、深度自编码器、物理信息神经网络及1.36亿参数的物理信息扩散模型，常取得低于Adam、Muon、SOAP等基线的损失。

Conclusion: SoftServe克服了拟牛顿方法在深度学习中的非凸与规模障碍，无需线搜索，可扩展且适配GPU，在病态任务上优于主流优化器。

Abstract: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent networks, deep autoencoders, physics-informed neural networks, and a 136M-parameter physics-informed diffusion model, often achieving lower losses than established baselines including Adam, Muon, and SOAP.

</details>


### [706] [Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02185)
*Weihao Liu,Huangjie Zheng,Tianrong Chen,Rohit Dilip,Richard He Bai,Yizhu Jiao,Yuyang Wang,Ruixiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoopCD是一种免训练的对比解码框架，利用循环Transformer的中间循环状态作为弱预测，与最终强预测对比来引导解码，在提升性能的同时减少推理计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer靠反复执行共享块实现参数高效，每个循环都产生一个可解码同一next token的中间表示，但标准解码丢弃了早期状态。由于早期循环计算量更少，这种循环结构天然提供了对齐的弱-强预测对，无需辅助模型或额外训练即可利用。

Method: 提出LoopCD，通过在最终预测与较早的循环预测之间进行对比来引导token选择。它有两种模式：LoopCD-Logits在logit空间操作，额外增加一次输出前向；LoopCD-Hidden在隐状态空间操作，无额外输出开销。

Result: 在四类循环Transformer系列上，LoopCD在完整循环深度下均取得显著且一致的提升：LoopCD-Logits将Ouro-2.6B-Thinking的AIME 2024 pass@1从61.88%提升到73.33%；LoopCD-Hidden将Huginn的HumanEval pass@1从22.56%提升到31.71%。这些增益使循环数减半仍能匹配或超过未引导的全深度基线，减少前向FLOPs 22.5%至48.2%。

Conclusion: LoopCD将循环中间状态转化为有效的引导信号，在实现更优解码质量的同时大幅降低推理计算。

Abstract: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.

</details>


### [707] [Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02186)
*Yiming Huang,Yujie Zeng,Vijay Prakash Dwivedi,Simone Foti,Jianmin Wang,Jure Leskovec,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出高阶语法表示（HGR），将分子提升为组合复形并用上下文无关高阶文法解析为产生式规则序列，从而实现拓扑感知的高效序列化表示，并构建环富集基准RingDiv与环多样性指数RDI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准序列与图表示难以显式编码环系统、重复基序等高阶拓扑；现有高阶表示虽能直接刻画这些结构，但计算开销大且难以解码为合法分子，因此需要一个既保留拓扑表达能力又兼容序列模型的高效表示。

Method: 提出HGR框架：将分子提升为组合复形，在上下文无关高阶文法下将每个复形解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，从而将高阶拓扑序列化为规则序列；同时构建包含118万分子的环富集基准RingDiv（含RingDiv300k子集）并提出环多样性指数RDI以量化环系统覆盖度。

Result: 在分子生成任务中，基于HGR的模型天然保证100%合法率，同时分布对齐领先，在全部五个生成基准的FCD指标上排名第一；在表示学习中，HGR-FM在七项MoleculeNet基准上于两种迁移协议下均取得最高平均AUC，相较最强基线在探测与全量微调下分别提升8.3与3.3个AUC点。

Conclusion: HGR是一种高效的高阶分子表示，兼具拓扑表达力与序列模型兼容性，在分子生成与可迁移表示学习上均取得领先表现。

Abstract: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.

</details>
