ActiveWAM improves TAVIS out-of-distribution success by up to 17.0 percentage points over the strongest baselines, achieves 20.0 additional points over Fast-WAM on RoboTwin-AV, and outperforms it by 26.7 points on real-world physical kitchen tasks.

</details>


### [777] [Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01726)
*Abdelrhman Werby,Fabio Scaparro,Kai O. Arra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 QueryArt，一个仅用单张 RGB 图像、一个 2D 查询点和相机内参来估计铰接物体运动学参数的模型。它不再将部件分割与铰接估计耦合，而是预测相对查询点、并以查询点深度为单位的 3D 铰接几何，从而在单视图下保持可辨识性，再借助一次深度测量恢复度量尺度。模型在合成与真实混合数据上训练，多数指标优于近期基线，并在移动操作平台上 57 次试验中达到 70.2% 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机：让机器人估计铰接物体的运动学参数可解锁交互与操作能力，但机器人通常只能获得当前观测，往往只是从未见过物体的单张 RGB 图像。现有单图方法将铰接部件分割与铰接估计耦合，预测易受漏检和错误部件关联影响；同时它们直接回归度量 3D 几何，而单视图只能确定到尺度。

Method: 方法：QueryArt 输入单张 RGB 图像、一个 2D 查询点和相机内参，输出铰接参数。关键建模选择是预测相对于查询点的 3D 铰接几何，并以该点深度为单位进行归一化，使目标仅凭图像即可辨识；随后在查询点进行一次深度测量以提供尺度，恢复度量参数。训练使用经过整理的合成与真实铰接数据集混合。

Result: 结果：在多个基准上与近期基线比较，QueryArt 在多数铰接指标上优于基线，包括分布外数据。在移动操作平台上，跨 16 个物体部件、5 类视角共 57 次操作试验中达到 70.2% 成功率。代码与视频见 https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/。

Conclusion: 结论：解耦铰接估计与部件分割、并在查询点局部尺度下预测铰接几何，可有效规避单图方法中的漏检、错误关联和尺度不可辨识问题。结合一次深度测量即可获得度量参数，在基准和真实移动操作任务中均表现出良好泛化与实用性。

Abstract: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of articulated objects unlocks a wide range of capabilities for interaction and manipulation. The estimation has to happen from the information the robot currently observes, often just a single RGB image of an object it has never seen before. Current single-image approaches couple articulation part segmentation with articulation estimation, making their predictions vulnerable to missed detections and incorrect part associations, and they regress metric 3D geometry that a single view fixes only up to scale. We present QueryArt, a model that estimates articulation parameters from a single RGB image, a 2D query point, and camera intrinsics. QueryArt is trained to estimate the 3D articulation geometry relative to the queried point and in units of its depth, which keeps its target identifiable from the image alone. A single depth measurement at the query point then supplies the scale and recovers the metric parameters. We train QueryArt on a curated mixture of synthetic and real-world articulation datasets. We evaluate QueryArt on several benchmarks and compare it against recent baselines. QueryArt outperforms recent baselines on most articulation metrics, including on out-of-distribution data. To demonstrate the model's capabilities in real-world settings, we evaluate QueryArt on a mobile manipulator across 57 manipulation trials spanning 16 object parts and five viewpoint classes, achieving a 70.2% success rate. We provide code and videos at: https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/

</details>


### [778] [World Motion Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling of SE(3) Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01742)
*Jiahui Lei,Qianqian Wang,Trevor Darrell,Angjoo Kanazawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出世界运动模型(WMM),用稀疏SE(3)位姿轨迹表示动态3D世界,将多实体联合分布建模为序列建模问题,以统一框架完成预测、控制、重定向等多类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 赋予智能体空间智能需要覆盖动态3D世界的生成式先验;现有表示难以统一刻画关节物体、人体、手-物交互、分片刚体场景动态、相机运动及机器人状态与动作等多类实体。

Method: 观察到动态场景元素可近似为一组刚性SE(3)轨迹,作者以此为4D建模的最小且具表达力的基元;将各实体联合分布建模为序列建模问题,采用带per-token噪声水平的flow matching,并引入context token机制实现非序列条件化,从而支持任意数量实体与时间步上的any-to-any边缘条件。

Result: 在3D视觉与机器人学的6个不同应用中验证,展现出良好通用性与灵活性并获得较强性能。

Conclusion: 未来预测、运动补全、模型预测控制、逆运动学、跨本体重定向与策略学习等任务,均归约为在同一网络上施加不同掩码,体现统一表示与统一模型的多任务优势。

Abstract: Equipping artificial agents with spatial intelligence requires a comprehensive generative prior over the dynamic 3D world. We propose World Motion Models (WMMs) that capture "what was, is, and will be where across time" via sparse SE(3) pose trajectories. WMMs are built on the observation that elements of dynamic scenes can be well approximated by a set of rigid SE(3) trajectories, a minimal yet expressive primitive for 4D modeling. This representation unifies articulated objects, human bodies, hand-object interactions, piecewise-rigid scene dynamics, camera motion, and even robot states and actions into a single shared space. Given this representation, we cast the joint distribution of these entities as a flexible sequence modeling problem, utilizing flow-matching with per-token noise levels. Coupled with a context token mechanism for non-sequential conditioning, this formulation supports any-to-any marginal conditioning across an arbitrary number of entities and time steps. Tasks such as future prediction, motion infilling, model-predictive control, inverse kinematics, cross-embodiment retargeting, and policy learning all reduce to the application of different masks over the same network. Experiments on 6 diverse applications of 3D vision and robotics demonstrate the versatility and flexibility of WMMs with strong performance.

</details>


### [779] [End-to-End Learning vs. Modular Architectures: Comparative Insights into Autonomous Driving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01746)
*Kartik B. Kapse*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文对自动驾驶中端到端学习与模块化架构两大设计范式进行系统比较分析，并提出四维架构选择框架（12项二元准则，覆盖安全、运行环境、数据/算力资源、部署情境），在10个已发表自动驾驶系统上验证，推荐准确率7/10；结论指出混合架构是未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端学习与模块化架构是自动驾驶系统实现的两大主流范式，各自在可解释性、可扩展性、鲁棒性、实车适用性等方面存在显著权衡，缺乏系统性的对比综合与选型指导，实践中难以判断何种场景应采用何种架构。

Method: 采用文献综合与比较分析方法，围绕可解释性、可扩展性、鲁棒性、真实世界适用性等关键维度对两类范式进行对比；在比较综合基础上，提出四维架构选择框架，包含安全、运行环境、数据/计算资源、部署情境四个维度下的12项二元判据，并以10个已发表的自动驾驶系统作为案例进行验证。

Result: 端到端学习结构简洁、在动态环境中适应性强，但透明度不足且高度依赖大规模数据集；模块化架构可解释性与任务级优化更优，但集成复杂度高、可扩展性受限。所提四维选择框架在10个已发表系统上正确推荐7个实际部署架构，准确率7/10。

Conclusion: 两类范式各有优劣、互补性强，混合架构可结合双方优势、是克服现有局限的有前景方向；所提框架为自动驾驶架构选型提供了初步可操作依据，后续需扩大验证样本并深化混合架构研究。

Abstract: Autonomous driving systems have become a central focus of intelligent transportation research, with End-to-End Learning and Modular Architectures offering two prominent design paradigms for their implementation. E2E Learning uses deep learning algorithms to map raw sensory inputs directly to driving actuators, providing a streamlined and adaptable solution. while Modular Architectures employ a pipeline-based approach, dividing the system into distinct subsystems for perception, cognition, planning, and control. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of these paradigms, focusing on their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs to provide insights into their suitability for various autonomous driving applications. The study evaluates key factors such as interpretability, scalability, robustness, and real-world applicability. While End-to-End Learning emphasizes simplicity and adaptability in dynamic environments, it lacks transparency and is highly dependent on large datasets. Conversely, Modular Architectures offer superior interpretability and task-specific optimization, but face challenges related to integration complexity and scalability. To address these limitations, hybrid approaches that combine the strengths of both paradigms have emerged, offering a promising direction for overcoming these challenges. Beyond this comparative synthesis, following work proposes a Four-Dimensional Architecture Selection Framework, comprising twelve binary criteria across safety, operating environment, data/computational resources, and deployment context, and validate it against ten published autonomous driving systems, correctly recommending 7/10 deployed architectures. This work synthesizes existing literature to highlight key trade-offs between the paradigms and identifies hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future research.

</details>


### [780] [FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01849)
*Kyungmin Lee,Sibeen Kim,Dongyoon Hwang,Yoonsang Oh,Donghu Kim,Youngdo Lee,I Made Aswin Nahrendra,Jaegul Choo,Hojoon Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出FlashDexRetarget，一个基于强化学习的高成功率、高效率灵巧手动作重定向框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类手-物体演示是可复用的灵巧操作数据来源，但跨具身迁移需要物理可行的重定向。现有基于物理的方法在重定向成功率、针对特定动作的训练效率或两者上均存在局限。

Method: 结合物体点云观测、手-物体距离特征与未来轨迹编码，并辅以监督物体运动和参考手-物体关系的互补奖励；采用左右手分离的actor-critic网络，并将off-policy算法FlashSAC适配到灵巧动作跟踪。

Result: 在涵盖单物体与双物体交互的50个动作基准上达到90%成功率，约为采样类基线的2.5倍，且训练算力最多比RL基线少100倍；在XHand与Sharpa Wave Hand上均获一致提升；200、500、1000动作规模下保持稳定且随训练集增大更高效；真实演示的定性回放验证了适用性。

Conclusion: FlashDexRetarget以高成功率、低训练算力实现跨具身灵巧动作重定向，并具备良好的可扩展性与真实应用潜力，组件消融验证了各设计选择的有效性。

Abstract: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of dexterous robot manipulation data, but transferring them across embodiments requires physically feasible retargeting. Existing physics-based approaches face limitations in retargeting success, motion-specific training efficiency, or both. To address these limitations, we introduce FlashDexRetarget, an RL-based framework for high-success, efficient dexterous motion retargeting. To make the demonstrated interaction easier to learn, we combine object point-cloud observations, hand-object distance features, and future trajectory encodings with complementary rewards that supervise object motion and reference hand-object relationships. To further accelerate learning, we employ separate left- and right-hand actor critic networks and adapt the off-policy algorithm, FlashSAC to dexterous motion tracking. On a benchmark of 50 motions spanning single-object and two-object interactions, FlashDexRetarget achieves a 90% success rate, approximately 2.5x that of the evaluated sampling-based baselines, while requiring up to 100x less training compute than the evaluated RL-based baselines. Evaluations on both XHand and Sharpa Wave Hand show consistent gains, and component-wise ablations examine the contributions of our design choices. Beyond the 50-motion benchmark, experiments with 200, 500, and 1,000 motions demonstrate that our method remains stable at larger scales and produces successful retargeted motions more efficiently as the training set grows. Qualitative replay results using real-world-captured demonstrations further illustrate the applicability of our framework to recorded human manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/

</details>


### [781] [ChunkVLA-AM: Parallel Action Chunking for Vision-Language-Action Robot Control in Additive Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01856)
*Zhugang Liu,Kaichuang Zhang,Jinman Zhang,Pu Sun,Martha Asare,Jose Hernandez,Maxim Ermolinsky,Efren Saenz,Qi Lu,Jinghao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本研究将 OpenVLA-OFT 部署到固定增材制造工作单元中的 FAIRINO FR3 机器人，通过数据管线转换单目演示数据并结合云边架构实现跨本体适配，42 次物理抓取转移试验成功率为 92.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型统一了视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，为增材制造（AM）自动化带来新机遇。但将其部署到 AM 场景仍面临两大挑战：一是适配未见过的机器人本体成本高昂，二是环境变化会导致性能退化。因此需要一套可行的部署方案来验证 VLA 在真实 AM 工作单元中的可用性。

Method: 构建了将单目真实演示数据转换为 OpenVLA 兼容的 TFDS/RLDS 数据集的数据管线，以支持向 FR3 本体的适配。运行时每次推理请求预测 8 步的 7 维动作块（chunk），FR3 以开环方式执行整块动作后再采集新观测，从而在块间形成闭环反馈。系统采用云边架构，FR3 客户端通过 FastAPI 接口将观测流式传输至远程推理服务器。

Result: 在 42 次物理 A-to-B 物体转移试验（红、蓝目标各半）中，系统成功 39 次，成功率 92.9%。三次失败均发生在最终放置阶段，原因是释放高度控制不足导致物体倾倒。光照扫描实验确定 0-255 尺度下低误差亮度区间为 85-125，其中平均空间误差最低点出现在亮度 95。

Conclusion: OpenVLA-OFT 可在固定 AM 工作单元中实现较高的任务成功率，云边推理架构与块式开环执行策略具备工程可行性。后续需重点改进释放高度控制以消除放置阶段失败，并将系统亮度维持在 85-125（最优 95）以保障感知精度。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception, language understanding, and action generation, offering new opportunities for automation in additive manufacturing (AM). However, deployment in AM remains challenging because adapting these models to unseen robot embodiments is costly, and performance can degrade under environment changes. In this work, we present a framework for deploying OpenVLA-OFT on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in a fixed AM workcell. A data pipeline converts monocular real-world demonstrations into OpenVLA-compatible TFDS/RLDS datasets to support adaptation to the FR3 embodiment. At runtime, each inference request predicts an eight-step chunk of 7-D actions. The FR3 executes each chunk open loop before capturing a new observation, providing closed-loop feedback between chunks. The system uses a cloud-edge architecture in which the FR3 client streams observations to a remote inference server through a FastAPI interface. In 42 physical A-to-B object-transfer trials, evenly split between red and blue targets, the system succeeded in 39 (92.9%). All three failures occurred during final placement, when insufficient release-height control caused the object to topple. An illumination sweep identified a low-error luminance range of 85-125 on a 0-255 scale, with the lowest mean spatial error at 95.

</details>


### [782] [Towards Physical Underwater Robotic Assistance for Scuba Diver Movement in Confined Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01906)
*Demetrious T. Kutzke,Junaed Sattar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出首个用于潜水员定向引导的可穿戴机器人RADMCS，通过单目深度估计与推进器力反馈提供触觉引导，实现潜水员与水底结构保持固定距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜水员通常被教导控制深度以避免快速升降导致的减压病与气压伤，但许多水下任务（如珊瑚礁、水下钻井仪器、未爆弹药等）更需要横向距离控制，而现有推进辅助外骨骼并未针对此需求设计定向引导方案。

Method: 研制可穿戴机器人RADMCS，采用单目深度估计感知潜水员与水底结构的距离，并利用水下推进器的力反馈向潜水员施加触觉引导；在闭环泳池与海洋环境中开展IRB批准的八名潜水员人体试验，包括阈值敏感性测试、定距保持实验及形态/佩戴/功能测试。

Result: 实验表明，即使采用较低推力（最大值的10%），也能通过机器人引导的物理体感有效引导人体运动方向；在泳池与海洋环境中均验证了阈值敏感性、定距保持能力及佩戴功能。

Conclusion: RADMCS为潜水员定向引导提供了首个可穿戴机器人平台，其紧凑形态可作为基础平台，未来可扩展至更复杂的控制与导航行为。

Abstract: Scuba divers are taught to control their depth to avoid rapid ascents and descents, which could result in serious injuries such as gas embolisms and barotrauma. However, many underwater tasks necessitate lateral control, maintaining distance between subsea structures such as coral reefs, submerged drilling instrumentation, or unexploded ordnance. In this work, we discuss a first-of-its-kind wearable robotic solution providing thruster-actuated directional guidance to a diver, as distinct from prior propulsive-assistance exoskeletons. We introduce ``Robotic Assisted Diver Movement in Confined Spaces'' (RADMCS), a wearable robot that assists divers in maintaining a fixed distance from subsea structures by leveraging perception techniques in monocular depth estimation and force-feedback from submersible thrusters to provide haptic feedback. Its small and compact form factor creates a foundational platform that could be expanded to include more sophisticated control and navigation behaviors. We present results from Institutional Review Board (IRB) in-water studies with eight human scuba diver participants on threshold sensitivity tests in both a closed-water swimming facility and ocean environments; distance-maintaining experiments in a closed-water facility; and form, fit, and function testing in the ocean. We demonstrate that relatively low thrust values (10 percent of maximum) allow robotic direction of a human's movement using the physical sensation of the robot's guidance.

</details>


### [783] [Robot Learning on Discrete Surfaces: Theory and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01910)
*Matteo Dalle Vedove,Fares J. Abu-Dakka,Luigi Palopoli,Daniele Fontanelli,Matteo Saveriano*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的离散黎曼框架，使机器人学习可直接在多面体表面网格上进行，并在DMP、GP与流匹配三种范式中验证其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人学习与运动生成框架多将表面视为约束，忽略其内在几何；尤其对于CAD与三维重建常见输出——多面体网格，其离散几何结构未被充分利用。

Method: 基于离散微分几何，定义跨面、边、顶点均良定义的指数/对数映射、平行移动与环境空间投影，并实例化于三种学习范式：DMP（改进指数映射计算、固定切锥强迫项编码与平行移动）、GP（测地核及可容许性控制）、黎曼流匹配（网格原生算子）。

Result: 仿真中优于当前最优方法；DMP跨表面泛化与稳定性提升，GP可在任意网格位置回归且无平滑性假设，RFM生成质量优于谱基线并缩短训练时间；并在两个真实机器人场景（跨表面用户手绘轨迹泛化、RGB-D重建表面抛光运动规划）中验证。

Conclusion: 该离散黎曼框架为多面体网格上的机器人学习提供了统一、实用的几何工具，兼具理论一致性与实际部署能力。

Abstract: All the objects composing our world are enclosed within surfaces. Yet, most robot learning and motion generation frameworks treat surfaces as constraints ignoring their intrinsic geometry. This gap is acute for polyhedral meshes--the standard output of CAD and 3D reconstruction--whose discrete geometric structure remains unexploited. In this paper, we propose a unified discrete Riemannian framework that enables robot learning directly on polyhedral surface meshes. Using discrete differential geometry, we define logarithmic and exponential maps, parallel transport, and ambient-space projections that remain well-defined across faces, edges, and vertices. We instantiate the framework in three learning paradigms: (i) Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs), an improved exponential-map computation and a fixed-tangent-cone forcing-term encoding with parallel transport yield better cross-surface generalisation and stability over prior mesh-based approaches. (ii) Gaussian Process (GP), a geodesic-based kernel with practical admissibility control, enables regression at arbitrary mesh locations without smoothness assumptions. (iii) Riemannian Flow Matching (RFM), mesh-native operators improve generative quality over spectral baselines while reducing training time. The framework is validated in simulation against state-of-the-art methods and demonstrated on two real-robot scenarios: generalising user-drawn trajectories across different surfaces and planning polishing motions on RGB-D-reconstructed surfaces.

</details>


### [784] [TouchTherm: Building Multimodal Digital Twins of Objects for Tactile and Thermal Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01943)
*Yitao Zhang,Hong Ying,Haoran Guo,Xiaoying Zhou,Guanyu Chen,Chenxi Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出TouchTherm框架，可从真实物体构建适配仿真的视觉-触觉-热学多模态物体资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人与VR仿真需要同时包含视觉几何与触觉、热学物理线索的物体资产，但现有3D数据集与重建方法主要关注物体尺度几何与外观，忽略了用于高保真触觉渲染的微观表面结构以及温度感知交互所需的瞬态热动力学。

Method: 视觉与触觉重建方面，结合结构光扫描与光度立体获得的多视角法向图；将法向图配准到扫描几何并转换到切空间，恢复局部微高度场用于光学触觉渲染，粗网格用于碰撞检测。热学重建方面，捕获受控加热后自然冷却的同步多视角红外视频，重建物理正则化的动态热场。

Result: 在20个物体上的实验表明，重建的微高度场保留了主导表面结构，并在粗几何之外恢复了更高频细节；热场在30 s与45 s的留出表面温度MAE分别为0.465°C与0.592°C。触觉资产支持从触觉观测进行合成到真实的物体识别，基于手套的VR系统展示了空间与时间变化的温度反馈。

Conclusion: TouchTherm在多模态感官仿真与温度感知虚拟交互方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Robotic simulation and virtual reality increasingly require object assets that capture not only visual geometry but also the physical cues underlying tactile and thermal interaction. Existing 3D datasets and reconstruction methods primarily represent object-scale geometry and visual appearance, overlooking microscale surface structure for high-fidelity haptic rendering and transient temperature dynamics for temperature-aware interaction. We present TouchTherm, a framework for constructing simulation-ready visuo-tactile-thermal object assets from real-world objects. For visual and tactile reconstruction, we combine structured-light scanning with multiview normal maps obtained from photometric stereo. The normal maps are registered to the scanned geometry and transformed into tangent space to recover local micro-height fields for optical tactile rendering, while the coarse mesh handles collision detection. For thermal reconstruction, we capture synchronized multiview infrared videos of natural cooling following controlled heating and reconstruct a physics-regularized dynamic thermal field. Experiments on 20 objects show that the reconstructed micro-height fields preserve dominant surface structures and recover higher-frequency details beyond the coarse geometry, while the thermal fields achieve held-out surface-temperature MAEs of 0.465 degrees C and 0.592 degrees C at 30 s and 45 s, respectively. The resulting tactile assets support synthetic-to-real object recognition from tactile observations, while a glove-based VR system demonstrates spatially and temporally varying thermal feedback. These results highlight the potential of TouchTherm for multimodal sensory simulation and temperature-aware virtual interaction.

</details>


### [785] [Training-Free Diffusion Planning with Analytical Local Scores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01959)
*Michael Y. Fatemi,Jinhao Liang,Ferdinando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练的扩散式运动规划器，用解析局部分数替代学习到的全局轨迹分数，实现高效、平滑且无碰撞的轨迹生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散式规划器需在大量可行轨迹上训练，导致其与地图强耦合（map-specific），在缺乏高质量示范数据时难以部署。作者希望摆脱数据依赖，同时保留扩散模型的迭代去噪细化能力。

Method: 关键观察是轨迹分数可仅由相邻路点及附近约束的局部交互重构。据此用解析局部分数（来自障碍、平滑度、速度、智能体间可行性项）替换学习的全局轨迹分数，推导出分解式去噪过程，兼顾经典轨迹优化结构与扩散迭代细化行为，无需训练。

Result: 在大量复杂环境与大规模多智能体任务上，该方法生成平滑可行轨迹且计算开销有限：GPU 上可在 6 秒内为 100+ 障碍环境中 300+ 智能体生成可行路径，优于强学习型与优化基线，且无需学习式扩散规划器的数据需求。

Conclusion: 通过将扩散式去噪与解析局部分数结合，该方法实现了免训练的多机器人运动规划，兼具高效性、可扩展性与泛化性，规避了对大规模示范数据的依赖。

Abstract: Path finding and multi-robot motion planning require trajectories that are smooth, goal-directed, and collision-free in environments with complex geometric constraints. Recent diffusion-based planners have shown that trajectory generation can be cast as iterative denoising which has opened the doors to learning-based approaches that can handle multi-modal trajectory distributions and refine entire trajectories. However, a key limitation is that diffusion planners require training on large collections of feasible trajectories, rendering them map-specific, and difficult to deploy when high-quality demonstrations are unavailable. This paper introduces a training-free diffusion-based motion planner that replaces learned global trajectory scores with analytical local scores derived from obstacle, smoothness, velocity, and inter-agent feasibility terms. The proposed idea relies on a key observation: the score of a trajectory can be reconstructed by considering only local interactions between neighboring waypoints and nearby constraints. This structure exploitation yields a decomposed denoising procedure that retains the optimization structure of classical trajectory methods while inheriting the iterative refinement behavior of diffusion models. Experiments on a large collection of complex environments and large multi-agent planning tasks show that the proposed analytical score produces smooth and feasible trajectories within limited computational costs, for example in generating feasible paths for 300+ agents in environments containing 100+ obstacles in under 6 seconds on a GPU, outperforming strong learning-based and optimization baselines, while avoiding the data requirements of learned diffusion planners.

</details>


### [786] [BLT*: Informed Belief Localization Trees for Uncertainty-Aware Planning on Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01972)
*Elliot Preston-Krebs,Abhishek Goudar,Timothy D. Barfoot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Informed BLT*，一种基于采样、以 2-Wasserstein 距离度量且面向点云观测的信念空间规划算法，可在大型户外数字孪生中高效运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外大规模场景下的信念空间规划面临点云观测维度高、信念传播计算昂贵、碰撞概率约束复杂等挑战，需要一种可扩展且能复用已获取信息的方法。

Method: 将 RRT* 与 Informed RRT* 适配到信念空间，采用 2-Wasserstein 度量；假设各向同性高斯信念，使采样信念状态可高效连接，并同时考虑可用信息与概率碰撞约束；由此实现无需反复传播观测的引导与重连（rewiring），并复用先前计算的量测信息。此外提出生成带语义标签数字孪生的框架，用于真实环境中基于点云定位的规划。

Result: 在仿真环境与数字孪生实验中，多数地图上初始解发现速度更快，且代价收敛性具有竞争力。

Conclusion: Informed BLT* 可扩展至大型户外数字孪生，在保持竞争性代价收敛的同时加速初始解求解，验证了结合 W2 度量与信息复用策略在信念空间规划中的有效性。

Abstract: We present Informed Belief Localization Trees* (Informed BLT*), a sampling-based belief space planning (BSP) algorithm that scales to large outdoor digital twins with point-cloud observations. We adapt RRT* and Informed RRT* to belief space using the $2$-Wasserstein ($W_2$) metric. Assuming isotropic Gaussian beliefs, sampled belief states can be connected efficiently while accounting for available information and probabilistic collision constraints. This enables steering and rewiring without repeatedly propagating observations, and allows previously computed measurement information to be reused. We present a framework to generate semantically labelled digital twins for planning in real-world environments with point-cloud-based localization. Experiments in simulated environments and digital twins show faster initial solution discovery in most maps with competitive cost convergence.

</details>


### [787] [H-SPAR: Hydrodynamic-aware Simulation for Particle Transport and Autonomous Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01985)
*Navid Zarrabi,Nariman Yousefi,Sajad Saeedi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: H-SPAR 是一个耦合流场、拉格朗日粒子输运、概率采样与 ROS 2/Gazebo USV 自主性的海洋机器人仿真框架，用于在统一水动力条件下联合评估任务成本与采样性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有海洋机器人仿真器通常将流场、自主性与采样目标分开建模，难以对任务成本与采样性能进行联合评估；而环境机器人采样需同时考虑水流对机器人运动与粒子输运的双重影响。

Method: H-SPAR 集成时空变化的流速场、拉格朗日粒子输运、概率采样以及基于 ROS 2/Gazebo 的无人水面艇（USV）自主系统；由共享的预计算流场同时驱动粒子平流与闭环执行中的水流诱导力。

Result: 路径规划实验中，现有水流感知规划器 SVF-RRT* 在规划层面相比传统 RRT* 降低 69.4% 的上游成本，但在时变水流下的实际执行中该降幅降至 41.7%；覆盖实验中，在完整 H-SPAR 配置下，扫描方向可使粒子采样率变化高达 22.2%。

Conclusion: 研究结果凸显了在一致水动力条件下对规划、载体执行、粒子输运与采样进行联合评估的重要性。

Abstract: Environmental robotic sampling requires considering the dual influence of water currents on robotic motion and particle transport. Existing marine robotics simulators generally model flow, autonomy, and sampling targets separately, limiting joint evaluation of mission cost and sampling performance. H-SPAR integrates spatially and temporally varying velocity fields, Lagrangian particle transport, probabilistic sampling, and ROS 2/Gazebo-based uncrewed surface vehicle (USV) autonomy. In this work, shared precomputed flow fields drive particle advection and current-induced forces during closed-loop vehicle execution. Path-planning experiments show that the existing current-aware planner SVF-RRT* achieves 69.4% lower upstream cost than conventional RRT* at the planning level, but this reduction falls to 41.7% during execution under time-varying currents, reflecting temporal flow variation, vehicle motion constraints, and path deviation omitted during planning. Coverage experiments show that sweep orientation changes the particle-sampling rate by up to 22.2% under the complete H-SPAR configuration. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating planning, vehicle execution, particle transport, and sampling together under consistent hydrodynamic conditions. The project webpage is available at https://sites.google.com/view/h-spar, and the open-source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/naviiidz/h-spar-sim.

</details>


### [788] [UniWAM: Unified World-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02054)
*Jiayi Chen,Wenxuan Song,Jingbo Wang,Shuai Zhou,Xicheng Gong,Zehua Fan,Ziyang Zhou,Junwu E,Haodong Yan,Fuhao Li,Qize Yu,Xu Huang,Pengwei Wang,Wen Chen,Shunbo Zhou,Haoang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 UniWAM：统一物理推理器、世界生成器与动作预测器的架构，结合严格数据管线与协同预训练/后训练设计，在人机混合数据上实现多任务 SOTA 与对数线性协同训练缩放规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型得益于预训练视觉语言模型的理解与推理能力，但仅靠动作监督难以充分建立对世界动态的建模；世界动作模型虽从视频生成模型继承时空先验，却在语义理解与分布偏移下的推理方面受限。二者互补但尚未统一。

Method: 采用统一架构 UniWAM，集成物理推理器、世界生成器与动作预测器，联合学习物理世界语义理解、视觉生成与动作预测。构建面向人类第一视角数据与机器人数据的严格清洗与标注管线。为在保留语言能力的同时适配具身任务，将底层动作以自然语言表示，并提出预训练配方，把 VQA 数据、人类第一视角数据与机器人演示的互补监督分配给相应模型组件。后训练阶段引入未来视觉噪声增强以降低对精确未来预测的依赖，并采用历史条件流匹配，用编码后的动作历史初始化动作生成。

Result: 在分布内性能、鲁棒性、泛化性、指令遵循与长时序任务执行等多项评测中取得 SOTA 性能；同时揭示统一人机协同训练的对数线性缩放规律，证明大规模人机混合数据预训练的有效性。设计显著减少去噪步数并保持性能。

Conclusion: 统一语义推理、视觉生成与动作预测可兼得 VLM 的理解优势与视频生成模型的时空先验；配合高质量数据管线、互补监督分配、噪声增强与历史条件流匹配，能够在效率与性能间取得良好平衡，并受益于人机数据协同预训练的可扩展性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models benefit from the understanding and reasoning capabilities of pretrained vision-language models, but action-only supervision provides limited grounding in world dynamics. Conversely, world-action models inherit spatiotemporal priors from video generation models, yet remain limited in semantic understanding and reasoning under distribution shifts. We introduce UniWAM, a unified architecture that integrates a physical reasoner, a world generator, and an action predictor to jointly learn semantic understanding of the physical world, visual generation, and action prediction. To ensure the quality of the training data, we developed a rigorous data cleaning and annotation pipeline for both human egocentric data and robot data. To adapt the vision-language component to embodied tasks while preserving its inherited language capabilities, we represent low-level actions in natural language and introduce a pre-training recipe that assigns complementary supervision from visual question answering (VQA) data, human egocentric data, and robot demonstrations to the appropriate model components. During post-training, future visual noise augmentation reduces reliance on precise future predictions, while history-conditioned flow matching uses encoded action history to initialize action generation. Together, these designs significantly reduce denoising steps while maintaining performance. UniWAM achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across multiple evaluations, including in-distribution performance, robustness, generalization, instruction following, and long-horizon task execution. Furthermore, we uncover a log-linear scaling law of unified human-robot co-training, demonstrating the effectiveness of large-scale pre-training on a mixture of human and robot data.

</details>


### [789] [HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02089)
*Kyochul Jang,Seohyeon Park,Ohchul Kwon,Sangjun Park,Junhyeok Choi,Seungyeop Yi,Chaeyun Kim,Sangkyu Lee,Idan Szpektor,Avi Caciularu,Jongmin Park,Youngjae Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HumanoidToolBench：面向人形机器人工具使用的 18 任务基准，配套 3.1k 演示数据集 ToolBook，揭示工具选择与任务完成之间的显著能力差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器人硬件与学习方法的进步，人形机器人需要借助工具完成超出自身物理极限的任务。成功的工具使用要求"选择合适的工具"并协调操作与（必要时）移动来完成任务，但现有基准无法在人形机器人上联合评估这些能力。

Method: 构建 HumanoidToolBench，覆盖 3 种场景、3 个执行层级与 2 种工具集模式，共 18 个任务；并构建 ToolBook 数据集，包含在仿真环境与真实 Unitree G1 上采集的 3.1k 条演示。在仿真中评测 7 种策略、在真机上评测 3 种策略，并对 GR00T N1.7 做针对性探针测试。

Result: 评测显示，策略在"选择合适的工具"与"完成任务"之间存在显著性能落差。GR00T N1.7 探针实验表明：对未见工具的选择准确率下降，且在面对无关指令时仍继续执行任务，说明指令遵循与工具泛化能力不足。

Conclusion: HumanoidToolBench 为"人形机器人工具使用"这一需联合评估工具选择、操作与移动的能力提供了统一评测平台，并暴露出现有策略在工具泛化与指令理解方面的关键短板，为后续研究指明改进方向。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.

</details>


### [790] [GlassGuard: Verified Glass Plane Mapping for Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02110)
*Hanwen Guo,Zhengzhi Lin,Yusen Xie,Ji Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GlassGuard：面向导航的玻璃重建框架，融合视觉与LiDAR证据重建平面建筑玻璃，兼顾覆盖率与自由空间污染，全景版达85%覆盖率，针孔版82%且假体素减少5-17倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透明与镜面表面对LiDAR SLAM与导航构成挑战：激光可穿透玻璃，导致碰撞边界缺失于地图。既有重建方法易将障碍错误放置，反而污染可通行自由空间。因此需要同时满足"玻璃覆盖"与"自由空间污染"双重要求的重建方案。

Method: 以"玻璃覆盖率"和"自由空间污染"双指标定义成功准则，并贯穿候选验证与全局地图构建。基础视觉模型提供玻璃实例掩码；结构化3D线索生成度量平面假设；无深度的2D投影几何在进入统一全局地图前校验平面朝向。

Result: 在9个建筑尺度场景（涵盖多样玻璃结构、空间尺度与光照条件）中评估，真实机器人行驶超1小时、2.1 km。全景版本达85%总玻璃覆盖率；相同针孔输入下达82%，基线最高仅61%，同时每帧假体素减少5-17倍。导航规划器定性示例显示重建平面可阻挡穿玻璃路径并保留可通行路线。

Conclusion: GlassGuard通过视觉-LiDAR互补证据与双指标约束，在建筑尺度真实场景中实现高覆盖、低污染的玻璃平面重建，支持可靠导航避障。

Abstract: Transparent and specular surfaces pose a serious challenge to LiDAR-based SLAM and navigation because laser returns may pass through glass, leaving collision boundaries absent from the map. Prior work attempts to reconstruct the missing surfaces, but inaccurate obstacle placement can create the opposite failure: contamination of traversable free space. Recognizing this dual requirement, we present GlassGuard, a navigation-oriented framework for reconstructing planar architectural glass from complementary visual and LiDAR evidence. We formulate success in terms of both glass coverage and free-space contamination and apply this principle throughout proposal verification and global map construction. A foundation vision model provides glass-instance masks, structural 3D cues generate metric plane hypotheses, and depth-free 2D projective geometry checks their orientations before they enter a consolidated global map. We evaluate GlassGuard in nine building-scale scenes spanning diverse glass structures, spatial scales, and lighting conditions, with more than one hour and 2.1 km of real-world robot traversal. GlassGuard achieves 85% of total glass coverage for its panoramic version. Under identical pinhole inputs, GlassGuard achieves 82% total coverage, compared with at most 61% for the evaluated baselines, while producing 5-17x fewer false voxels per frame. Qualitative examples with a navigation planner illustrate the reconstructed planes blocking paths through glass while leaving traversable routes open. The project page is available at https://glassguardproject.github.io/.

</details>


### [791] [SkeleWAM: Skeleton World-Action Modeling for Efficient Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02120)
*Juyi Sheng,Hua Wang,Mengyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkeleWAM提出以稀疏3D骨架为状态空间的紧凑世界动作模型，在LIBERO-Plus上以57.1M参数取得85.9%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）多预测视频或学习的视觉潜变量，仅隐式表达交互几何，且保留与控制无关的外观信息。

Method: 将操作场景表示为由机器人关节、物体中心与交互点构成的稀疏3D骨架，由当前RGB-D观测与机器人本体感受在线构建；该骨架作为统一几何状态，同时用于动作生成与未来骨架预测，后者提供几何监督而无需视觉重建。推理时由当前骨架与语言指令直接生成动作，并采用Medoid Action Consensus（MAC）作为随机动作采样的辅助共识策略。

Result: 在LIBERO-Plus上整体成功率达85.9%，参数量57.1M，较Cosmos-Policy高出3.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 稀疏3D机器人—物体结构为稳健且参数高效的世界动作学习提供了有效状态空间。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) combine robot action generation with future state prediction. Existing WAMs typically predict videos or learned visual latents, which represent interaction geometry only implicitly and may retain appearance information unrelated to control. We introduce SkeleWAM, a compact WAM that represents a manipulation scene as a sparse 3D skeleton composed of robot joints, object centers, and interaction points. Constructed online from current RGB-D observations and robot proprioception, the skeleton provides a unified geometric state for action generation and future skeleton prediction. Future skeleton prediction provides additional geometric supervision for action learning without requiring visual reconstruction. At inference, SkeleWAM generates actions directly from the current skeleton and language instruction, while Medoid Action Consensus (MAC) serves as an auxiliary consensus strategy for stochastic action samples. On LIBERO-Plus, SkeleWAM achieves an overall success rate of 85.9% with 57.1M parameters, outperforming Cosmos-Policy by 3.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate that sparse 3D robot--object structure provides an effective state space for robust and parameter-efficient world action learning. The project is available at https://skelewam-project.github.io/.

</details>


### [792] [DuoMind: Enabling Distributed Multi-Robot Coordination with Semantic Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02161)
*Hanchu Zhou,Dechen Gao,Hang Wang,Brendan Lynch,Boqi Zhao,Qiyao Ma,Raman Goyal,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出分布式分层框架 DuoMind，通过语义通信实现多机器人协调，并构建 RoboPoly 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉语言动作模型（VLA）虽推动通用机器人进展，但多集中于单机器人场景。扩展到多机器人系统面临挑战：机器人需在长时程行为中保持协调，同时维持可靠、细粒度的执行。

Method: DuoMind 采用分布式分层架构：每个机器人使用基于 VLA 的动作模型进行底层执行，使用基于 VLM 的编排器进行高层推理与智能体间协调。每个规划步中，编排器基于任务指令、局部观测和其他机器人发来的消息进行推理，生成给动作模型的底层指令以及给同伴机器人的语义消息。该架构结合 VLM 的语义推理能力与 VLA 的精确动作生成能力。此外构建 RoboPoly 基准，包含需分布式控制下协调闭环执行的长时程操作任务。

Result: 在 RoboPoly 和 RoboTwin 上的实验表明 DuoMind 提升了多机器人任务性能；消融实验验证了分层编排与语义通信的贡献。

Conclusion: DuoMind 通过分层编排与语义通信有效增强多机器人协调能力，RoboPoly 为多机器人协调提供了评估基准。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently driven rapid progress in general-purpose robots, yet most progress has focused on single-robot settings. Extending these capabilities to multi-robot systems remains challenging because robots must coordinate long-horizon behaviors while maintaining reliable, fine-grained execution. We introduce DuoMind, a distributed hierarchical framework for multi-robot coordination through semantic communication. Each robot uses a VLA-based action model for low-level execution and a VLM-based orchestrator for high-level reasoning and inter-agent coordination. At each planning step, the orchestrator at each robot reasons over the task instruction, local observations, and messages received from other robots. It then generates low-level instructions for the action model and semantic messages for peer robots. This architecture exploits the complementary strengths of pretrained models by combining the semantic reasoning capabilities of VLMs with the precise action-generation capabilities of VLAs. To address the scarcity of benchmarks for multi-robot coordination, we further develop RoboPoly, a benchmark comprising long-horizon manipulation tasks that require coordinated, closed-loop execution under distributed control. Experiments on RoboPoly and RoboTwin demonstrate that DuoMind improves multi-robot task performance, while ablation studies confirm the contributions of hierarchical orchestration and semantic communication. More details are available on our project page.

</details>


### [793] [Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Inferring Robot Partner Constraints for Zero-Shot Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02170)
*Suyu Ye,Zheyuan Zhang,Vaishnav Tadiparthi,Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub,Ehsan Moradi Pari,Tianmin Shu,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Nakul Agarwal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出"Watch, Infer, Coordinate"基准，让"助手"机器人通过观察受限机器人与其他机器人的协同行为来推断其物理约束，并据此在新任务中实现零样本协同，性能接近已知真实约束的oracle。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在物理世界协作时，硬件退化或执行器故障会限制其可靠执行的动作，但这种物理约束可能不为协作伙伴所知。伙伴需要在无法直接获知对方能力的情况下推断约束，以便在新任务中有效配合。难点在于：演示只显示受限机器人"做了什么"，而非"本可做什么"；且在物理耦合任务中，另一方可能补偿其缺陷，使约束难以从受限机器人自身行为中识别。

Method: 关键洞见是约束会塑造团队的联合行为，因此双方动作都对受限伙伴的能力具有信息量。作者构建了Watch, Infer, Coordinate基准，涵盖三种物理耦合操作场景；并提出一种推断方法，通过观测到的联合行为对候选约束进行打分，进而完成约束推断与零样本协同。

Result: 在全部三种场景中，该方法显著提升了约束推断与零样本协同表现，接近拥有真实约束信息的oracle水平。

Conclusion: 通过利用物理耦合任务中团队的联合行为信息，可以在不直接观测对方能力的情况下有效推断伙伴的物理约束，并迁移到新任务实现高质量协同，为多机器人协作中的能力建模提供了新思路与基准。

Abstract: Robots operating in the physical world will increasingly need to coordinate with other robots, particularly in manipulation tasks where an object may be too large or heavy for a single robot to carry alone. Physical limitations caused by hardware degradation or actuator faults can restrict the actions a robot can reliably execute, yet these limitations may be unknown to its partner. We study whether a helper can infer a robot partner's physical constraints from observing it coordinate with another robot, then use the inferred capability to coordinate with the same partner on a new task. This is difficult because a demonstration shows what the constrained robot did, but not what it could have done. In physically coupled tasks, the other robot may also compensate for its limitations, making those limitations difficult to identify from the constrained robot's behavior alone. Our key insight is that these constraints shape the joint behavior of the team, making the actions of both robots informative about the constrained partner's capability. We introduce Watch, Infer, Coordinate, a benchmark spanning three physically coupled manipulation settings, together with an inference approach that scores candidate constraints using observed joint behavior. Across all three settings, our method substantially improves constraint inference and zero-shot coordination, approaching an oracle with access to the true constraints.

</details>


### [794] [InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02196)
*Zhuo Lin,Sirui Xu,Liuyu Bian,Yu-Xiong Wang,Liang-Yan Gui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 InterEvolve，通过规划与控制的接口在测试时进化人形 loco-manipulation 技能，无需重训练即可复用并保持已有运动能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对控制器从未训练过的任务，现有方法需要重训练或难以复用已有技能。作者的核心洞察是：广覆盖的控制器已具备新任务所需的大部分能力，关键在于设计一个足够表达、可执行且可度量的规划—控制接口，使这些能力可被释放并通过执行反馈持续改进。

Method: InterEvolve 由两部分组成：(1) 物体感知的前向—后向（FB）行为基础模型，其在冻结的身体先验上引入物体残差，可将关于身体或物体的新奖励在测试时转化为 loco-manipulation 行为；(2) 以奖励程序指定任务，即带完成条件和可调常数的分阶段奖励。LLM 智能体依据执行反馈与已验证程序构成的技能库，在上下文中修改程序结构，数值优化器负责调参。每个候选程序在并行仿真场景中验证，从而探索诱导、复用与组合已有运动能力的新方式，并迭代改进。

Result: 实验显示，人工设计的奖励远未挖掘 FB 模型的 loco-manipulation 潜力，而 InterEvolve 进化出的程序释放了这些能力，有时还产生新颖策略。该方法在仿真中覆盖多样任务、复杂场景与长时程组合，进化得到的技能还能基于第一人称机载感知在真实 Unitree G1 上自主运行。

Conclusion: 通过将任务规划表示为可进化的奖励程序，并与物体感知 FB 行为基础模型结合，可在测试时自主发现、复用和组合已有运动技能，实现从仿真到真实人形机器人的零重训练（test-time）loco-manipulation 能力迁移。

Abstract: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.

</details>


### [795] [Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02204)
*Yen-Jen Wang,Haozhe Jiang,Shuying Deng,Haoru Xue,Weirui Ye,Rocky Duan,Nika Haghtalab,S. Shankar Sastry,Pieter Abbeel,Haozhi Qi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RPG 是一个无需更新模型权重的机器人执行系统自主改进框架：从离线数据集中识别操作能力并在仿真中构建练习任务，通过执行反馈、特权状态与数据集视频诊断失败，发展/精炼可复用符号技能并修订系统提示，经跨任务评估筛选后，在测试时由多模态 LLM 依据提示与技能库协调感知与控制。22 项操作任务上成功率从首轮 28.6% 提升至 15 轮后 95.0%，优于 ASPIRE(75.5%) 与 CaP-Agent0(60.0%)；经统一校准与硬件适配后，冻结系统在 3 项任务共 30 次真机试验中全部成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建跨多样任务的可靠机器人能力需要大量人力来开发与维护技能、设计奖励，并将感知与控制集成。本文旨在减少这种人工投入，实现机器人执行系统的自主改进，且不依赖模型权重更新。

Method: 提出 Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG) 框架。离线阶段：从数据集中识别操作能力，并在仿真中构建相关练习任务。练习阶段：利用执行反馈、仿真器特权状态与可用数据集视频进行失败诊断，据此开发新的可复用符号技能、精炼已有技能并修订系统提示；通过跨任务评估测试单个候选变更与合并修订，合格者才被保留复用。测试阶段：多模态 LLM 使用最终系统提示与技能库协调感知与机器人控制。

Result: 在 22 项操作任务的留出初始化上，RPG 将成功率从第一轮练习后的 28.6% 提升到 15 轮后的 95.0%，优于所有评估基线，包括 ASPIRE(75.5%) 与由 GPT-6 Astra Pro 驱动的 CaP-Agent0(60.0%)。经统一的校准与硬件适配流程后，冻结系统在 3 项任务各 10 次、共 30 次真机试验中全部成功。

Conclusion: RPG 表明，无需更新模型权重，仅通过离线能力识别、仿真练习、失败诊断驱动的技能与提示迭代，即可显著提升机器人操作成功率，并有效迁移到真机执行。

Abstract: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initializations of 22 manipulation tasks, RPG improves task success from 28.6% after the first practice round to 95.0% after 15 rounds, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including ASPIRE (75.5%) and CaP-Agent0 powered by GPT-6 Astra Pro (60.0%). After a common calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure, the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials, with ten trials on each of three tasks. Project Website: https://rpg-robot.github.io/

</details>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [796] [Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00093)
*Jiahao Chen,Zhou Feng,Oubo Ma,Yichen Yan,Ruixiao Lin,Hangtao Zhang,Linkang Du,Hengyu An,Yong Yang,Jun Liu,Junhao Li,Naen Xu,Chunyi Zhou,Yuan Su,Zehao Jin,Qianli Ma,Leyi Qi,Yiming Wang,Zhe Ma,Yuwen Pu,Mengyao Du,Yuanyi Song,Enhao Huang,Zhihui Fu,Jun Wang,Jinfeng Li,Yuefeng Chen,Hui Xue,Yiming Li,Tianyu Du,Shouling Ji*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文关注自演化智能体的安全问题，提出以状态转移为核心的SAVER框架（Substrate、Adaptation、Violation、Exposure、Response），指出安全风险源于可复用经验的累积与跨情境复用，并呼吁纵向评估以追溯不安全影响、验证修复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型参数在部署后固定，难以从新交互中学习；开放环境中出现持续更新可复用状态（参数、记忆、工具定义、技能、工作流）的自演化智能体。这一转变使安全问题的性质改变：经验一旦成为可复用状态，过去事件就变成未来诱因，某情境下无害的信息可能在更高持久性、权威性或更大范围内影响决策。因此需要重新界定自演化智能体的安全命题。

Method: 提出SAVER转移中心框架：Substrate定位可复用影响的载体，Adaptation刻画其如何变化，Violation识别受损害的安全属性，Exposure标记失败可被观测的环节，Response评估遏制、修复或撤销；并据此对现有工作进行系统梳理与综述。

Result: 综述发现：失败并非必然源于有害信息，合法状态在适应性扩张其持久性、权威性或适用范围至原有效条件之外时也会变得不安全。现有研究在准入、检索、激活、暴露与局部遏制方面证据较强，但在衍生后代修复及适应恢复后的评估方面证据明显不足。

Conclusion: 应开展纵向评估：将不安全影响追溯至其起源转移，验证修复在衍生状态中的有效性，并测试在持续演化下安全问题是否会重新出现。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities, yet their parameters typically remain fixed after deployment, limiting learning from new interactions. In open-ended environments, this motivates self-evolving agents that continually update reusable state-including model parameters, memories, tool definitions, skills, and workflows-from data, feedback, and accumulated experience. This shift changes the safety problem: once experience becomes reusable state, past events become future causes, and information harmless in one context may later influence decisions with greater persistence, authority, or scope. Self-evolving agent safety therefore asks not only whether a response is aligned or an action authorized, but whether safety properties survive the accumulation, generalization, and cross-context reuse of locally useful experience. We introduce SAVER, a transition-centered framework in which Substrate locates reusable influence, Adaptation captures how it changes, Violation identifies compromised safety attributes, Exposure marks where failures become observable, and Response assesses containment, repair, or revocation. Our survey reveals that failures need not originate from harmful information: legitimate state can become unsafe when adaptation expands its persistence, authority, or scope beyond the conditions under which it was valid. Existing work provides comparatively strong evidence for admission, retrieval, activation, exposure, and local containment, but much less for descendant repair and evaluation after adaptation resumes. We therefore argue for longitudinal evaluation that traces unsafe influence to its originating transition, verifies repair across descendants, and tests whether it can re-emerge under continued evolution.

</details>


### [797] [Characterizing and Codifying Malware Sophistication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00098)
*Angelo Porcella,Zachary Wadhams,Clemente Izurieta,Jonathan Crussell,Ann Marie Reinhold*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文对现有恶意软件质量评估方法进行系统化梳理，从ISO/IEC 25010软件质量标准中重新解释可靠性、可维护性、灵活性、安全性等特性，界定恶意软件"复杂性（sophistication）"，并筛选出与恶意软件相关且可通过静态二进制分析度量的特性，为后续评估框架奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "Sophisticated"（复杂性/精密性）虽广泛用于描述恶意软件，但学术文献中缺乏统一定义。现有软件质量与复杂度度量仅能反映恶意软件结构的部分信息，无法刻画导致真实威胁潜力的对抗性与操作性特征。

Method: 采用静态二进制分析的思路，对现有恶意软件质量评估方法进行系统化（systematization）；以质量视角重新解释ISO/IEC 25010软件质量标准中的部分特性，评估其应用于恶意软件二进制的适用性，并识别哪些特性既与恶意软件相关又可通过静态分析度量。

Result: 界定了从质量视角出发的恶意软件复杂性概念，明确了可适用于恶意软件二进制的ISO/IEC 25010特性集合，并确定了可通过静态分析测量的特性，构成一致性评估框架的基础。

Conclusion: 该研究为在缺乏源代码或无法进行动态执行的情况下，一致地评估恶意软件复杂性提供了基础，但仍处于框架构建阶段，尚未给出完整评估体系。

Abstract: 'Sophisticated' is widely used to describe malware, yet it lacks a consistent definition within academic literature. While existing software quality and complexity metrics offer some insight into malware structure, they do not capture the broader adversarial and operational traits that contribute to real-world threat potential. This paper presents a systematization of existing approaches for assessing malware quality using static binary analysis. We define malware sophistication through a quality-focused lens by reinterpreting select characteristics from the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality standard, including reliability, maintainability, flexibility, and security, and evaluating their applicability to malware binaries. We identify which characteristics are both relevant to malware and measurable through static analysis, forming the basis for future frameworks that consistently assess malware sophistication when source code is unavailable or dynamic execution is infeasible.

</details>


### [798] [A Comprehensive Review of One-Pixel Attack: Research Status, Taxonomy, Applications, Regulation Policy and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00125)
*Mirza Niaz Morshed,Md. Masudul Islam,Galib Muhammad Shahriar Himel,Md. Aslam Uddin,Hui Liu,Md. Shafiqul Islam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对2017—2026年单像素攻击（OPA）研究进行PRISMA系统综述，构建多维度分类体系，指出其方法、防御与评估现状及未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单像素攻击仅改一个像素即可高置信度诱导误分类，在医疗诊断、自动驾驶、生物识别、量子通信等领域构成严重威胁，但现有对抗攻击综述对其覆盖零散、浅显，缺乏统一梳理。

Method: 采用PRISMA引导的系统综述方法，筛选2017—2026年高质量研究，构建涵盖算法基础、黑盒进化优化、混合与程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具及领域特定脆弱性的多轴统一分类体系，并归纳评估防御范式及其权衡。

Result: 分析显示：差分进化策略占据主导，效率优化与显著性引导方法兴起；数据集多样性、可迁移性和标准化评估仍存在持续缺口；防御范式在鲁棒性、不可感知性与计算开销之间存在权衡。

Conclusion: 本文为理解、评估与缓解当代AI系统中的超稀疏对抗威胁奠定综合基础，并提出选择性像素恢复、Transformer特定脆弱性分析、显著性驱动优化、领域自适应防御等未来方向，以及强调鲁棒性测试、事件披露与AI安全治理的监管框架。

Abstract: One-Pixel Attacks (OPAs) represent one of the most extreme demonstrations of adversarial fragility in deep learning, where modifying a single pixel can reliably induce high-confidence misclassification across domains such as medical diagnosis, autonomous driving, biometrics, and quantum communication. Despite their conceptual simplicity, OPAs remain underexamined in existing adversarial-attack surveys, which provide only fragmented or cursory coverage. This PRISMA-guided review synthesizes high-quality studies from 2017 to 2026 and delivers a unified, multi-axis taxonomy of OPA research spanning algorithmic foundations, black-box evolutionary optimization, emerging hybrid and program-synthesis attacks, defence mechanisms, interpretability tools, and domain-specific vulnerabilities. Our analysis reveals the dominance of Differential Evolution-based strategies, the rise of efficiency-optimized and saliency-guided methods, and persistent gaps in dataset diversity, transferability, and standardized evaluation. We summarized and assess defence paradigms including pixel restoration, anomaly detection, input-space transformations, and robust training highlighting their trade-offs in robustness, imperceptibility, and computational overhead. Building on these insights, we outline future research priorities involving selective pixel recovery, transformer-specific vulnerability analysis, saliency-driven optimization, and real-world domain-adaptive defences. We further propose a regulatory framework emphasizing robustness testing, incident disclosure, and AI security governance. This review establishes a comprehensive foundation for understanding, evaluating, and mitigating ultra-sparse adversarial threats in contemporary AI systems.

</details>


### [799] [A Verifier Can Leak the Answer: Diagnosability Before Optimization in Closed-Loop Agent Debugging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00126)
*Peiying Zhu,Sidi Chang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了一个代理验证器（verifier）失败模式：当探针或谓词编码了目标身份时，精确求解器的比较会变得空洞（求解器正确但验证器早已泄露答案）。作者提出以"支持门控验证契约"替代求解器优先的评测，并在1440例预注册heldout上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理开发者常用基于模拟器的验证器来比较提示、工具、策略和诊断算法。但若验证器的探针或谓词编码了目标身份，精确优化器可能看似有效却未解决任何真实歧义，导致求解器比较变得空洞无效。作者观察到这一失败，希望先验证证据的资格与非泄露性，再优化选择器。

Method: 在一个闭环决策代理的聚合轨迹调试器上报告该失败：对比精确最小命中集（MHS）与传播感知贪心法。通过审计发现精确锚点谓词在9/9案例中直接产出植入对。移除锚点后采用新的"支持门控验证契约"：(1) 干净的参考图须先展示重复的组件暴露；(2) 匹配的参考/当前门须确立可比的运行时证据；(3) 之后由独立校准的信号规则返回检测。在预注册heldout（1440例、21600分区行）上评估。

Result: 精确MHS与贪心在12/12开发案例中返回相同支持集，9/12中恢复相同植入故障。审计发现精确锚点谓词在9/9案例产出植入对。移除锚点后整体植入对恢复为8/9；但硬探针单例对在9/9匹配植入对，且传播后无案例保留非空残差冲突族（0/9）。heldout中：55/72 regime-component单元通过参考门，54/55通过运行时门，稳定误接纳为0/20（单侧精确95%上界0.1391）。在被接纳单元内，受影响干净流量的检测预测优于名义故障单元比例。

Conclusion: 核心教训是结构性的：在优化组件选择器之前，必须先验证证据资格与非泄露性。否则更强的求解器只能证明一个更强的验证器伪影（artifact），而非真实能力。

Abstract: Agent developers increasingly compare prompts, tools, policies, and diagnosis algorithms through simulator-grounded verifiers. A verifier can nevertheless make a solver comparison vacuous: if its probes or predicates encode the target identity, an exact optimizer may appear effective without resolving any genuine ambiguity. We report such a failure in an aggregate-trace debugger for a closed-loop decision agent. Exact minimum hitting set (MHS) and a propagation-aware greedy method returned identical supports in 12/12 development cases and the same planted-fault recovery in 9/12. A subsequent audit found that exact-anchor predicates produced the planted pair in 9/9 cases. After removing those anchors, overall planted-pair recovery was 8/9; hard-probe singleton pairs nevertheless matched the planted pair in 9/9, and no case retained a nonempty residual conflict family after propagation (0/9). The optimizer was correct, but the verifier had already disclosed the answer. We replace solver-first evaluation with a support-gated verification contract. A clean reference map must first show repeated component exposure; a matched reference/current gate must then establish comparable runtime evidence; only afterward may an independently calibrated signal rule return a detection. In a preregistered heldout comprising 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows, 55/72 regime-component units passed the reference gate, 54/55 passed the runtime gate, and stable false admission was 0/20 represented components with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic predicted detection better than nominal fault-cell fraction. The main lesson is structural: verify evidence eligibility and non-revelation before optimizing the component selector. Otherwise a stronger solver can merely certify a stronger verifier artifact.

</details>


### [800] [The Cognitive Continuity Test: Verifying Governed State Transitions in Persistent AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00132)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出认知连续性测试（CCT），一种策略相关的契约框架，用于验证持续型AI智能体提交的状态转移；配套 IdentityLineageBench 基准（24 类转移、576 个标注样本）验证其合成一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续型AI智能体会修正信念、整合记忆并替换执行基底，导致相似的后继状态可能对应不同授权依据的转移声明，而合法的开发演进又可能大幅改变状态。因此需要一个能区分"已验证可接受""明确违规""证据不足"的验证机制。

Method: CCT 通过作用域权限、来源溯源、确定性应用、语义谓词和候选持久化凭证来验证提交的转移；方法包含可满足性分离结果，并区分已验证可接受、肯定性违规与未解决的必需证据三种判定。评估使用 IdentityLineageBench（24 个生成的转移家族）及签名对抗性回归测试。

Result: 参考后解析验证器匹配全部 576 个规范留出标签；词法状态相似度基线与仅谱系诊断基线分别放过 60.0% 和 80.0% 的无效样本。18,000 次执行的有效路径研究显示驻留输入上默认中位延迟为 6.21 ms。

Conclusion: CCT 的分离结果针对转移声明而非实时运行时身份，其健全性依赖于指定检查器与评估器假设；结果仅确立合成一致性，不代表优于策略感知的已部署系统。SIT 行为与实际模型迁移尚未测量，部署还需补充激活与恢复义务。

Abstract: Persistent AI agents revise beliefs, consolidate memory, and replace execution substrates. Similar successor states can accompany differently authorized transition claims, while legitimate development can change state substantially. We introduce the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying submitted transitions using scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application, semantic predicates, and candidate-persistence receipts. CCT distinguishes verified admissibility, affirmative violation, and unresolved required evidence. Separation results concern transition claims rather than live runtime identity; soundness is conditional on the specified checker and evaluator assumptions.
  IdentityLineageBench provides 24 generated transition families. The reference post-resolution verifier matches all 576 canonical held-out labels; lexical state similarity and a lineage-only diagnostic baseline admit 60.0% and 80.0% of invalid fixtures. These comparisons establish synthetic conformance, not superiority to a policy-aware deployed system. Signed adversarial regressions cover fabricated interaction counts, unsupported belief changes, and mixed missing/contradictory evidence. SIT behavior and actual model migration remain unmeasured. An 18,000-execution valid-path study measures a 6.21 ms default median on resident inputs. We specify the additional activation and recovery obligations needed for deployment.

</details>


### [801] [Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00136)
*Parker Hummel,Ryne Skabo,Muhammad Abusaqer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文通过可复现的教学实验对比图像与文本分类的规避攻击：MNIST上的CNN在FGSM/PGD下准确率剧降，而SMS垃圾短信上的DistilBERT在预定义扰动下几乎不翻转，说明对抗脆弱性强烈依赖模态，稳健性须实证检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 干净准确率高并不代表模型稳健，但这一点常被忽视。作者希望用可复现的教学型实验，直观展示对抗样本对分类模型的实际威胁，并考察这种威胁是否随模态（图像 vs 文本）而变化，从而强调稳健性必须通过实证评估而非由干净精度推断。

Method: 研究包含两个实验。实验一为图像分类：在MNIST上训练紧凑卷积网络，进行白盒FGSM与PGD攻击，扫描扰动强度\varepsilon（如0.15、0.30），并测试比特深度压缩防御的效果。实验二为文本分类：在SMS Spam Collection上微调DistilBERT，施加预定义扰动序列（字符替换、空白噪声、良性后缀），观察输出概率变化及标签翻转情况。

Result: 图像实验中，MNIST CNN干净测试准确率为98.63%；FGSM下\varepsilon=0.15时降至60.20%，\varepsilon=0.30时降至1.72%；PGD下降至32.47%与0.41%；比特深度压缩防御仅恢复部分精度。文本实验中，DistilBERT准确率98.75%、F1为94.96%，但在所受扰动下多数样例仅出现小幅概率偏移，未发生spam到ham的翻转。

Conclusion: 对抗脆弱性具有明显的模态依赖性：MNIST实验构成清晰的规避攻击演示，而文本实验更像受控的稳健性评估。模型的高干净精度不能保证稳健性，稳健性必须通过经验性对抗测试来验证。

Abstract: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $ε$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $ε$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.

</details>


### [802] [Intrusion Detection for Agentic Processes: Evidence-Based Runtime Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00151)
*Arslan Brömme*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 A-IDS：一种以智能体流程本身为监控对象的证据感知型运行时入侵检测解释层，通过将证据支持的观测与受治理、带版本的期望基线（流程状态、授权、通信、强制事件）进行比对来识别安全相关偏差，属概念性贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体部署日益融合语言模型推理与检索、委派、工具执行、外部系统访问及人类审批，安全相关偏差可能在整个演化流程中逐步显现，而非局限于单一输入或动作。既有工作（作者早期的黑盒智能体流程架构与后续的证据-断言模型）缺乏面向流程整体的运行时安全解释层。

Method: 概念性建模，核心要素包括：动态到期（dynamically due）的受治理期望；将可见性与三值匹配相分离；显式的“未解决”观测状态；区分证据状态与运营影响的有界发现（bounded findings）。同时将监控平面本身视为攻击面（对抗内容经合法观测路径抵达语义证据生产者）。不假设完全可观测性或捕获普遍可信；将提示注入同时视为输入安全问题与后续流程偏差及跨智能体影响路径的可能来源。

Result: 无数值实验或检测性能结果。文中明确边界：不从异常行为推断恶意意图，不将未观测事件视为未发生之证明，不宣称提出新的异常检测器、时序逻辑或溯源模型；亦不验证实现、不展示实证检测性能、不建立因果归因、不提供执行/强制机制。

Conclusion: A-IDS 的贡献是概念性的：给出一种证据感知、面向智能体流程整体的运行时入侵检测解释框架，为后续实现验证与实证评估留出空间。

Abstract: Agent deployments increasingly combine language-model inference with retrieval, delegation, tool execution, external-system access, and human approval. Security-relevant deviations can therefore emerge across an evolving process rather than in one isolated input or action. Building on the author's earlier black-box architecture for agentic processes and the subsequent evidence-claim model, this paper proposes an Agentic-Process Intrusion Detection System (A-IDS), an evidence-aware security interpretation layer for runtime intrusion detection whose monitored object is the agentic process itself. A-IDS compares evidence-supported observations with a governed and versioned expectation baseline for workflow state, authorization, communication, and mandatory events. Its conceptual contribution combines dynamically due governed expectations, visibility separated from three-valued matching, explicit unresolved observation states, and bounded findings that separate evidentiary status from operational impact. The model further identifies the monitoring plane itself as an attack surface when adversarial content reaches semantic evidence producers through otherwise legitimate observation paths. Some observations may be produced outside the operational agent's self-report path, but the model does not assume complete observability or universally trustworthy capture. Prompt injection is treated both as an input-security problem and as a possible origin of later process deviations and cross-agent influence paths. A-IDS does not infer malicious intent from anomalous behavior, does not treat an unobserved event as proof of non-occurrence, and does not claim a new anomaly detector, temporal logic, or provenance model. The contribution is conceptual: it does not validate an implementation, demonstrate empirical detection performance, establish causal attribution, or provide an enforcement mechanism.

</details>


### [803] [Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00309)
*Mohamed Shaaban,Mohamed Elmahallawy*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Locket框架将细粒度访问控制嵌入LLM生成过程，通过键控入口令牌路由到不同LoRA适配器，实现无令牌时脱敏、有令牌时解锁私有知识，兼顾效用、隐私与合规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在医疗、金融、政府等隐私敏感领域广泛应用，但其记忆并泄露个人可识别信息（PII）带来严重安全与合规风险。现有防御措施往往在模型效用、隐私保护和微调私有知识访问三者之间被迫权衡，难以兼顾。

Method: 提出Locket（LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens）。训练一组轻量LoRA适配器，每个适配器编码一种访问策略（完全披露、PII掩码部分脱敏、指定差分隐私级别披露等）。训练紧凑门控模块，通过序列级硬路由将学习到的键控入口令牌与唯一LoRA适配器关联：有效令牌作为授权密钥解锁对应私有知识；无效或缺失令牌则触发隐私保护适配器，对敏感内容进行脱敏或净化。该设计兼容现成LLM，支持可扩展部署。

Result: 在Enron、ECHR、Yelp数据集及多种先进LLM（Qwen3 1.7B/8B、Llama-3.2 1B/3B、Gemma-2-2B）上评估：提供正确令牌时，困惑度与无防御的原始数据微调相当；令牌缺失或无效时，显著降低PII泄露，同时效用和困惑度与强基线防御持平。

Conclusion: Locket通过键控入口令牌与LoRA适配器的硬路由机制，将策略驱动的细粒度访问控制直接嵌入LLM生成，在保持模型效用与私有知识可用性的同时满足监管与隐私要求，是可实际部署的隐私保护方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-critical domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, and government), but their propensity to memorize and disclose personally identifiable information (PII) poses serious security and compliance risks. Existing defenses typically force a trade-off between model utility, privacy protection, and access to fine-tuned private knowledge. We propose LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens (Locket), a practical framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation. Locket trains a set of lightweight LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy (e.g., full reveal, partial redaction via PII masking, or reveal under a specified differential privacy level). A compact gating module is trained to associate a learned keyed entry token with exactly one LoRA adapter via sequence-level hard routing; the presence of a valid token acts as an authorization key that unlocks corresponding private knowledge, while an invalid or absent token triggers a privacy-preserving adapter that redacts or sanitizes sensitive content. This design ensures Locket remains fully compatible with off-the-shelf LLMs, supporting scalable deployment while satisfying regulatory and privacy requirements. We evaluate Locket across multiple datasets (Enron, ECHR, Yelp) and a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs, including Qwen3 (1.7B and 8B), Meta's Llama-3.2 (1B and 3B), and Google's Gemma-2-2B. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that, when the correct token is provided, Locket preserves perplexity comparable to fine-tuning on raw data (without any defense). Conversely, when the token is missing or invalid, it substantially reduces PII leakage while maintaining utility and perplexity on par with strong baseline defenses.

</details>


### [804] [Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00327)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Yina Sa,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"以论断为锚的执行契约"，将输出论断、精确原文片段、有序执行前缀以及来源版本/访问状态联合绑定，用确定性完整性校验器在语义支持判定之前重建绑定关系，并暴露七个可独立测试的性质。在1280个跨对象攻击中检出1275个（0.9961），移除任一目标性质后检出率降至0.0156–0.0625；冲突感知的支持守卫在384对裁判集上F1为0.8865、误接受率0.0729。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具型智能体虽能给出引用与执行日志，但二者之间的关键关联未被审计：展示给用户的论断是否为已提交执行所产出、且由所引来源支持，仍无法核验。有效引用与有效轨迹可以各自独立成立，却被跨论断、跨动作、跨运行或跨来源版本"移植"，导致结构上看似合规但语义链条断裂。

Method: 提出以论断为锚的执行契约（claim-anchored execution contract），联合绑定四项要素：输出论断、其精确来源跨度、产生该论断的有序执行前缀、以及该次执行观测到的来源版本与访问状态。每个receipt包含emission anchor，可确定性地在已提交答案或承载论断的动作中定位该论断，并附带来源标识、偏移、哈希、引文与域分隔的执行承诺。确定性完整性校验器在接入语义或任务标签之前先重建这些绑定。系统将完整性平面与可插拔的支持平面分离，避免以结构有效性代替蕴含判定。

Result: 契约暴露七个可独立测试的性质：论断—输出绑定、来源绑定、有序执行绑定、预言机分离、持久化对象回放、执行重跑一致性、版本/访问绑定。在1280个跨对象攻击中，联合契约检出1275个替换（0.9961）；移除某一目标性质后，对应攻击检出率降至0.0156–0.0625。在独立裁判的384对划分上，冲突感知的支持守卫达到F1 0.8865、误接受率0.0729；在未见失败族上分别为0.8679与0.0938。

Conclusion: 将论断级绑定作为独立的完整性平面，可有效检测跨论断、跨动作、跨运行、跨版本的引用/轨迹移植攻击，且各性质均具可分离的检测贡献。完整性校验与语义支持判定解耦，使结构合规不再被误用为蕴含成立。未来可扩展到更广的来源版本与访问状态模型及更多失败族。

Abstract: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.

</details>


### [805] [UnifiedAttack: Evaluating the Safety of Large Multimodal Models in Synergistic Harmful Image-Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00341)
*Bingjun Luo,Jialin Guo,Tony Wang,Siqi Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 UnifiedAttack 基准与协同劫持框架，用于评估原生统一架构大模型在图文协同有害生成任务中的安全性，通过跨模态协同产生的危害增益来衡量风险，并验证现有对齐机制可被系统绕过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型正转向原生统一架构，安全评估需覆盖图文协同场景：单模态无害的组分在协同下可能产生远超其各自危害的协同风险，而现有对齐与评测方法难以刻画这种跨模态协同危害。

Method: 构建 UnifiedAttack 基准，包含按多模态潜力筛选的样本与合成的虚假信息查询子集；提出协同劫持框架，含 In-Context Reskinning（ICR，用少样本学习将对抗意图包装为良性虚拟外壳以弱化安全过滤）与 Cognitive Planning Injection（CPI，以"先规划后执行"范式劫持推理路径，先诱导模型承诺中性逻辑计划，再利用其一致性驱动生成有害多模态内容）。

Result: 在当前最先进架构上的广泛评测表明，UnifiedAttack 可稳定绕过现代对齐机制，说明统一模型的结构性有用性与逻辑连贯性可被系统性武器化。

Conclusion: 协同生成任务暴露了统一模型的新安全盲区，凸显对"逻辑感知"防御的迫切需求；代码已开源。

Abstract: As Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) transition toward natively unified architectures, evaluating their safety in synergistic harmful image-text generation tasks becomes a critical challenge. Unlike unimodal threats, synergistic risks emerge when text and image modalities are coordinated to produce harm that significantly exceeds their individual components. We introduce UnifiedAttack, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate LMM safety in collaborative scenarios by focusing on the harmfulness gain achieved through cross-modal synergy. The benchmark incorporates samples filtered for their multimodal potential alongside a novel subset of synthesized disinformation queries. To verify identified vulnerabilities, we propose a synergistic hijacking framework featuring In-Context Reskinning (ICR) and Cognitive Planning Injection (CPI). ICR utilizes few-shot learning to wrap adversarial intent in benign virtual shells to desensitize safety filters, while CPI hijacks the reasoning path by enforcing a plan-then-execute paradigm. By compelling the system to commit to a neutral logical plan, we exploit its internal drive for consistency to induce the synchronized generation of harmful multimodal content. Extensive evaluations on state-of-the-art architectures demonstrate that UnifiedAttack consistently bypasses modern alignment. Our findings reveal that the structural helpfulness and logical coherence of unified models can be systematically weaponized, highlighting the urgent need for logic-aware defenses in synergistic generation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/UnifiedAttack .

</details>


### [806] [Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00347)
*Genliang Zhu,Chu Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出"授权继承"（authorization succession）机制，将自修改AI代理的授权绑定到单亲生成森林的活动前沿，实现种群级安全的自修改与分叉管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自修改AI代理可替换、分叉、回滚携带身份标识的软件，且后代仍可执行。现有的"逐后继授权"无法约束整个种群：兄弟节点可能重复配额、合并权限、规避祖先切断，或在升级期间与前任重叠，导致授权失控。

Method: 设计外部协议：每代绑定manifest、root、唯一parent、完整lineage与全新population sequence；分离不变量约束根生存期消耗与当前种群暴露。采用分阶段预留（staged reservation）在替换时冻结前任残留权限；分叉时对完整子代族进行分区校验。每次提交原子性地围栏（fence）前任并激活后继。祖先切断使依赖后代失效；回滚生成全新代而不恢复已耗授权；新root需独立授权。证明依赖五项假设：完全中介、认证记录、健全效应抽象、持久单调状态、完整谱系记账。

Result: 可执行评估覆盖32项注册决策，经直接调用与邮箱映射实现64/64重放（28允许、36拒绝）。独立检查器接受全部64条原始轨迹，拒绝28/28语义变异体；12/12 profile不变量、16/16崩溃切断、32/32竞争者调度通过。两个外部适配器在实测的OurArk与Darwin Gödel Machine变异上复现全部32项决策，包括新进程重启、原子继承与前任拒绝。

Conclusion: 在五项假设下证明了种群安全继承、分叉守恒、撤销闭包、原子交接、回滚不重铸及自认证排除。结果为面向注册保护效应的授权继承提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Self-modifying AI agents can replace, fork, and roll back identity-bearing software while descendants remain executable. Per-successor authorization does not constrain the resulting population: siblings may duplicate quotas, combine permissions, survive ancestor cuts, or overlap predecessors during promotion. We define authorization succession, which conserves authority across the active frontier of a single-parent generation forest.
  Our external protocol binds each generation to a manifest, root, unique parent, complete lineage, and fresh population sequence. Separate invariants bound root-lifetime consumption and current population exposure. A staged reservation freezes predecessor residual authority during replacement, while a partitioning fork validates the complete child family. Each commit atomically fences the predecessor and activates successors. Ancestor cuts invalidate dependent descendants; rollback creates a fresh generation without restoring spent authority; and a new root requires an independent grant. Under complete mediation, authenticated records, sound effect abstraction, durable monotone state, and complete lineage accounting, we prove population-safe succession, fork conservation, revocation closure, atomic handoff, rollback non-reminting, and exclusion of self-certification.
  An executable evaluation covers 32 registered decisions through direct-call and mailbox mappings (64/64 replays; 28 allows, 36 denies). An independent checker accepts all 64 original traces and rejects 28/28 semantic mutants; 12/12 profile invariants, 16/16 crash cuts, and 32/32 contender schedules pass. Two external adapters reproduce all 32 decisions around measured OurArk and Darwin Godel Machine mutations, including fresh-process restart, atomic succession, and predecessor rejection. The results establish authorization succession for registered protected effects.

</details>


### [807] [Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00348)
*Minoo Kim,Vasileios Lampos,George Drayson*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: NEEDLE：一种免训练的后门定向移除方法，通过激活向量估计后门方向与拒答子空间，并施加顺序权重正交化，在极低攻击成功率下最小化对模型能力与安全性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对大语言模型的后门防御在移除后门时，往往会使模型对良性提示的输出分布发生偏移，导致模型性能下降与安全性受损。且已有方法通常需要干净参考模型或原始投毒训练数据，限制其适用性。

Method: 提出 NEEDLE，一种免训练的后门定向移除方法。在触发词被识别后，利用激活向量估计后门方向与拒答（refusal）子空间，并施加顺序权重正交化（sequential weight orthogonalisation），在抑制后门行为的同时避免改变与拒答相关的表征。该方法既不需要干净参考模型，也不需要原始投毒训练数据。

Result: 在多种模型家族与多种攻击类型上进行评估。NEEDLE 在所评估的防御方法中取得最低的平均攻击成功率（ASR），在具有挑战性的代码注入攻击上达到 0% ASR，同时带来最低的 KL 散度，并且模型能力与安全性变化最小。

Conclusion: NEEDLE 以无需训练、无需干净参考模型与投毒数据的方式实现了定向后门移除，在显著降低攻击成功率的同时，最大限度保持模型的原始能力与安全对齐，优于现有后门防御方法。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks can be implanted in Large Language Models (LLMs) during training, causing unwanted behaviour when a trigger appears in the input. Existing backdoor defences for LLMs attempt to remove the backdoor but inadvertently shift the model's output distribution to benign prompts, which can result in degraded model performance and safety. We propose NEEDLE, a training-free method for targeted backdoor removal. Once a trigger has been identified, our method estimates a backdoor direction and a refusal subspace through activation vectors, then applies sequential weight orthogonalisation to suppress the backdoor while preventing changes in refusal-related representations. NEEDLE requires neither a clean reference model nor the original poisoned training data. Evaluation is conducted across multiple model families and attack types. NEEDLE achieves the lowest mean Attack Success Rate (ASR) among the evaluated defences, including 0% on challenging code injection attacks, while resulting in the lowest KL divergence and minimal changes in capability and safety.

</details>


### [808] [Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00354)
*Bravish Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Proof-Gated Signing (PGS)：先仿真交易并提取效果，再用 SMT 求解器在预言机不确定区间内校验声明式的价值与权限策略，并编译链上后置条件（余额上下界、收款方回执、授权上限与所有权），证明满足后置条件的任意执行也满足策略；由智能合约钱包原子执行，从而在任意状态漂移下保证已执行交易合规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制钱包的 AI 代理会读取攻击者可触及的内容，可能被诱导提出有害交易。现有签署前检查（静态白名单、LLM 审查、交易仿真）共同缺陷是：检查刻画的是检查时刻的链上状态，而交易在更晚、可被对手通过抢跑、合约升级或代币参数变更塑造的状态中执行，即"状态漂移"，导致检查失效。

Method: PGS 包含四步：(1) 仿真拟定交易并抽取其效果；(2) 用 SMT 求解器在预言机不确定性带内对每个价格检验声明式的价值与权限策略；(3) 编译链上后置条件，包括钱包余额上下界、收款方收款凭证、授权额度上限与所有权约束；(4) 证明任何满足后置条件的执行都满足策略，并由智能合约钱包原子化强制执行。

Result: 在含 260 个场景的开放测试台（14 类攻击族，含 5 类漂移族与 2 类自适应族，以及 12 类良性族），以攻击者余额而非策略本身度量危害：PGS 阻止了 140 个有害场景中的 93.6%，通过 97.5% 的良性场景；纯仿真检查为 57.9%，静态白名单为 71.4%。50 个漂移场景在 PGS 下均未产生攻击者收益。唯一未被阻止的族为策略内抽干，由每会话预算限定。此外发现，向 LLM 审查者提供干净的漂移前仿真会提高其批准漂移攻击的可能性。开销约为每次检查 41k gas 与 0.1–0.2 秒。

Conclusion: PGS 通过在不确定性带内进行策略求解并生成可被链上原子执行的后置条件，弥合了签署前检查与执行时状态之间的"状态漂移"缺口，在多数攻击族（含全部漂移场景）上显著优于仿真检查与静态白名单，且开销可控；残余风险主要是策略内抽干，可用会话预算约束。

Abstract: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.

</details>


### [809] [On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00382)
*Rongke Liu,Youwen Zhu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究模型量化如何影响模型反演攻击及其与数据特性的关系，提出了一种隐私感知的训练后量化方法，在保持效用的同时提升抗反演能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化会降低权重与激活的数值精度，而模型反演攻击可从模型输出或中间特征中恢复敏感训练数据或推理输入，因此量化可能改变反演攻击的有效性。但量化如何影响模型反演、数据特性又如何影响这一关系，两个问题尚未解决。

Method: 第一，界定量化对"由预测概率定义的类别变量"与输入之间互信息变化的影响上界，以区分信息性效应与攻击优化障碍；第二，识别特征分布与反演结果的数据依赖变化，发现4比特处显著的量化敏感性差异。据此提出隐私感知训练后量化方法：使用Fisher型任务敏感度代理进行预算感知的比特分配，校准激活范围，并以任务恢复与几何保持目标联合优化权重/激活尺度和权重舍入决策，同时加入尺度与舍入正则化。

Result: 在ResNet-50、Palm数据集4比特下，RL-MIA严格成功率从54%降至26%，而精度相对FP32仅从99.01%降至96.55%。方法还支持输出级防御：在Iris、4.5比特下加入Stealthy Shield Defense（epsilon=0.1），BREP-MI严格成功率从63.33%降至37.33%，精度相对仅量化从92.8%降至87.6%。

Conclusion: 量化会显著改变模型反演攻击效果，且该影响具有数据依赖性；所提隐私感知训练后量化方法能够在多个指标、网络架构及人脸、掌纹、虹膜识别任务上有效提升抗反演能力，同时较好地恢复模型效用。

Abstract: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship?
