We adopt a Markov chain Monte Carlo-based Bayesian privacy estimation method to estimate the privacy of our proposed framework. Our results show that this method improves both model utility and estimated privacy over the baseline method that relies solely on differential privacy for training. In our experiments with the FEMNIST dataset, by the end of training, our method reaches a test loss of $1.09$, compared to $2.37$ for the differential privacy-only approach, while providing stronger estimated privacy protection, with the estimated posterior mean of the privacy parameter $ε$ of $4.32$, compared to $7.26$ for the differential privacy-only approach. We also show that intermittent model monitoring can preserve the encrypted training trajectory while, under our evaluated experimental setting, providing estimated privacy comparable to or stronger than the differential privacy-only approach.

</details>


### [842] [The Achilles' Heel of Partial Reconfiguration: Optical Side-Channel Leakage on the 7-Series ICAP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01736)
*Antonio Saavedra,Jan Caspar Marx,Lars Renkes,Jean-Pierre Seifert*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对7系列FPGA提出AMD非对称密钥比特流保护方案的概念验证实现（基于可编程逻辑部分重构），分析其安全性与硬件开销，并展示一种利用光子发射显微镜与电光探测的光学侧信道攻击，可从ICAP接口非接触提取明文配置数据，证明即使采用高级加密与自定义密码引擎仍易受光学攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流FPGA厂商采用比特流加密保护配置数据，但广泛使用的FPGA系列中，硬连线的不可修补保护方案已被多种攻击绕过或完全破解，因此亟需可修补（patchable）的保护方案；同时需评估此类新方案的实际安全性。

Method: 在7系列FPGA上，利用可编程逻辑发起部分重构，实现AMD提出的非对称密钥比特流保护方案的概念验证；分析其安全影响与硬件开销；随后采用光子发射显微镜（PEM）与电光探测（EOP）进行光学侧信道攻击，先定位ICAP接口，再非接触式提取动态重构过程中的明文配置数据（在AMD XC7A200T器件上验证）。

Result: 在AMD XC7A200T器件中成功定位ICAP总线，并证明可通过电光探测提取其上的数据；即动态重构过程中的明文配置数据可被非接触方式恢复。

Conclusion: 即便采用部分重构与自定义密码引擎的高级加密方案，由于重构必须经由硬连线且脆弱的配置接口，仍易受光学攻击；表明可修补保护方案的实际部署仍需考虑物理侧信道威胁。

Abstract: Major FPGA manufacturers have incorporated bitstream encryption to protect sensitive configuration data. However, for the most widely used FPGA families, multiple attacks against unpatchable protection schemes hard-wired into the devices can bypass or fully break them, making patchable schemes desirable.
  In this work, we present a proof-of-concept implementation of an AMD-proposed asymmetric key encryption scheme for bitstream protection for 7-Series FPGAs, using partial reconfiguration from the Programmable Logic. We analyze the security implications and hardware overhead of this implementation. We then propose and demonstrate an optical side-channel attack that is able to recover plain-text configuration data during the dynamic reconfiguration process. This attack leverages Photon Emission Microscopy and Electro-Optical Probing to first locate and then contactlessly extract the plain-text data from the ICAP interface, which internally connects the Programmable Logic with the configuration logic.
  We located the ICAP buses in an AMD XC7A200T device and show that the data on it can be extracted with Electro-Optical Probing. We claim that even advanced encryption schemes utilizing Partial Reconfiguration and custom cryptographic engines are vulnerable to optical attacks, as reconfiguration is only possible via hard-wired, vulnerable configuration interfaces.

</details>


### [843] [SoK: Decentralized Agent Economic Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01756)
*Rui Sun,Xihan Xiong,Qin Wang,Fei Gao,Zelin Li,Zehua Cheng,Jiahao Sun,Zhipeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文系统化了去中心化智能体经济中跨协议组合导致的任务级安全与经济学保证失效问题，提出"保证闭包"准则，并在840次匹配执行与11,648个穷举案例中揭示了验证与结算之间的反复失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化智能体经济常将分别设计与加固的协议拼装成单一任务，导致工作流每一步都"看起来正确"却产生错误结果。例如，正确的托管机制可能依据一个仅表明授权通过、却几乎不证明交付成果真正满足任务的审批就释放付款。

Method: 作者在智能体任务全生命周期上系统化该问题，将安全与经济需求组织为6个阶段上的17个属性族，并单独评估收据的健全性与完备性；考察12个系统与标准、5类可复用机制族及4种经典基线；提出"保证闭包"——一个任务相对性准则，用于判定某阶段建立的保证是否仍然可用，并能约束后续依赖它们的决策；随后将该准则应用于受控与原生工作流。

Result: 实验结果覆盖840次匹配执行，以及在一个有限目标-任务域上的11,648例穷举检查，暴露出验证与结算之间反复出现的失效：符合规范的工作可能不被接受，或有效证据被忽略。公开记录与模型判断进一步区分了"记录在案的审批"与"任务符合性的证据"，而经济分析识别出这些保证背后的报告、惩罚与共享误差假设。

Conclusion: 研究指出现有端到端保证在何处失效，以及为在整个工作流中保持这些保证需要修复什么。

Abstract: Decentralized agent economies increasingly build a single task from protocols that were designed and secured separately. This creates a simple problem: a workflow can look correct at each step and still produce the wrong outcome. For example, a correct escrow may release payment on an authorized approval that provides little evidence that the delivered work actually satisfied the task.
  We systematize this problem across the full lifecycle of an agent task. Our study organizes security and economic requirements into 17 property families over six stages, with receipt soundness and completeness assessed separately. We examine 12 systems and standards, five reusable mechanism families, and four classical baselines. We introduce guarantee closure, a task-relative criterion for determining whether guarantees established at one stage remain available and constrain the later decisions that depend on them.
  We apply the criterion to controlled and native workflows, covering 840 matched executions and an exhaustive 11,648-case check over a finite objective-task domain. Our results expose recurring failures between verification and settlement, where conforming work can remain unaccepted or valid evidence can be ignored. Public records and model judgments further distinguish recorded approval from evidence of task conformance, while economic analysis identifies the report, penalty, and shared-error assumptions behind these guarantees. These findings show where end-to-end guarantees fail and what must be repaired to preserve them across the workflow.

</details>


### [844] [The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01768)
*Alessandro Pegoraro,Daryan Merx,Phillip Rieger,Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: LLMLeak是一种新型攻击向量：本地恶意软件无法直接联网时，可利用LLM的网页获取工具建立隐蔽信道，将机密数据编码进URL，通过攻击者控制的DNS或Web服务器外泄。在11个开源模型上平均攻击成功率达79.7%，并在真实聊天机器人上验证了其现实相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM及LLM智能体被广泛用于日常任务（如处理邮件、编程支持），其安全与隐私风险已被大量研究，例如提示注入、向聊天机器人运营商泄露敏感数据等。现有缓解方案包括输入结构化以抵御提示注入、部署本地LLM以避免与运营商共享机密数据。然而，即便采用这些防护，LLM仍存在向第三方泄露机密数据的风险，这一维度尚未被充分关注：本地恶意软件本身无法直接访问互联网，却可能借助LLM作为中介实现数据外泄。

Method: 提出LLMLeak攻击向量。其核心思路是：客户端本地恶意组件将机密信息编码嵌入到一个URL中，并将该URL伪装成完成某项良性任务（如迁移软件库）所必需的参考网站，诱使LLM调用其网站获取工具去访问该URL。由于该输入并未指示LLM通过生成代码直接发送数据，也绕开了对网络库的限制，因此难以被检测。当LLM访问该URL时，攻击者通过其控制的DNS或Web服务器即可接收到编码后的机密信息，从而建立一条隐蔽信道。该方法仅依赖LLM获取网站以补充信息的工具能力。

Result: 在11个开放参数模型上进行了广泛评估，观察到79.7%的攻击成功率；同时在真实世界的聊天机器人上开展了案例研究，证明了LLMLeak的现实相关性与可行性。

Conclusion: LLMLeak揭示了一类此前被忽视的威胁：LLM的网页获取工具可被本地无联网能力的恶意软件滥用为隐蔽信道，实现机密数据向第三方的泄露。这表明仅靠输入结构化和本地部署等现有防护不足以覆盖该风险，需要针对LLM工具调用与出站URL建立更完善的检测与管控机制。

Abstract: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties.
  In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. While inputs that instruct the LLM to send data directly via generated code are easy to detect and network libraries are typically restricted, LLMLeak relies only on the LLM's tool to fetch websites for further information. A malicious software component on the client side embeds a secret into a URL. It presents the referenced website as providing information required for a benign task, such as migrating a software library. When the LLM accesses the URL, the attacker receives the encoded secret through an attacker-controlled DNS or web server. We perform an extensive evaluation on eleven open-parameter models, observe an attack success rate of 79.7%, and also conduct a case study on real-world chatbots, demonstrating the relevance of LLMLeak.

</details>


### [845] [Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01871)
*Maria Carmen Jica,Ali Satvaty,Suzan Verberne,Fatih Turkmen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 $\immrag$，一种针对"图像返回型"多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）系统的自适应黑盒数据提取攻击，通过在用户输入图像中嵌入恶意指令并结合相关性加权重采样，单次2500查询运行可重建数百条私有数据条目，最高达非自适应基线的5.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRAG虽能降低幻觉、有效利用外部知识，但引入了新的攻击面，包括隐私信息泄露和抗数据提取攻击的脆弱性。现有提取攻击多通过文本提示诱导模型泄露数据，尚未充分考虑"检索到的视觉产物本身即为响应"的图像返回型MRAG场景，亟需针对多模态数据的防护设计。

Method: 提出 $\immrag$：一种自适应、自动化的黑盒数据提取攻击流程。每次查询将攻击者持有的影子图像与已从系统恢复的图像混合；利用相关性加权重采样（relevance-weighted resampling），引导后续查询向嵌入空间中仍能产生新检索结果的区域移动；与现有基于文本提示的攻击不同，$\immrag$ 将恶意指令嵌入用户提供的输入图像中。

Result: 在三个真实场景（医疗助手、文档处理助手、通用工具）上评估，涵盖多个CLIP族检索器及不同生成器。单次2500次查询运行，在局部特征对应下可重建多达611张放射图像、566份文档扫描件和416张通用图像，检索到的不同数据存储条目数最高达非自适应基线的5.6倍。

Conclusion: $\immrag$ 在图像返回型MRAG场景下表现出较强的自适应数据提取能力，揭示了多模态系统特有的隐私泄露风险，表明亟需专门针对多模态数据设计的安全防护措施。

Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks.
  In this paper, we introduce $\immrag$, an adaptive and automatic data extraction attack procedure operating in a black box setting against \emph{image-returning} MRAG, a configuration in which the retrieved visual artifact is itself the response. Each query blends an attacker-held shadow image with an image already recovered from the system, and relevance-weighted resampling steers subsequent queries towards regions of the embedding space that still yield novel retrievals. Unlike current extraction attacks that aim to persuade the model towards data leakage by placing a malicious query as a textual prompt, $\immrag$ embeds the malicious instructions inside a user-given input image. We evaluate $\immrag$ on three plausible and distinct real-world scenarios: medical assistant, document-focused helper and general purpose tool. The experiments involve the study of the effectiveness of the attack on multiple CLIP-family retrievers, as well as the impact of various generators. A single 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images under local-feature correspondence, and reaches up to $5.6\times$ as many distinct datastore items as a non-adaptive baseline. Our results show the urgent need for safeguards specifically designed for multimodal data.

</details>


### [846] [From Network Intrusion Detection to Blockchain-Backed Endpoint Detection and Response: Mapping the Landscape of Decentralized Detection-and-Response Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01872)
*Yahya Shahsavari,Sara Rouhani,Kaiwen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该SoK论文针对现有区块链辅助IoT/IIoT入侵检测综述的两大缺陷，提出三轴分类法并开展系统性知识梳理与差距分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有区块链辅助物联网（IoT）与工业物联网（IIoT）入侵检测/防御系统（IDS/IPS）的系统性综述存在两项关键局限：一是忽视了向现代端点检测与响应（EDR）及扩展检测与响应（XDR）架构的结构性转变；二是将区块链的不同功能角色混同为一个单一的整体类别，缺乏细粒度区分。

Method: 本文属于系统化知识梳理（SoK）。作者提出一个三轴分类法，从三个维度对相关方案进行分类：（1）检测系统类别（NIDS、HIDS、EDR/XDR）；（2）区块链的功能角色；（3）响应自动化成熟度。并综合整理了2019至2026年间发表于高影响力期刊/会议的研究成果。

Result: 通过上述分类框架，论文给出了严格的差距分析，指出由于延迟、部署与社区（生态）不匹配等原因，真正意义上的“逐端点、以区块链为锚点”的响应闭环几乎尚不存在。同时评估了文献中普遍存在的结构性、跨领域挑战，包括受限设备上的共识延迟、后量子密码脆弱性、智能合约攻击面，以及演进中的基于大语言模型（LLM）检测引擎的对抗脆弱性。

Conclusion: 论文提出了一项全面的研究议程，核心是链上/链下混合编排（hybrid on-chain/off-chain orchestration），以弥合去中心化信任与快速响应自动化之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: While the literature on blockchain-assisted intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) for Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks is mature, existing systematic reviews suffer from two critical limitations: they overlook the structural shift toward modern Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) architectures, and they conflate blockchain's distinct functional roles into a single monolithic category. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) addresses these gaps by proposing a three-axis taxonomy that classifies proposals by detection-system class (NIDS, HIDS, EDR/XDR), blockchain functional role, and response-automation maturity. Synthesizing research published in high-impact venues between 2019 and 2026, we provide a rigorous gap analysis exposing why a genuine per-endpoint blockchain-anchored response loop remains nearly nonexistent due to latency, deployment, and community mismatches. Furthermore, we evaluate structural, cross-cutting challenges persisting across the literature, including consensus latency on constrained devices, post-quantum cryptographic vulnerability, smart-contract attack surfaces, and the adversarial vulnerability of evolving LLM-based detection engines. Finally, we outline a comprehensive research agenda centered on hybrid on-chain/off-chain orchestration to bridge the gap between decentralized trust and rapid response automation.

</details>


### [847] [A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01893)
*Emmanuela Andam,Rana Shaaban,Emanuel Grant,Naima Kaabouch*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对IoT设备因内置安全不足而面临日益严重的恶意软件威胁，提出利用结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型进行恶意软件检测与分类的新框架，首次将S4应用于恶意软件分析，并与其他深度学习架构进行对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预计到2030年IoT设备将达400亿台，广泛应用于工业、医疗、农业、汽车及楼宇/家庭自动化等领域。设备普遍缺乏内置安全机制，形成巨大攻击面，网络犯罪分子借机利用漏洞实施恶意软件攻击、窃取数据并索要赎金。现有安全措施已跟不上IoT的快速增长以及每日新增的恶意软件变种，因此亟需更有效的检测与分类手段来增强IoT系统的鲁棒性与安全性。

Method: 提出一种基于结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型的恶意软件检测与分类框架。该模型对恶意软件样本序列进行离散化处理，捕捉序列中的长程依赖关系，从而识别恶意软件执行流中隐藏的“因”与“果”。同时，将该模型与其他深度学习架构进行性能对比。

Result: 研究实现了S4模型在恶意软件分析中的首次实证应用，并给出了其与其他深度学习架构的全面性能比较结果，为新范式下的后续研究奠定基础。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，利用S4模型对恶意软件执行序列进行长程依赖建模，可为IoT设备提供更有效的恶意软件检测与分类，提升IoT系统整体的安全性与鲁棒性，并开辟了将状态空间序列模型应用于恶意软件分析的新研究方向。

Abstract: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a ransom is typically demanded for its release. Current cybersecurity measures in place are being outpaced by the rapid growth of the IoT, which is accompanied by a subsequent growth in malware variants being created per day. Recognizing this pitfall, this research examines and proposes a novel approach to malware detection and classification to safeguard devices from further attacks and make IoT systems more robust and secure. The framework proposed utilizes a Structured State Space Sequence (S4) model, which discretizes sequences of malware samples in a sequence and captures long-range dependencies, essentially identifying the "cause" and "effect" hidden within malware execution flow. This study presents two novel contributions: the first empirical application of the S4 model for malware analysis, and a comprehensive comparison of its performance against other deep learning architectures, laying the stepping stone for future research in this new paradigm.

</details>


### [848] [Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01907)
*Cesare Gerolimetto Fabrello,Valeria Rossi,Alberto Trombetta,Massimo Caccia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文发现OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器存在周期性分布失真，追溯至bernoulli_exp1所用有理算术库的缺陷实现，并提出基于精确有理算术的修复方案，经10^6样本验证与理论分布不可区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私的正式隐私保证依赖对噪声分布的精确采样；若采样器存在系统性偏差，将破坏隐私保证与统计效度。因此有必要排查并修复采样实现中的隐性缺陷。

Method: 对OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器进行系统性测试，识别输出分布中的周期性失真；通过逐层隔离嵌套采样层次中的组件，将缺陷定位到bernoulli_exp1（实现Bernoulli(e^{-x})采样的底层原语）所依赖的有理算术库的病态实现；随后提出基于精确有理算术的替代实现。

Result: 实验确认采样器存在周期性失真伪影，且根源为有理算术库的错误实现；修复后的采样器在10^6样本的统计验证下，输出与理论分布在所测精度水平上不可区分。

Conclusion: 底层数值原语的实现缺陷会向上传播为差分隐私采样器的系统性偏差；采用精确有理算术可消除该伪影，保障采样精度与隐私保证的可靠性。

Abstract: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.

</details>


### [849] [A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01949)
*Emmanuela Andam,Yasir Abbas Zaidi,Abdelali Hadir,Emmanuel Grant,Naima Kaabouch*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将自编码器特征提取器（AFE）与模型无关元学习（MAML）分类器相结合的混合深度学习框架，用于小样本勒索软件检测；在Ransomware Dataset 2024上，1至50 shot设置下均取得高准确率、F1与MCC，验证了其在极端数据稀缺下的鲁棒性与适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 勒索软件威胁日益严重，攻击频发且影响关键行业，通常经钓鱼邮件、恶意下载或软件漏洞利用获得访问权限，随后加密文件并索要加密货币赎金。传统检测方法面对新型或稀缺样本时表现不佳，系统仍易受攻击，因此需要能够在极少标注数据下快速适应新威胁的检测方案。

Method: 提出混合深度学习框架：Autoencoder Feature Extractor（AFE）生成紧凑的潜在特征，以降低噪声与维度；Model Agnostic Meta Learning（MAML）分类器利用少量标注数据快速适应新威胁。二者结合实现小样本恶意软件检测，并在Ransomware Dataset 2024上开展二分类实验，覆盖1至50 shot多种设置。

Result: 在Ransomware Dataset 2024的二分类任务中，1至50 shot设置下模型持续获得较高的准确率、F1分数与Matthews相关系数（MCC），即使在数据极端稀缺时仍保持可靠分类性能，体现了鲁棒性与对有限数据场景的适应能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将特征提取与元学习相结合可提升对恶意软件的抵御能力，尤其在医疗、制造与公共基础设施等网络攻击会造成重大运营与经济损失的领域具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that combines an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML) classifier for few shot malware detection. The AFE generates compact latent features that reduce noise and dimensionality, while the MAML classifier rapidly adapts to new threats using limited labeled data. Experiments conducted on the Ransomware Dataset 2024 demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework in binary classification tasks. Across one to fifty shot settings, the proposed model consistently achieves high accuracy, F1 score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient values, maintaining reliable classification even under extreme scarcity. These results highlight the model's robustness and effectiveness in adapting to limited data scenarios, demonstrating the potential of combining feature extraction with meta learning to enhance resilience against malware, particularly in sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, and public infrastructure, where cyberattacks can cause significant operational and financial disruption.

</details>


### [850] [System-Level Optimization Beyond Cryptographic Kernels: An ML-KEM Case Study on Arm Cortex-M7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01960)
*Mahmoud Abdelhafeez Sayed,Mostafa Taha,Gurp Nijjer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文以 Arm Cortex-M7 上的 ML-KEM 为案例，研究算术内核优化之外的内存层次利用、紧耦合内存放置、外设集成、时钟配置与公开数据复用带来的性能增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有嵌入式后量子密码工作主要聚焦指令级优化（算术内核改进、汇编调优、寄存器分配、指令调度），忽视了执行系统其他层面可能存在的额外收益，因此需要评估算术内核优化之后的剩余部署增益。

Method: 以 SLOTHY 优化实现为起点，覆盖 ML-KEM 全部三组参数集，在不修改密码算法和标准化线格式的前提下，评估内存层次利用、紧耦合内存放置、外设集成、时钟配置以及确定性公开数据复用等配置。

Result: 无辅助公开状态的配置最多减少 2.5% 周期数；选定的公开数据复用配置使封装与解封装周期分别最多降低 74.6% 和 58.8%。

Conclusion: 结果表明算术内核优化之后仍存在可观的部署增益，并由此提出同时考察周边执行系统的两阶段方法学。

Abstract: Recent work on embedded post-quantum cryptography has focused primarily on instruction-level optimization, including arithmetic-kernel improvements, assembly tuning, register allocation, and instruction scheduling. Using the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) on an Arm Cortex-M7 as a case study, we examine the additional gains available from memory-hierarchy utilization, tightly coupled memory placement, peripheral integration, clock configuration, and deterministic public-data reuse. The evaluation starts from a state-of-the-art SLOTHY-optimized implementation and covers all three ML-KEM parameter sets. Without modifying the cryptographic algorithm or standardized wire formats, the evaluated profiles without auxiliary public state reduce cycles by up to 2.5%. A selected public-data-reuse profile reduces encapsulation and decapsulation cycles by up to 74.6% and 58.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate that substantial deployment gains remain after arithmetic-kernel optimization and motivate a two-stage methodology that also examines the surrounding execution system.

</details>

### [851] [Improving scoring functions for protein-protein docking with LambdaLoss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00191)
*Richard Zhu,Darren Xu,Lee-Shin Chu,Jeffrey J. Gray*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 提出使用Learning-to-Rank中的LambdaLoss损失函数改进蛋白质-蛋白质对接位姿打分与排序的通用框架，通过微调DFMDock能量预测头得到LambdaDockScore。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用建模需要准确的打分函数，能够对复合物构象（位姿）进行排序，从而区分近天然位姿与错误位姿。现有方法在排序性能上仍不足。

Method: 将Learning-to-Rank领域的LambdaLoss损失函数引入生物分子相互作用建模，构建通用框架；在基于DIPS数据集构建的290万个诱饵位姿增强数据集上，使用LambdaLoss微调DFMDock的能量预测头，得到排序模型LambdaDockScore。

Result: 在CAPRI score set基准靶标上，LambdaDockScore在top-1与top-5预测中识别正确位姿的能力优于当前最优方法EuDockScore；在抗体-抗原复合物以及结合界面过大或过小的蛋白质-蛋白质复合物打分上，也优于基线DFMDock。

Conclusion: LambdaLoss可作为通用排序损失用于提升蛋白质-蛋白质位姿排序及其他生物分子相互作用模型，微调能量预测头即能显著改善近天然位姿甄别能力。

Abstract: Modeling protein-protein interactions requires accurate scoring functions that can rank potential poses (conformations) of a protein-protein complex to differentiate near-native poses from incorrect ones. Here, we propose a general framework for improving protein-protein pose ranking and other biomolecular interaction models using the LambdaLoss loss function from the Learning-to-Rank field. We test this framework by fine-tuning the energy prediction head of DFMDock with the LambdaLoss on an augmented dataset of 2.9M decoy poses derived from the DIPS dataset. On targets from the CAPRI score set benchmark, our fine-tuned ranking model LambdaDockScore is better at identifying correct poses in its top-1 and top-5 predictions compared to EuDockScore, a state-of-the-art method. LambdaDockScore also improves upon baseline DFMDock ranking performance for scoring antibody-antigen complexes and protein-protein complexes with very large or small binding interfaces.

</details>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [852] [SyntheticHLS: Building Diverse Synthetic High-Level Synthesis Datasets using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00106)
*Stefan Abi-Karam,Miaoyan Zhou,Callie Hao*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 SyntheticHLS 框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）大规模生成复杂、多样化的 HLS 合成数据集，并通过迭代反馈引导的变异循环与量化复杂度/设计空间可扩展性指标提升数据质量与泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习与 LLM 在半导体设计中快速应用，带来训练数据集需求。现有工作多聚焦硬件描述语言（HDL），而高层次综合（HLS）设计数据集稀缺。既有 HLS 数据集工作偏重人工整理或设计参数化，较少涉及高质量 LLM 生成，也缺乏在代码长度、层次结构、设计空间规模、时延、资源利用率与应用领域等方面的多样性，可能限制模型泛化能力。

Method: SyntheticHLS 的两项核心思路：1）迭代反馈引导的变异循环，利用成对的 HLS 源码与设计空间规格，将种子设计逐步转化为更复杂、更可扩展的设计；2）HLS 设计复杂度与设计空间可扩展性的量化指标，作为 LLM 引导变异可测量的优化目标。

Result: 系统性地交叉验证了一个 HLS QoR（Quality-of-Results）深度学习模型，在常见 HLS 基准、零样本合成设计及迭代变异合成设计上训练与测试。合成设计能良好迁移到常见基准测试集，反之则不成立。SyntheticHLS 的迭代变异设计在所研究数据集中提供了最具泛化性的训练语料。对变异过程与数据集的分析表明，指标引导的轨迹在不使非目标指标退化的前提下，持续改善目标复杂度与可扩展性目标；变异设计覆盖的设计空间显著比零样本生成设计更广、更多样。

Conclusion: SyntheticHLS 能借助 LLM 与量化指标驱动的迭代变异，生成大规模、复杂且多样的 HLS 数据集，显著提升训练语料泛化性，并开源框架、数据集与评估代码：https://github.com/sharc-lab/synthetic-hls。

Abstract: Deep learning and large language models (LLMs) are rapidly gaining adoption in semiconductor design, driving demand for training datasets. Most efforts focus on hardware description languages (HDLs) while designs for high-level synthesis (HLS), a popular approach to domain-specific accelerators, remain scarce. HLS dataset efforts emphasize manual curation or design parameterization, seldom addressing high-quality LLM-based generation or diversity in code length, hierarchy, design-space size, latency, resource utilization, and application domain, potentially limiting model generalization.
  We propose SyntheticHLS, a framework for generating large-scale, complex, diverse synthetic HLS datasets using LLMs. Its two key ideas are: 1) an iterative feedback-guided mutation loop that uses paired HLS source code and design-space specifications to incrementally transform seed designs into more complex, scalable designs; and 2) quantitative metrics of HLS design complexity and design-space scalability that serve as measurable objectives for LLM-guided mutation.
  We systematically cross-validate an HLS Quality-of-Results (QoR) deep learning model trained and tested across common HLS benchmarks, zero-shot synthetic designs, and iteratively mutated synthetic designs. Synthetic designs transfer well to common benchmark test sets while the reverse does not hold. SyntheticHLS's iteratively mutated designs provide the most generalizable training corpus among the datasets studied. Analysis of the mutation process and dataset shows that metric-guided trajectories consistently improve targeted complexity and scalability objectives without regressing non-target metrics. Mutated designs span a substantially broader, more diverse design space than zero-shot generated designs.
  Our framework, dataset, and evaluation are open-source: https://github.com/sharc-lab/synthetic-hls.

</details>


### [853] [ShatterQuant: Breaking Uniform Precision with Block-Wise Mixed-Precision on a Systolic Transformer Hardware Accelerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00207)
*Mikolaj Walczak,Edward Humes,Chao Fang,Marian Verhelst,Tinoosh Mohsenin*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ShatterQuant 提出了软硬件协同设计的框架，通过块级（block）混合精度量化实现张量内不同位宽的独立分配，并结合定制加速器支持 1/2/4/8-bit 权重精度，在 DeiT、ImageNet-1K 与 PixelDiT 上取得与先进混合精度方法相当甚至更优的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统加速器对张量内异构精度支持不足，导致神经网络量化大多局限于每张量（per-tensor）的精度分配，无法在单个张量内部按敏感度更细粒度地分配位宽。作者希望突破这一限制，实现张量内混合精度量化。

Method: 1) 硬件感知的后训练方法：基于块级标准差和权重敏感度分配张量内精度；2) ShatterQuant Transformer 加速器：支持 1/2/4/8-bit 权重量化、精度相关 PE 配置、块级重缩放（block rescaling），并集成 softmax 与分段线性非线性单元；3) 精度粒度与 PE 配置耦合，每个精度决定有效块高度。

Result: 在 TSMC 16nm PDK、1 GHz 下实现，达到 1.5 TOPS 算力、760 GOPS/mm² 面积效率、2.8 TOPS/W 能效。在 DeiT 与 ImageNet-1K 上，精度与最先进混合精度方法差距在 3.3% 以内，同时有效位宽低 2 bit；在 PixelDiT 上生成质量相当。

Conclusion: ShatterQuant 证明了通过软硬件协同设计，可以实现细粒度的张量内混合精度量化，在保持精度的同时降低有效位宽并提升硬件效率。

Abstract: Due to limited support for intra-tensor heterogeneous precision in conventional accelerators, neural network quantization remains largely restricted to per-tensor precision assignment. We present ShatterQuant, a hardware-software co-designed framework enabling mixed-precision quantization within each tensor by assigning independent bit-widths to blocks of a weight projection. ShatterQuant couples precision granularity with PE configuration, such that each precision determines an effective block height. We introduce (1) a hardware-aware post-training method that assigns intra-tensor precision based on block-level standard deviation and weight sensitivity; (2) the ShatterQuant Transformer Accelerator supporting 1/2/4/8-bit weight precision, precision-dependent PE configuration, block rescaling, and integrated softmax and piecewise-linear nonlinearities; and (3) an evaluation of model-hardware tradeoffs using an implementation in the TSMC 16nm PDK operating at 1 GHz, achieving 1.5 TOPS, 760 GOPS/$mm^2$ area efficiency, and 2.8 TOPS/W energy efficiency. On DeiT and ImageNet-1K, ShatterQuant achieves accuracy within $3.3\%$ of state-of-the-art mixed-precision techniques while using a 2 bit lower effective bitwidth, while for PixelDiT demonstrates comparable generation quality. ShatterQuant demonstrates how fine-grained intra-tensor mixed-precision can be realized through hardware-software co-design.

</details>


### [854] [EdgeDAE: Acceleration of Diffusion Action Experts for Real-Time Physical AI with Tiny VLAs on Edge FPGA-GPU Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00311)
*Zhiheng Chen,Ye Qiao,Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque,Sitao Huang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出EdgeDAE异构FPGA-GPU系统，将视觉Transformer卸载到GPU、将DAE推理放在FPGA上并全片上存储参数，消除DRAM访存瓶颈，实现推理延迟与能效显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理AI模型（如VLA架构）依赖大规模Transformer骨干与扩散式动作解码器实现通用机器人策略。边缘GPU擅长并行化计算密集的视觉Transformer，但对Diffusion Action Expert（DAE）存在根本性限制：迭代去噪需跨多步反复从DRAM加载参数，呈现访存受限特性，使GPU庞大算力无法充分利用。DAE的I/O密集型特征与GPU以计算为中心的架构不匹配，因此需要异构加速方案。

Method: EdgeDAE采用异构FPGA-GPU系统，依据计算特征进行工作负载划分：将感知密集的视觉Transformer卸载至GPU，而在FPGA上加速DAE推理，通过BRAM/URAM实现参数全片上存储。通过协同设计量化策略、定点运算以及面向FPGA结构的高效随机数生成，消除访存瓶颈。

Result: 相较边缘GPU基线，EdgeDAE将Octo-Small端到端推理延迟降低52.5%，Octo-Base降低38.7%，吞吐量最高提升2.10倍；相较消费级GPU（RTX 4090），能效提升约17倍。

Conclusion: 基于计算特征划分的异构FPGA-GPU协同设计可有效解决扩散动作专家的访存瓶颈，在延迟、吞吐与能效方面全面优于纯GPU方案，为物理AI模型的边缘部署提供了高效路径。

Abstract: Physical AI models such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures enable generalist robotic policies through large-scale transformer backbones and diffusion-based action decoders. While edge GPU platforms excel at parallelizing the compute-intensive vision-transformer workloads, they exhibit fundamental limitations for the Diffusion Action Expert (DAE) module: the iterative denoising process requires repeated parameter loading from DRAM across multiple steps, resulting in memory-bound performance where the GPU's massive computational throughput remains underutilized. This mismatch between DAE's I/O-intensive characteristics and GPU's compute-centric architecture motivates a heterogeneous acceleration approach. This paper presents \textbf{EdgeDAE}, a heterogeneous FPGA-GPU system that strategically partitions workloads based on computational characteristics. We offload the perception-heavy vision-transformer to GPU while accelerating DAE inference on FPGA through complete on-chip parameter storage in BRAM/URAM. This architecture eliminates the memory bottleneck by co-designing quantization strategies, fixed-point arithmetic, and hardware-efficient random number generation for the FPGA fabric. Compared to an edge GPU baseline, EdgeDAE reduces end-to-end inference latency by 52.5\% for Octo-Small and 38.7\% for Octo-Base, with up to $2.10\times$ higher throughput; compared to a consumer GPU (RTX~4090), it achieves ${\sim}17\times$ higher energy efficiency.

</details>


### [855] [From Physical Devices to RTL Models: Abstraction and Validation in Hardware Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01186)
*Wolfgang Ecker,Natalie Simson,Johannes Ecker,Endri Kaja*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文认为抽象是硬件工程模型的核心特征，系统梳理了数字设计中的抽象方法（集总模型、值离散模型、时间离散模型）及其与设计学科、抽象层级和预聚类设计元素的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件工程模型本质上是不完整的，因为抽象必然省略细节并限制设计空间，但抽象又是简化和管理复杂性的关键，且更抽象的模型仿真更快。因此有必要厘清抽象在硬件工程中的地位及其具体实现方式。

Method: 论文以"所有模型都是错的，但有些是有用的"（George Box）为出发点，考察数字设计中的多种抽象方法，包括集总模型、值离散模型和时间离散模型，并将其与约束条件、设计准则相结合来说明设计学科的构成；进而把这些抽象形式与晶体管、门、寄存器、传递函数等预聚类设计元素相关联。

Result: 这些抽象方法与定义抽象有效性的约束及设计准则共同构成设计学科；预聚类设计元素定义了门级等抽象层级，并被视为提升设计生产率的关键使能因素。

Conclusion: 抽象是硬件工程模型的定义性特征，它虽使模型在特定方面不完整，却是简化、复杂性管理和加速仿真的必要手段；通过设计学科与预聚类设计元素形成抽象层级，可有效提高设计生产率。

Abstract: This paper introduces the foundational principles underlying hardware engineering models and argues that abstraction is their defining characteristic. Because abstraction necessarily omits detail and constrains what engineers can build, models are inherently incomplete in specific respects - or, as George Box famously observed, "All models are wrong, but some are useful". At the same time, abstraction is essential for simplification, which is key to managing complexity. More abstract models also tend to simulate faster because fewer details must be considered.
  This paper subsequently examines a range of abstraction methods in digital design - sometimes referred to as design disciplines - including lumped models, value-discrete models, and time-discrete models. Together with constraints that define the validity of the abstraction and design guidelines, these abstraction methods establish design disciplines. This paper further relates these forms of abstraction to pre-clustered design elements such as transistors, gates, registers, and transfer functions. These pre-clustered elements define abstraction levels, such as the gate level, and are presented as a key enabler of increased design productivity.

</details>


### [856] [U-Sonic: An Open-Source 8-Channel Ultrasound Transmit IP in a 130 nm RISC-V SoC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01603)
*Federico Villani,Nico Canzani,Marc-André Wessner,Philippe Sauter,Enrico Zelioli,Andrea Cossettini,Christoph Leitner,Luca Benini*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: U-Sonic: 集成于32位RISC-V SoC的开源数字超声发射外设，支持最多16通道可编程脉冲激励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型化超声探头需要多阵元间可编程且同步的发射激励，而现有紧凑平台多依赖受限的MCU脉冲发生器或闭源固定功能脉冲器。

Method: 在32位RISC-V SoC中集成8个脉冲器核心（架构参数化支持16通道）；每核心可编程周期、占空比、脉冲数、极性、空闲电平，并支持可选反相停止脉冲实现主动阻尼；通过共享内存映射OBI实现任意通道子集同步启停，支持复合双极性、门控与三电平激励。采用Verilator对Python黄金模型验证，并在DE10-Lite FPGA确认，随后在IHP 130 nm完成综合与布局布线。

Result: 在4379个校验周期、定向与随机配置下功能验证通过；后布局面积为1.65 kGE加每通道1.66 kGE；8通道实例占14.9 kGE，约占104 kGE SoC的14.3%。

Conclusion: U-Sonic提供了开源、可扩展、可编程的数字超声发射外设，RTL、寄存器描述、验证配套与软件支持均已开源。

Abstract: Miniaturized ultrasound (US) probes require programmable and synchronized transmit (TX) excitation across multiple elements, while existing compact platforms often rely on limited microcontroller (MCU) pulse generators or closed-source fixed-function pulser devices. We present U-Sonic, an open-source digital US TX peripheral integrated into a 32-bit RISC-V system-on-chip (SoC). The implemented SoC integrates 8 pulser cores, while the parameterized architecture supports up to 16 channels. Each core generates single- or dual-tone bursts with programmable period, duty cycle, pulse count, polarity, and idle level, together with optional inverted stop pulses for active damping. A shared memory-mapped Open Bus Interface (OBI) enables synchronous start and stop of arbitrary channel subsets and supports composite bipolar, gated, and three-level excitation schemes. Functional correctness was verified in Verilator against a Python golden model over 4379 checked cycles across directed and randomized configurations, and confirmed on a Terasic DE10-Lite field-programmable gate array (FPGA). The design was synthesized and placed-and-routed in IHP 130 nm. The post-layout area in kilo gate equivalents (kGE), scales as 1.65 kGE plus 1.66 kGE per channel. The 8-channel instance occupies 14.9 kGE, corresponding to approximately 14.3% of the 104 kGE SoC. The register-transfer level (RTL), register descriptions, verification collateral, and software support are released as open source.

</details>


### [857] [Open-Source Multi-Wire SPI Readout for Wearable Ultrasound Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01623)
*Federico Villani,Soumyo Bhattacharjee,Lisa Odermatt,Cédric Hirschi,Luca Benini,Andrea Cossettini*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出开源多线SPI读出接口（双/四通道可配置），在FPGA上完成采样重排与32位打包，兼容类闪存协议；在IGLOO2/SiWG917上以5MHz验证，Kria K26测试床实现最高66MHz无误传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TinyProbe等可穿戴超声探头需在紧凑低功耗条件下传输日益增大的采集数据量，当前瓶颈位于采集FPGA与无线系统控制器之间的数据传输，现有方案难以突破带宽限制。

Method: 设计开源多线SPI读出接口：串行命令与地址阶段后接构建时可选择的双/四通道载荷阶段；接口模拟串行闪存，兼容多种MCU及其外设。FPGA数据通路经时钟域跨越、样本重排与32位字打包，连接采集FIFO与SPI接口。

Result: 双SPI读出集成到IGLOO2/SiWG917 TinyProbe架构，SCLK 5MHz验证通过；Kria K26独立测试床实现最高66MHz无误传输；指出SiWG917多线SPI实现成为新的带宽限制组件。

Conclusion: 该接口有效缓解FPGA到无线控制器的传输瓶颈并保持MCU兼容性，HDL与MCU实现以宽松开源许可发布，并推动未来系统控制器的升级。

Abstract: Wearable ultrasound probes must transfer increasingly large acquisition payloads while maintaining compact, low-power electronics. In TinyProbe, the current bottleneck in data transfer occurs between the acquisition FPGA and the wireless system controller. This work presents an open-source, multi-wire SPI readout interface that uses serial command and address phases followed by a build-time-selectable dual- or quad-lane payload phase that is intended to address this bottleneck by increasing the potential bandwidth over the wifi limit while retaining compatibility with the Microcontroller-centric wearable US architecture. The interface emulates a serial flash memory, enabling compatibility with a broad range of microcontroller families and their existing peripheral interfaces. On the FPGA, the data path connects the existing acquisition FIFOs to the SPI interface through clock-domain crossing, sample reshaping, and packing into 32-bit words. Dual-SPI readout is integrated into the existing IGLOO2/SiWG917 TinyProbe architecture and verified at an SCLK frequency of 5 MHz. A separate Kria K26 testbed is used to characterize the FPGA SPI interface independently of the acquisition and wireless subsystems, demonstrating error-free transfers at SCLK frequencies up to 66 MHz. These measurements identify the SiWG917 multi-lane SPI implementation as the next bandwidth-limiting component and motivate a future upgrade of the system controller. The HDL and MCU implementations are released under a permissive open-source license.

</details>


### [858] [ZTA-Q: an Open-source RISC-V Platform for Accurate Quantized CNN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01867)
*Yike Li,Ajay Kumar M,Vishnu PS,Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos,Bo Ji,Hans Vandierendonck,Deepu John*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ZTA-Q是一个开源RISC-V加速平台，实现TensorFlow Lite INT8模型端到端部署，并提供可配置后处理数据通路研究电路级近似对精度的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘AI广泛采用低精度推理以降低计算成本与内存开销，但现有开源加速平台对标准TensorFlow Lite整型推理方案的端到端支持有限。

Method: 在开源RISC-V平台上扩展算子支持，并设计可配置后处理数据通路，用于研究降低乘法器精度、共享移位缩放、简化舍入等电路级近似对模型精度的影响；系统部署于Digilent Arty A7-100T FPGA，工作频率83.3 MHz。

Result: 在代表性CNN模型上评测，LUT、寄存器与DSP开销分别为26.3%、12.6%和150%，top-1与top-5精度下降均限制在0.25个百分点以内。

Conclusion: ZTA-Q以可接受的硬件开销实现了TensorFlow Lite INT8模型的精确部署，并为电路级近似与精度权衡研究提供了可配置实验平台。

Abstract: Low-precision inference is widely adopted in edge AI to reduce computational cost and memory footprint. However, existing open-source accelerator platforms provide limited end-to-end support for CNNs following the standard TensorFlow Lite integer inference scheme. This paper presents ZTA-Q, an open-source RISC-V-based platform that enables accurate deployment of TensorFlow Lite INT8 models. In addition to extending operator support, ZTA-Q provides a configurable post-processing datapath for studying how circuit-level approximations, including reduced multiplier precision, shared shift scaling, and simplified rounding, affect model accuracy. The proposed system is implemented on a Digilent Arty A7-100T FPGA and operates at 83.3 MHz. Evaluations on representative CNN models show that with LUT, register, and DSP overheads of 26.3%, 12.6%, and 150%, respectively, ZTA-Q limits the degradation in both top-1 and top-5 accuracy to within 0.25 percentage points.

</details>


### [859] [Timing-Driven Logic Remapping with Local Physical Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01918)
*Zijian Jiang,Hongyang Pan,Cunqing Lan,Keren Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种局部重映射框架，将离散映射搜索与物理实现反馈耦合，在已有布局的时序约束下重新选择逻辑实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 映射电路的时序既取决于逻辑实现，也取决于其所在的物理环境，因此布局后重新审视映射决策需要一种能够考虑周边时序约束、扇出负载与互连效应的搜索方法。

Method: 通过有界窗口隔离时序关键区域，使窗口接口保留周边电路上下文；在窗口内建立混合整数模型，联合选择逻辑割、信号极性及库单元，并采用基于估计位置与互连寄生参数的延迟模型；先用连续松弛过滤搜索空间，再经离散优化生成时序相近但结构不同的替代实现；随后通过合法化、基于布线的寄生估计与时序分析进行重建与评估，将物理验证有效的改进纳入设计并更新上下文以指导后续搜索。

Result: 该框架能够生成在建模时序上相近、但结构选择不同的多种替代实现，并通过合法化、布线寄生估计与时序分析进行物理验证，筛选出有效改进。

Conclusion: 该框架为在既有布局条件下系统性地重访局部逻辑实现、并考虑其与布局的相互作用提供了一种有效途径。

Abstract: The timing behavior of a mapped circuit depends on both its logic implementation and the physical environment in which that implementation is realized. Revisiting mapping decisions after placement therefore requires a search procedure that accounts for surrounding timing constraints, fanout loads, and interconnect effects. We study local remapping in this setting and develop a framework that couples discrete mapping search with physical implementation feedback. Timing-critical regions are isolated through bounded windows whose interfaces retain the context of the surrounding circuit. Within each window, a mixed-integer formulation jointly selects logic cuts, signal polarities, and library cells under a delay model informed by estimated locations and interconnect parasitics. A continuous relaxation filters the search space before discrete optimization produces alternative implementations with similar modeled timing and different structural choices. These implementations are reconstructed and assessed through legalization, routing-based parasitic estimation, and timing analysis. Physically validated improvements are incorporated into the design, and the updated context guides subsequent searches. The framework provides a systematic way to revisit local logic implementations while accounting for their interaction with an existing placement.

</details>


### [860] [CONFERM: Recurrence-Aware Temporal Mapping for Multi-Cycle Multi-Context CGRAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01975)
*Jun Yin,Jannes Willemen,Stef Cuyckens,Chao Fang,Marian Verhelst*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出循环递推感知的时序映射器 CONFERM，利用主时序约束指导 DFG 表示并暴露循环携带流水机会，在十个基准内核上吞吐率较 SOTA 提升 2.18 倍，发起间隔缩短 46%，映射收敛快 5.07 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DSP 与机器学习工作负载的吞吐率常受制于循环携带递推与多周期长延迟计算节点。粗粒度可重构阵列（CGRA）可通过多上下文模配置重叠迭代来缓解，但现有映射器分别处理递推感知调度与算子级流水，导致迭代间重叠受限、路由压力增大。

Method: CONFERM 是一种递推感知时序映射器：以主导时序约束指导数据流图（DFG）表示，暴露循环携带流水机会；在调度过程中识别并优先处理瓶颈区域；利用交错迭代间规则的循环携带偏移量，使发出的控制序列以比原始发起间隔更短的节奏重复。

Result: 在十个基准内核上，CONFERM 吞吐率较 SOTA 映射器提升 2.18 倍；统一的迭代偏移使发出的发起间隔缩短 46%；在相同的启发式映射后端下，其映射 pass 收敛速度平均快 5.07 倍。

Conclusion: 通过统一的递推感知时序映射，将递推调度与算子级流水协同优化，可在降低 CGRA 配置开销的同时提升吞吐率并加速映射收敛。

Abstract: Throughput in DSP and machine learning workloads is often limited by two temporal structures, i.e., loop-carried recurrences and long-latency, multi-cycle compute nodes. On spatio-temporal coarse-grained reconfigurable arrays (CGRAs), both bottlenecks can be addressed by overlapping iterations across the multi-context modulo configurations. Yet, existing CGRA mappers schedule a fixed dataflow graph (DFG) that treats recurrence-aware scheduling and operator-level pipelining separately, limiting inter-iteration overlap and inflating routing pressure. To tackle this, we present CONFERM, a recurrence-aware temporal mapper that uses the dominant temporal con-straint to guide the DFG representation and expose opportunities for loop-carried pipelining. CONFERM identifies and prioritizes bottleneck regions during scheduling. The regular loop-carried offsets across interleaved iterations allow the emitted control sequence to repeat at a shorter cadence than the original initiation interval, thus delivering higher throughput with lower CGRA configuration overhead. Across ten benchmark kernels, CONFERM improves throughput by 2.18x over state-of-the-art mappers. Its uniform iteration offsets shorten the emitted initiation interval by 46%. CONFERM's mapper pass also converges faster by 5.07x on average with the same heuristic mapper backend.

</details>


### [861] [Catscan: Visualizing Pipelines of CPU Performance Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02121)
*Aaron Lindsay,Nicholas Kelly,Scott Witscher,Mahesh Madhav*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 论文介绍Ampere Computing开源的两项性能分析基础设施：事件流（模拟器输出格式）和Catscan（交互式可视化工具）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业界CPU团队的流水线可视化工具通常不公开，导致学生、研究者及从业者难以接触处理器架构师在流片前用于调试性能的工具。作者希望将内部工具开放给社区。

Method: 提出事件流格式：以带类型的事件记录微架构活动，并通过事务关系连接事件，使用户可在症状与解释症状的指令、uop或内存事务之间导航。基于该格式构建Catscan交互式查看器，支持资源导向与事务导向视图、持久高亮、领域特定搜索、对比轨迹同步等工作流。

Result: 两项工具已在生产环境中实际使用，并作为开源发布；论文报告了经生产验证的设计选择、遇到的局限性。

Conclusion: 总结了可供未来微架构可视化工具借鉴的经验教训。

Abstract: Processor pipeline visualization tools are routine inside industry CPU teams, but few of them are described or released publicly. As a result, students, researchers, and other practitioners rarely see the tooling that processor architects use to debug performance before silicon. This paper describes two pieces of Ampere Computing's performance- analysis infrastructure that we have released to the community as open source: event streams, a simulator-output format, and Catscan, an interactive viewer built around that format. Event streams record microarchitectural activity as typed events connected by transaction relationships, so a user can move between a symptom and the instruction, uop, or memory transaction that explains it. Catscan uses that structure to support resource- and transaction-oriented views, persistent highlighting, domain-specific search, comparative trace synchronization, and other workflows used during product development. In this paper we report the design choices that survived production use, the limitations we encountered, and the lessons we think are useful for future microarchitectural visualization tools.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>
